verses.en: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
verses.fr: Plusieurs ayant entrepris de composer un récit des événements qui se sont accomplis parmi nous,
verses.am: የከበርህ ቴዎፍሎስ ሆይ፥ ከመጀመሪያው በዓይን ያዩትና የቃሉ አገልጋዮች የሆኑት እንዳስተላለፉልን፥

verses.en: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
verses.fr: suivant ce que nous ont transmis ceux qui ont été des témoins oculaires dès le commencement et sont devenus des ministres de la parole,
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሄሮድስ ዘመን ከአብያ ክፍል የሆነ ዘካርያስ የሚባል አንድ ካህን ነበረ፤ ሚስቱም ከአሮን ልጆች ነበረች፥ ስምዋም ኤልሳቤጥ ነበረ።

verses.en: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
verses.fr: il m''a aussi semblé bon, après avoir fait des recherches exactes sur toutes ces choses depuis leur origine, de te les exposer par écrit d''une manière suivie, excellent Théophile,
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሄሮድስ ዘመን ከአብያ ክፍል የሆነ ዘካርያስ የሚባል አንድ ካህን ነበረ፤ ሚስቱም ከአሮን ልጆች ነበረች፥ ስምዋም ኤልሳቤጥ ነበረ።

verses.en: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
verses.fr: afin que tu reconnaisses la certitude des enseignements que tu as reçus.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሄሮድስ ዘመን ከአብያ ክፍል የሆነ ዘካርያስ የሚባል አንድ ካህን ነበረ፤ ሚስቱም ከአሮን ልጆች ነበረች፥ ስምዋም ኤልሳቤጥ ነበረ።

verses.en: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
verses.fr: Du temps d''Hérode, roi de Judée, il y avait un sacrificateur, nommé Zacharie, de la classe d''Abia; sa femme était d''entre les filles d''Aaron, et s''appelait Elisabeth.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሄሮድስ ዘመን ከአብያ ክፍል የሆነ ዘካርያስ የሚባል አንድ ካህን ነበረ፤ ሚስቱም ከአሮን ልጆች ነበረች፥ ስምዋም ኤልሳቤጥ ነበረ።

verses.en: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
verses.fr: Tous deux étaient justes devant Dieu, observant d''une manière irréprochable tous les commandements et toutes les ordonnances du Seigneur.
verses.am: ሁለቱም በጌታ ትእዛዝና ሕግጋት ሁሉ ያለ ነቀፋ እየሄዱ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጻድቃን ነበሩ።

verses.en: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
verses.fr: Ils n''avaient point d''enfants, parce qu''Elisabeth était stérile; et ils étaient l''un et l''autre avancés en âge.
verses.am: ኤልሳቤጥም መካን ነበረችና ልጅ አልነበራቸውም፤ ሁለቱም በዕድሜያቸው አርጅተው ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,
verses.fr: Or, pendant qu''il s''acquittait de ses fonctions devant Dieu, selon le tour de sa classe,
verses.am: እርሱም በክፍሉ ተራ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሲያገለግል፥

verses.en: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
verses.fr: il fut appelé par le sort, d''après la règle du sacerdoce, à entrer dans le temple du Seigneur pour offrir le parfum.
verses.am: እንደ ካህናት ሥርዓት ወደ ጌታ ቤተ መቅደስ ገብቶ ለማጠን ዕጣ ደረሰበት።

verses.en: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
verses.fr: Toute la multitude du peuple était dehors en prière, à l''heure du parfum.
verses.am: በዕጣንም ጊዜ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ በውጭ ቆመው ይጸልዩ ነበር።

verses.en: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
verses.fr: Alors un ange du Seigneur apparut à Zacharie, et se tint debout à droite de l''autel des parfums.
verses.am: የጌታም መልአክ በዕጣኑ መሠዊያ ቀኝ ቆሞ ታየው።

verses.en: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
verses.fr: Zacharie fut troublé en le voyant, et la frayeur s''empara de lui.
verses.am: ዘካርያስም ባየው ጊዜ ደነገጠ፥ ፍርሃትም ወደቀበት።

verses.en: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
verses.fr: Mais l''ange lui dit: Ne crains point, Zacharie; car ta prière a été exaucée. Ta femme Elisabeth t''enfantera un fils, et tu lui donneras le nom de Jean.
verses.am: መልአኩም እንዲህ አለው። ዘካርያስ ሆይ፥ ጸሎትህ ተሰምቶልሃልና አትፍራ ሚስትህ ኤልሳቤጥም ወንድ ልጅ ትወልድልሃለች፥ ስሙንም ዮሐንስ ትለዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
verses.fr: Il sera pour toi un sujet de joie et d''allégresse, et plusieurs se réjouiront de sa naissance.
verses.am: ደስታና ተድላም ይሆንልሃል፥ በመወለዱም ብዙዎች ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.
verses.fr: Car il sera grand devant le Seigneur. Il ne boira ni vin, ni liqueur enivrante, et il sera rempli de l''Esprit-Saint dès le sein de sa mère;
verses.am: በጌታ ፊት ታላቅ ይሆናልና፥ የወይን ጠጅና የሚያሰክር መጠጥ አይጠጣም፤ ገናም በእናቱ ማኅፀን ሳለ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ይሞላበታል፤

verses.en: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.
verses.fr: il ramènera plusieurs des fils d''Israël au Seigneur, leur Dieu;
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ብዙዎችን ወደ ጌታ ወደ አምላካቸው ይመልሳል።

verses.en: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
verses.fr: il marchera devant Dieu avec l''esprit et la puissance d''Elie, pour ramener les coeurs des pères vers les enfants, et les rebelles à la sagesse des justes, afin de préparer au Seigneur un peuple bien disposé.
verses.am: እርሱም የተዘጋጁትን ሕዝብ ለጌታ እንዲያሰናዳ፥ የአባቶችን ልብ ወደ ልጆች የማይታዘዙትንም ወደ ጻድቃን ጥበብ ይመልስ ዘንድ በኤልያስ መንፈስና ኃይል በፊቱ ይሄዳል።

verses.en: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
verses.fr: Zacharie dit à l''ange: A quoi reconnaîtrai-je cela? Car je suis vieux, et ma femme est avancée en âge.
verses.am: ዘካርያስም መልአኩን። እኔ ሽማግሌ ነኝ ምስቴም በዕድሜዋ አርጅታለችና ይህን በምን አውቃለሁ? አለው።

verses.en: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
verses.fr: L''ange lui répondit: Je suis Gabriel, je me tiens devant Dieu; j''ai été envoyé pour te parler, et pour t''annoncer cette bonne nouvelle.
verses.am: መልአኩም መልሶ። እኔ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የምቆመው ገብርኤል ነኝ፥ እንድናገርህም ይህችንም የምሥራች እንድሰብክልህ ተልኬ ነበር፤

verses.en: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
verses.fr: Et voici, tu seras muet, et tu ne pourras parler jusqu''au jour où ces choses arriveront, parce que tu n''as pas cru à mes paroles, qui s''accompliront en leur temps.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ በጊዜው የሚፈጸመውን ቃሌን ስላላመንህ፥ ይህ ነገር እስከሚሆን ቀን ድረስ ዲዳ ትሆናለህ መናገርም አትችልም አለው።

verses.en: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
verses.fr: Cependant, le peuple attendait Zacharie, s''étonnant de ce qu''il restait si longtemps dans le temple.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ዘካርያስን ይጠብቁት ነበር፤ በቤተ መቅደስም ውስጥ ስለ ዘገየ ይደነቁ ነበር።

verses.en: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
verses.fr: Quand il sortit, il ne put leur parler, et ils comprirent qu''il avait eu une vision dans le temple; il leur faisait des signes, et il resta muet.
verses.am: በወጣም ጊዜ ሊነግራቸው አልቻለም፥ በቤተ መቅደስም ራእይ እንዳየ አስተዋሉ፤ እርሱም ይጠቅሳቸው ነበር፤ ድዳም ሆኖ ኖረ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
verses.fr: Lorsque ses jours de service furent écoulés, il s''en alla chez lui.
verses.am: የማገልገሉም ወራት ሲፈጸም ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.en: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
verses.fr: Quelque temps après, Elisabeth, sa femme, devint enceinte. Elle se cacha pendant cinq mois, disant:
verses.am: በስድስተኛውም ወር መልአኩ ገብርኤል ናዝሬት ወደምትባል ወደ ገሊላ ከተማ፥

verses.en: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
verses.fr: C''est la grâce que le Seigneur m''a faite, quand il a jeté les yeux sur moi pour ôter mon opprobre parmi les hommes.
verses.am: በስድስተኛውም ወር መልአኩ ገብርኤል ናዝሬት ወደምትባል ወደ ገሊላ ከተማ፥

verses.en: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
verses.fr: Au sixième mois, l''ange Gabriel fut envoyé par Dieu dans une ville de Galilée, appelée Nazareth,
verses.am: ከዳዊት ወገን ለሆነው ዮሴፍ ለሚባል ሰው ወደ ታጨች ወደ አንዲት ድንግል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ተላከ፥ የድንግሊቱም ስም ማርያም ነበረ።

verses.en: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.
verses.fr: auprès d''une vierge fiancée à un homme de la maison de David, nommé Joseph. Le nom de la vierge était Marie.
verses.am: መልአኩም ወደ እርስዋ ገብቶ። ደስ ይበልሽ፥ ጸጋ የሞላብሽ ሆይ፥ ጌታ ከአንቺ ጋር ነው፤ አንቺ ከሴቶች መካከል የተባረክሽ ነሽ አላት።

verses.en: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
verses.fr: L''ange entra chez elle, et dit: Je te salue, toi à qui une grâce a été faite; le Seigneur est avec toi.
verses.am: እርስዋም ባየችው ጊዜ ከንግግሩ በጣም ደነገጠችና። ይህ እንዴት ያለ ሰላምታ ነው? ብላ አሰበች።

verses.en: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
verses.fr: Troublée par cette parole, Marie se demandait ce que pouvait signifier une telle salutation.
verses.am: መልአኩም እንዲህ አላት። ማርያም ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጸጋ አግኝተሻልና አትፍሪ።

verses.en: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
verses.fr: L''ange lui dit: Ne crains point, Marie; car tu as trouvé grâce devant Dieu.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ትፀንሻለሽ ወንድ ልጅም ትወልጃለሽ፥ ስሙንም ኢየሱስ ትዪዋለሽ።

verses.en: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name Jesus.
verses.fr: Et voici, tu deviendras enceinte, et tu enfanteras un fils, et tu lui donneras le nom de Jésus.
verses.am: እርሱ ታላቅ ይሆናል የልዑል ልጅም ይባላል፥ ጌታ አምላክም የአባቱን የዳዊትን ዙፋን ይሰጠዋል፤

verses.en: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
verses.fr: Il sera grand et sera appelé Fils du Très-Haut, et le Seigneur Dieu lui donnera le trône de David, son père.
verses.am: በያዕቆብ ቤትም ላይ ለዘለላም ይነግሣል፥ ለመንግሥቱም መጨረሻ የለውም።

verses.en: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
verses.fr: Il règnera sur la maison de Jacob éternellement, et son règne n''aura point de fin.
verses.am: ማርያምም መልአኩን። ወንድ ስለማላውቅ ይህ እንዴት ይሆናል? አለችው።

verses.en: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
verses.fr: Marie dit à l''ange: Comment cela se fera-t-il, puisque je ne connais point d''homme?
verses.am: መልአኩም መልሶ እንዲህ አላት። መንፈስ ቅዱስ በአንቺ ላይ ይመጣል፥ የልዑልም ኃይል ይጸልልሻል ስለዚህ ደግሞ ከአንቺ የሚወለደው ቅዱስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ይባላል።

verses.en: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
verses.fr: L''ange lui répondit: Le Saint-Esprit viendra sur toi, et la puissance du Très-Haut te couvrira de son ombre. C''est pourquoi le saint enfant qui naîtra de toi sera appelé Fils de Dieu.
verses.am: እነሆም ዘመድሽ ኤልሳቤጥ፥ እርስዋ ደግሞ በእርጅናዋ ወንድ ልጅ ፀንሳለች፥ ለእርስዋም መካን ትባል ለነበረችው ይህ ስድስተኛ ወር ነው፤

verses.en: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
verses.fr: Voici, Elisabeth, ta parente, a conçu, elle aussi, un fils en sa vieillesse, et celle qui était appelée stérile est dans son sixième mois.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሳነው ነገር የለምና።

verses.en: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
verses.fr: Car rien n''est impossible à Dieu.
verses.am: ማርያምም። እነሆኝ የጌታ ባሪያ እንደ ቃልህ ይሁንልኝ አለች። መልአኩም ከእርስዋ ሄደ።

verses.en: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
verses.fr: Marie dit: Je suis la servante du Seigneur; qu''il me soit fait selon ta parole! Et l''ange la quitta.
verses.am: ማርያምም በዚያ ወራት ተነሥታ ወደ ተራራማው አገር ወደ ይሁዳ ከተማ ፈጥና ወጣች፥

verses.en: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;
verses.fr: Dans ce même temps, Marie se leva, et s''en alla en hâte vers les montagnes, dans une ville de Juda.
verses.am: ወደ ዘካርያስም ቤት ገብታ ኤልሳቤጥን ተሳለመቻት።

verses.en: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
verses.fr: Elle entra dans la maison de Zacharie, et salua Elisabeth.
verses.am: ኤልሳቤጥም የማርያምን ሰላምታ በሰማች ጊዜ ፅንሱ በማኅፀንዋ ውስጥ ዘለለ፤ በኤልሳቤጥም መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላባት፥

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:
verses.fr: Dès qu''Elisabeth entendit la salutation de Marie, son enfant tressaillit dans son sein, et elle fut remplie du Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: በታላቅ ድምፅም ጮኻ እንዲህ አለች። አንቺ ከሴቶች መካከል የተባረክሽ ነሽ፥ የማኅፀንሽም ፍሬ የተባረከ ነው።

verses.en: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
verses.fr: Elle s''écria d''une voix forte: Tu es bénie entre les femmes, et le fruit de ton sein est béni.
verses.am: የጌታዬ እናት ወደ እኔ ትመጣ ዘንድ እንዴት ይሆንልኛል?

verses.en: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
verses.fr: Comment m''est-il accordé que la mère de mon Seigneur vienne auprès de moi?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የሰላምታሽ ድምጽ በጆሮዬ በመጣ ጊዜ ፅንሱ በማኅፀኔ በደስታ ዘሎአልና።

verses.en: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
verses.fr: Car voici, aussitôt que la voix de ta salutation a frappé mon oreille, l''enfant a tressailli d''allégresse dans mon sein.
verses.am: ከጌታ፤ የተነገረላት ቃል ይፈጸማልና ያመነች ብፅዕት ናት።

verses.en: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
verses.fr: Heureuse celle qui a cru, parce que les choses qui lui ont été dites de la part du Seigneur auront leur accomplissement.
verses.am: ማርያምም እንዲህ አለች።

verses.en: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
verses.fr: Et Marie dit: Mon âme exalte le Seigneur,
verses.am: ነፍሴ ጌታን ታከብረዋለች፥ መንፈሴም በአምላኬ በመድኃኒቴ ሐሴት ታደርጋለች፤

verses.en: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
verses.fr: Et mon esprit se réjouit en Dieu, mon Sauveur,
verses.am: የባሪያይቱን ውርደት ተመልክቶአልና። እነሆም፥ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ትውልድ ሁሉ ብፅዕት ይሉኛል፤

verses.en: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
verses.fr: Parce qu''il a jeté les yeux sur la bassesse de sa servante. Car voici, désormais toutes les générations me diront bienheureuse,
verses.am: ብርቱ የሆነ እርሱ በእኔ ታላቅ ሥራ አድርጎአልና፤ ስሙም ቅዱስ ነው።

verses.en: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
verses.fr: Parce que le Tout-Puissant a fait pour moi de grandes choses. Son nom est saint,
verses.am: ምሕረቱም ለሚፈሩት እስከ ትውልድና ትውልድ ይኖራል።

verses.en: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.
verses.fr: Et sa miséricorde s''étend d''âge en âge Sur ceux qui le craignent.
verses.am: በክንዱ ኃይል አድርጎአል፤ ትዕቢተኞችን በልባቸው አሳብ በትኖአል፤

verses.en: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
verses.fr: Il a déployé la force de son bras; Il a dispersé ceux qui avaient dans le coeur des pensées orgueilleuses.
verses.am: ገዥዎችን ከዙፋናቸው አዋርዶአል፤ ትሑታንንም ከፍ አድርጎአል፤

verses.en: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
verses.fr: Il a renversé les puissants de leurs trônes, Et il a élevé les humbles.
verses.am: የተራቡትን በበጎ ነገር አጥግቦአል፤ ባለ ጠጎችንም ባዶአቸውን ሰዶአቸዋል።

verses.en: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
verses.fr: Il a rassasié de biens les affamés, Et il a renvoyé les riches à vide.
verses.am: ማርያምም ሦስት ወር የሚያህል በእርስዋ ዘንድ ተቀመጠች ወደ ቤትዋም ተመለሰች።

verses.en: He hath helped his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;
verses.fr: Il a secouru Israël, son serviteur, Et il s''est souvenu de sa miséricorde, -
verses.am: ማርያምም ሦስት ወር የሚያህል በእርስዋ ዘንድ ተቀመጠች ወደ ቤትዋም ተመለሰች።

verses.en: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
verses.fr: Comme il l''avait dit à nos pères, -Envers Abraham et sa postérité pour toujours.
verses.am: የኤልሳቤጥም የመውለጃዋ ጊዜ ደረሰ፥ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች።

verses.en: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.
verses.fr: Marie demeura avec Elisabeth environ trois mois. Puis elle retourna chez elle.
verses.am: ጎረቤቶችዋም ዘመዶችዋም ጌታ ምሕረቱን እንዳገነነላት ሰምተው ከእርስዋ ጋር ደስ አላቸው።

verses.en: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
verses.fr: Le temps où Elisabeth devait accoucher arriva, et elle enfanta un fils.
verses.am: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ሕፃኑን ሊገርዙት መጡ፥ በአባቱም ስም ዘካርያስ ሊሉት ወደዱ።

verses.en: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
verses.fr: Ses voisins et ses parents apprirent que le Seigneur avait fait éclater envers elle sa miséricorde, et ils se réjouirent avec elle.
verses.am: እናቱ ግን መልሳ። አይሆንም፥ ዮሐንስ ይባል እንጂ አለች።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
verses.fr: Le huitième jour, ils vinrent pour circoncire l''enfant, et ils l''appelaient Zacharie, du nom de son père.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ከወገንሽ ማንም በዚህ ስም የተጠራ የለም አሉአት።

verses.en: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.
verses.fr: Mais sa mère prit la parole, et dit: Non, il sera appelé Jean.
verses.am: አባቱንም ማን ሊባል እንዲወድ ጠቀሱት።

verses.en: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: Il n''y a dans ta parenté personne qui soit appelé de ce nom.
verses.am: ብራናም ለምኖ። ስሙ ዮሐንስ ነው ብሎ ጻፈ። ሁሉም አደነቁ።

verses.en: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.
verses.fr: Et ils firent des signes à son père pour savoir comment il voulait qu''on l''appelle.
verses.am: ያንጊዜም አፉ ተከፈተ መላሱም ተፈታ እግዚአብሔርንም እየባረከ ተናገረ።

verses.en: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
verses.fr: Zacharie demanda des tablettes, et il écrivit: Jean est son nom. Et tous furent dans l''étonnement.
verses.am: ለጎረቤቶቻቸውም ሁሉ ፍርሃት ሆነ፤ ይህም ሁሉ ነገር በይሁዳ በተራራማው አገር ሁሉ ተወራ፤

verses.en: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.
verses.fr: Au même instant, sa bouche s''ouvrit, sa langue se délia, et il parlait, bénissant Dieu.
verses.am: የሰሙትም ሁሉ። እንኪያ ይህ ሕፃን ምን ይሆን? እያሉ በልባቸው አኖሩት፤ የጌታ እጅ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረችና።

verses.en: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.
verses.fr: La crainte s''empara de tous les habitants d''alentour, et, dans toutes les montagnes de la Judée, on s''entretenait de toutes ces choses.
verses.am: አባቱ ዘካርያስም መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላበትና ትንቢት ተናገረ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui les apprirent les gardèrent dans leur coeur, en disant: Que sera donc cet enfant? Et la main du Seigneur était avec lui.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ጌታ አምላክ ይባረክ፥ ጐብኝቶ ለሕዝቡ ቤዛ አድርጎአልና፤

verses.en: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
verses.fr: Zacharie, son père, fut rempli du Saint-Esprit, et il prophétisa, en ces mots:
verses.am: ማዳኑም ከወደረኞቻችንና ከሚጠሉን ሁሉ እጅ ነው፤

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
verses.fr: Béni soit le Seigneur, le Dieu d''Israël, De ce qu''il a visité et racheté son peuple,
verses.am: ማዳኑም ከወደረኞቻችንና ከሚጠሉን ሁሉ እጅ ነው፤

verses.en: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;
verses.fr: Et nous a suscité un puissant Sauveur Dans la maison de David, son serviteur,
verses.am: ደግሞም አንተ ሕፃን ሆይ፥ የልዑል ነቢይ ትባላለህ፥ መንገዱን ልትጠርግ በጌታ ፊት ትሄዳለህና፤

verses.en: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:
verses.fr: Comme il l''avait annoncé par la bouche de ses saints prophètes des temps anciens, -
verses.am: ደግሞም አንተ ሕፃን ሆይ፥ የልዑል ነቢይ ትባላለህ፥ መንገዱን ልትጠርግ በጌታ ፊት ትሄዳለህና፤

verses.en: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
verses.fr: Un Sauveur qui nous délivre de nos ennemis et de la main de tous ceux qui nous haïssent!
verses.am: ደግሞም አንተ ሕፃን ሆይ፥ የልዑል ነቢይ ትባላለህ፥ መንገዱን ልትጠርግ በጌታ ፊት ትሄዳለህና፤

verses.en: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;
verses.fr: C''est ainsi qu''il manifeste sa miséricorde envers nos pères, Et se souvient de sa sainte alliance,
verses.am: እንደዚህም የኃጢአታቸው ስርየት የሆነውን የመዳን እውቀት ለሕዝቡ ትሰጣለህ፤

verses.en: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
verses.fr: Selon le serment par lequel il avait juré à Abraham, notre père,
verses.am: ይህም ከላይ የመጣ ብርሃን በጐበኘበት በአምላካችን ምሕረትና ርኅራኄ ምክንያት ነው፤

verses.en: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,
verses.fr: De nous permettre, après que nous serions délivrés de la main de nos ennemis, De le servir sans crainte,
verses.am: ብርሃኑም በጨለማና በሞት ጥላ ተቀምጠው ላሉት ያበራል እግሮቻችንንም በሰላም መንገድ ያቀናል።

verses.en: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
verses.fr: En marchant devant lui dans la sainteté et dans la justice tous les jours de notre vie.
verses.am: ሕፃኑም አደገ በመንፈስም ጠነከረ፥ ለእስራኤልም እስከ ታየበት ቀን ድረስ በምድረ በዳ ኖረ።

verses.en: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;
verses.fr: Et toi, petit enfant, tu seras appelé prophète du Très-Haut; Car tu marcheras devant la face du Seigneur, pour préparer ses voies,
verses.am: ደግሞም አንተ ሕፃን ሆይ፥ የልዑል ነቢይ ትባላለህ፥ መንገዱን ልትጠርግ በጌታ ፊት ትሄዳለህና፤

verses.en: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,
verses.fr: Afin de donner à son peuple la connaissance du salut Par le pardon de ses péchés,
verses.am: እንደዚህም የኃጢአታቸው ስርየት የሆነውን የመዳን እውቀት ለሕዝቡ ትሰጣለህ፤

verses.en: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
verses.fr: Grâce aux entrailles de la miséricorde de notre Dieu, En vertu de laquelle le soleil levant nous a visités d''en haut,
verses.am: ይህም ከላይ የመጣ ብርሃን በጐበኘበት በአምላካችን ምሕረትና ርኅራኄ ምክንያት ነው፤

verses.en: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
verses.fr: Pour éclairer ceux qui sont assis dans les ténèbres et dans l''ombre de la mort, Pour diriger nos pas dans le chemin de la paix.
verses.am: ብርሃኑም በጨለማና በሞት ጥላ ተቀምጠው ላሉት ያበራል እግሮቻችንንም በሰላም መንገድ ያቀናል።

verses.en: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.
verses.fr: Or, l''enfant croissait, et se fortifiait en esprit. Et il demeura dans les déserts, jusqu''au jour où il se présenta devant Israël.
verses.am: ሕፃኑም አደገ በመንፈስም ጠነከረ፥ ለእስራኤልም እስከ ታየበት ቀን ድረስ በምድረ በዳ ኖረ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be taxed.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là parut un édit de César Auguste, ordonnant un recensement de toute la terre.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት ዓለሙ ሁሉ እንዲጻፍ ከአውግስጦስ ቄሣር ትእዛዝ ወጣች።

verses.en: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
verses.fr: Ce premier recensement eut lieu pendant que Quirinius était gouverneur de Syrie.
verses.am: ቄሬኔዎስ በሶርያ አገር ገዥ በነበረ ጊዜ ይህ የመጀመሪያ ጽሕፈት ሆነ።

verses.en: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
verses.fr: Tous allaient se faire inscrire, chacun dans sa ville.
verses.am: ሁሉም እያንዳንዱ ይጻፍ ዘንድ ወደ ከተማው ሄደ።

verses.en: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
verses.fr: Joseph aussi monta de la Galilée, de la ville de Nazareth, pour se rendre en Judée, dans la ville de David, appelée Bethléhem, parce qu''il était de la maison et de la famille de David,

verses.en: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
verses.fr: afin de se faire inscrire avec Marie, sa fiancée, qui était enceinte.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ደግሞ ከዳዊት ቤትና ወገን ስለ ነበረ ከገሊላ ከናዝሬት ከተማ ተነሥቶ ቤተ ልሔም ወደምትባል ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ ወደ ይሁዳ፥ ፀንሳ ከነበረች ከእጮኛው ከማርያም ጋር ይጻፍ ዘንድ ወጣ።

verses.en: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''ils étaient là, le temps où Marie devait accoucher arriva,
verses.am: በዚያም ሳሉ የመውለጃዋ ወራት ደረሰ፥

verses.en: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
verses.fr: et elle enfanta son fils premier-né. Elle l''emmaillota, et le coucha dans une crèche, parce qu''il n''y avait pas de place pour eux dans l''hôtellerie.
verses.am: የበኵር ልጅዋንም ወለደች፥ በመጠቅለያም ጠቀለለችው፤ በእንግዶችም ማደሪያ ስፍራ ስላልነበራቸው በግርግም አስተኛችው።

verses.en: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
verses.fr: Il y avait, dans cette même contrée, des bergers qui passaient dans les champs les veilles de la nuit pour garder leurs troupeaux.
verses.am: በዚያም ምድር መንጋቸውን በሌሊት ሲጠብቁ በሜዳ ያደሩ እረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
verses.fr: Et voici, un ange du Seigneur leur apparut, et la gloire du Seigneur resplendit autour d''eux. Ils furent saisis d''une grande frayeur.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ የጌታ መልአክ ወደ እነርሱ ቀረበ የጌታ ክብርም በዙሪያቸው አበራ፥ ታላቅ ፍርሃትም ፈሩ።

verses.en: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
verses.fr: Mais l''ange leur dit: Ne craignez point; car je vous annonce une bonne nouvelle, qui sera pour tout le peuple le sujet d''une grande joie:
verses.am: መልአኩም እንዲህ አላቸው። እነሆ፥ ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ የሚሆን ታላቅ ደስታ የምሥራች እነግራችኋለሁና አትፍሩ፤

verses.en: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
verses.fr: c''est qu''aujourd''hui, dans la ville de David, il vous est né un Sauveur, qui est le Christ, le Seigneur.
verses.am: ዛሬ በዳዊት ከተማ መድኃኒት እርሱም ክርስቶስ ጌታ የሆነ ተወልዶላችኋልና።

verses.en: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
verses.fr: Et voici à quel signe vous le reconnaîtrez: vous trouverez un enfant emmailloté et couché dans une crèche.
verses.am: ይህም ምልክት ይሆንላችኋል፤ ሕፃን ተጠቅልሎ በግርግምም ተኝቶ ታገኛላችሁ።

verses.en: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
verses.fr: Et soudain il se joignit à l''ange une multitude de l''armée céleste, louant Dieu et disant:
verses.am: ድንገትም ብዙ የሰማይ ሠራዊት ከመልአኩ ጋር ነበሩ። እግዚአብሔርንም እያመሰገኑ።

verses.en: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
verses.fr: Gloire à Dieu dans les lieux très hauts, Et paix sur la terre parmi les hommes qu''il agrée!
verses.am: ክብር ለእግዚአብሔር በአርያም ይሁን ሰላምም በምድር ለሰውም በጎ ፈቃድ አሉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.
verses.fr: Lorsque les anges les eurent quittés pour retourner au ciel, les bergers se dirent les uns aux autres: Allons jusqu''à Bethléhem, et voyons ce qui est arrivé, ce que le Seigneur nous a fait connaître.
verses.am: መላእክትም ከእነርሱ ተለይተው ወደ ሰማይ በወጡ ጊዜ፥ እረኞቹ እርስ በርሳቸው። እንግዲህ እስከ ቤተ ልሔም ድረስ እንሂድ እግዚአብሔርም የገለጠልንን ይህን የሆነውን ነገር እንይ ተባባሉ።

verses.en: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
verses.fr: Ils y allèrent en hâte, et ils trouvèrent Marie et Joseph, et le petit enfant couché dans la crèche.
verses.am: ፈጥነውም መጡ ማርያምንና ዮሴፍን ሕፃኑንም በግርግም ተኝቶ አገኙ።

verses.en: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
verses.fr: Après l''avoir vu, ils racontèrent ce qui leur avait été dit au sujet de ce petit enfant.
verses.am: አይተውም ስለዚህ ሕፃን የተነገረላቸውን ነገር ገለጡ።

verses.en: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui les entendirent furent dans l''étonnement de ce que leur disaient les bergers.
verses.am: የሰሙትን ሁሉ እረኞቹ በነገሩአቸው ነገር አደነቁ፤

verses.en: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
verses.fr: Marie gardait toutes ces choses, et les repassait dans son coeur.
verses.am: ማርያም ግን ይህን ነገር ሁሉ በልብዋ እያሰበች ትጠብቀው ነበር።

verses.en: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
verses.fr: Et les bergers s''en retournèrent, glorifiant et louant Dieu pour tout ce qu''ils avaient entendu et vu, et qui était conforme à ce qui leur avait été annoncé.
verses.am: እረኞችም እንደ ተባለላቸው ስለ ሰሙትና ስላዩት ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገኑና እያከበሩ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
verses.fr: Le huitième jour, auquel l''enfant devait être circoncis, étant arrivé, on lui donna le nom de Jésus, nom qu''avait indiqué l''ange avant qu''il fût conçu dans le sein de sa mère.
verses.am: ሊገርዙት ስምንት ቀን በሞላ ጊዜ፥ በማኅፀን ሳይረገዝ በመልአኩ እንደ ተባለ፥ ስሙ ኢየሱስ ተብሎ ተጠራ።

verses.en: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
verses.fr: Et, quand les jours de leur purification furent accomplis, selon la loi de Moïse, Joseph et Marie le portèrent à Jérusalem, pour le présenter au Seigneur, -

verses.en: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
verses.fr: suivant ce qui est écrit dans la loi du Seigneur: Tout mâle premier-né sera consacré au Seigneur, -
verses.am: እንደ ሙሴም ሕግ የመንጻታቸው ወራት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ በጌታ ሕግ። የእናቱን ማኅፀን የሚከፍት ወንድ ሁሉ ለጌታ የተቀደሰ ይባላል ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ በጌታ ፊት ሊያቆሙት፥ በጌታም ሕግ። ሁለት ዋሊያ ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ጫጩቶች እንደ ተባለ፥ መሥዋዕት ሊያቀርቡ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወሰዱት።

verses.en: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
verses.fr: et pour offrir en sacrifice deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons, comme cela est prescrit dans la loi du Seigneur.
verses.am: እንደ ሙሴም ሕግ የመንጻታቸው ወራት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ በጌታ ሕግ። የእናቱን ማኅፀን የሚከፍት ወንድ ሁሉ ለጌታ የተቀደሰ ይባላል ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ በጌታ ፊት ሊያቆሙት፥ በጌታም ሕግ። ሁለት ዋሊያ ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ጫጩቶች እንደ ተባለ፥ መሥዋዕት ሊያቀርቡ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወሰዱት።

verses.en: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
verses.fr: Et voici, il y avait à Jérusalem un homme appelé Siméon. Cet homme était juste et pieux, il attendait la consolation d''Israël, et l''Esprit-Saint était sur lui.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ስምዖን የሚባል ሰው ነበረ፥ ይህም ሰው የእስራኤልን መጽናናት ይጠባበቅ ነበር፤ ጻድቅና ትጉህም ነበረ፥ መንፈስ ቅዱስም በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ።

verses.en: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.
verses.fr: Il avait été divinement averti par le Saint-Esprit qu''il ne mourrait point avant d''avoir vu le Christ du Seigneur.
verses.am: በጌታም የተቀባውን ሳያይ ሞትን እንዳያይ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተረድቶ ነበር።

verses.en: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
verses.fr: Il vint au temple, poussé par l''Esprit. Et, comme les parents apportaient le petit enfant Jésus pour accomplir à son égard ce qu''ordonnait la loi,
verses.am: በመንፈስም ወደ መቅደስ ወጣ፤ ወላጆቹም እንደ ሕጉ ልማድ ያደርጉለት ዘንድ ሕፃኑን ኢየሱስን በአስገቡት ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
verses.fr: il le reçut dans ses bras, bénit Dieu, et dit:
verses.am: እርሱ ደግሞ ተቀብሎ አቀፈው እግዚአብሔርንም እየባረከ እንዲህ አለ።

verses.en: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
verses.fr: Maintenant, Seigneur, tu laisses ton serviteur S''en aller en paix, selon ta parole.
verses.am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ አሁን እንደ ቃልህ ባሪያህን በሰላም ታሰናብተዋለህ፤

verses.en: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
verses.fr: Car mes yeux ont vu ton salut,
verses.am: ይህም ለአሕዛብ ሁሉን የሚገልጥ ብርሃን ለሕዝብህም ለእስራኤል ክብር ነው።

verses.en: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
verses.fr: Salut que tu as préparé devant tous les peuples,
verses.am: ይህም ለአሕዛብ ሁሉን የሚገልጥ ብርሃን ለሕዝብህም ለእስራኤል ክብር ነው።

verses.en: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
verses.fr: Lumière pour éclairer les nations, Et gloire d''Israël, ton peuple.
verses.am: ዮሴፍና እናቱም ስለ እርሱ በተባለው ነገር ይደነቁ ነበር።

verses.en: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
verses.fr: Son père et sa mère étaient dans l''admiration des choses qu''on disait de lui.
verses.am: ከአሴር ወገንም የምትሆን የፋኑኤል ልጅ ሐና የምትባል አንዲት ነቢይት ነበረች፤ እርስዋም ከድንግልናዋ ጀምራ ከባልዋ ጋር ሰባት ዓመት ኖረች፤

verses.en: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
verses.fr: Siméon les bénit, et dit à Marie, sa mère: Voici, cet enfant est destiné à amener la chute et le relèvement de plusieurs en Israël, et à devenir un signe qui provoquera la contradiction,
verses.am: ከአሴር ወገንም የምትሆን የፋኑኤል ልጅ ሐና የምትባል አንዲት ነቢይት ነበረች፤ እርስዋም ከድንግልናዋ ጀምራ ከባልዋ ጋር ሰባት ዓመት ኖረች፤

verses.en: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
verses.fr: et à toi-même une épée te transpercera l''âme, afin que les pensées de beaucoup de coeurs soient dévoilées.
verses.am: እርስዋም ሰማኒያ አራት ዓመት ያህል መበለት ሆና በጣም አርጅታ ነበር፤ በጾምና በጸሎትም ሌሊትና ቀን እያገለገለች ከመቅደስ አትለይም ነበር።

verses.en: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
verses.fr: Il y avait aussi une prophétesse, Anne, fille de Phanuel, de la tribu d''Aser. Elle était fort avancée en âge, et elle avait vécu sept ans avec son mari depuis sa virginité.
verses.am: በዚያችም ሰዓት ቀርባ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገነች፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቤዛ ለሚጠባበቁ ሁሉ ስለ እርሱ ትናገር ነበር።

verses.en: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
verses.fr: Restée veuve, et âgée de quatre vingt-quatre ans, elle ne quittait pas le temple, et elle servait Dieu nuit et jour dans le jeûne et dans la prière.
verses.am: ሁሉንም እንደ ጌታ ሕግ ከፈጸሙ በኋላ፥ ወደ ገሊላ ወደ ከተማቸው ወደ ናዝሬት ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Etant survenue, elle aussi, à cette même heure, elle louait Dieu, et elle parlait de Jésus à tous ceux qui attendaient la délivrance de Jérusalem.
verses.am: ሕፃኑም አደገ፥ ጥበብም ሞልቶበት በመንፈስ ጠነከረ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ጸጋ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ።

verses.en: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils eurent accompli tout ce qu''ordonnait la loi du Seigneur, Joseph et Marie retournèrent en Galilée, à Nazareth, leur ville.
verses.am: ወላጆቹም በያመቱ በፋሲካ በዓል ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይወጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
verses.fr: Or, l''enfant croissait et se fortifiait. Il était rempli de sagesse, et la grâce de Dieu était sur lui.
verses.am: የአሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ልጅ በሆነ ጊዜ፥ እንደ በዓሉ ሥርዓት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጡ፤

verses.en: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
verses.fr: Les parents de Jésus allaient chaque année à Jérusalem, à la fête de Pâque.
verses.am: ቀኖቹንም ከፈጸሙ በኋላ፥ ሲመለሱ ብላቴናው ኢየሱስ በኢየሩሳሌም ቀርቶ ነበር፥ ዮሴፍም እናቱም አላወቁም ነበር።

verses.en: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il fut âgé de douze ans, ils y montèrent, selon la coutume de la fête.
verses.am: ከመንገደኞች ጋር የነበረ ስለ መሰላቸው የአንድ ቀን መንገድ ሄዱ፥ ከዘመዶቻቸውም ከሚያውቋቸውም ዘንድ ፈለጉት፤

verses.en: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.
verses.fr: Puis, quand les jours furent écoulés, et qu''ils s''en retournèrent, l''enfant Jésus resta à Jérusalem. Son père et sa mère ne s''en aperçurent pas.
verses.am: ባጡትም ጊዜ እየፈለጉት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ።

verses.en: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
verses.fr: Croyant qu''il était avec leurs compagnons de voyage, ils firent une journée de chemin, et le cherchèrent parmi leurs parents et leurs connaissances.
verses.am: ከሦስት ቀንም በኋላ በመምህራን መካከል ተቀምጦ ሲሰማቸውም ሲጠይቃቸውም በመቅደስ አገኙት፤

verses.en: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
verses.fr: Mais, ne l''ayant pas trouvé, ils retournèrent à Jérusalem pour le chercher.
verses.am: የሰሙትም ሁሉ በማስተዋሉና በመልሱ ተገረሙ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
verses.fr: Au bout de trois jours, ils le trouvèrent dans le temple, assis au milieu des docteurs, les écoutant et les interrogeant.
verses.am: ባዩትም ጊዜ ተገረሙ፥ እናቱም። ልጄ ሆይ፥ ለምን እንዲህ አደረግህብን? እነሆ፥ አባትህና እኔ እየተጨነቅን ስንፈልግህ ነበርን አለችው።

verses.en: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui l''entendaient étaient frappés de son intelligence et de ses réponses.
verses.am: እርሱም። ስለ ምን ፈለጋችሁኝ? በአባቴ ቤት እሆን ዘንድ እንዲገባኝ አላወቃችሁምን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
verses.fr: Quand ses parents le virent, ils furent saisis d''étonnement, et sa mère lui dit: Mon enfant, pourquoi as-tu agi de la sorte avec nous? Voici, ton père et moi, nous te cherchions avec angoisse.
verses.am: እነርሱም የተናገራቸውን ነገር አላስተዋሉም።

verses.en: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Pourquoi me cherchiez-vous? Ne saviez-vous pas qu''il faut que je m''occupe des affaires de mon Père?
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር ወርዶ ወደ ናዝሬት መጣ፥ ይታዘዝላቸውም ነበር። እናቱም ይህን ነገር ሁሉ በልብዋ ትጠብቀው ነበር።

verses.en: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
verses.fr: Mais ils ne comprirent pas ce qu''il leur disait.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ደግሞ በጥበብና በቁመት በሞገስም በእግዚአብሔርና በሰው ፊት ያድግ ነበር።

verses.en: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
verses.fr: Puis il descendit avec eux pour aller à Nazareth, et il leur était soumis. Sa mère gardait toutes ces choses dans son coeur.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር ወርዶ ወደ ናዝሬት መጣ፥ ይታዘዝላቸውም ነበር። እናቱም ይህን ነገር ሁሉ በልብዋ ትጠብቀው ነበር።

verses.en: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
verses.fr: Et Jésus croissait en sagesse, en stature, et en grâce, devant Dieu et devant les hommes.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ደግሞ በጥበብና በቁመት በሞገስም በእግዚአብሔርና በሰው ፊት ያድግ ነበር።

verses.en: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
verses.fr: La quinzième année du règne de Tibère César, -lorsque Ponce Pilate était gouverneur de la Judée, Hérode tétrarque de la Galilée, son frère Philippe tétrarque de l''Iturée et du territoire de la Trachonite, Lysanias tétrarque de l''Abilène,
verses.am: ጢባርዮስ ቄሣርም በነገሠ በአሥራ አምስተኛይቱ ዓመት፥ ጴንጤናዊው ጲላጦስም በይሁዳ ሲገዛ፥ ሄሮድስም በገሊላ የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ፥ ወንድሙ ፊልጶስም በኢጡርያስ በጥራኮኒዶስም አገር የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ፥ ሊሳኒዮስም በሳቢላኒስ የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ ሆነው ሳሉ፥

verses.en: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
verses.fr: et du temps des souverains sacrificateurs Anne et Caïphe, -la parole de Dieu fut adressée à Jean, fils de Zacharie, dans le désert.
verses.am: ሐናና ቀያፋም ሊቃነ ካህናት ሳሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ዘካርያስ ልጅ ወደ ዮሐንስ በምድረ በዳ መጣ።

verses.en: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
verses.fr: Et il alla dans tout le pays des environs du Jourdain, prêchant le baptême de repentance, pour la rémission des péchés,

verses.en: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.fr: selon ce qui est écrit dans le livre des paroles d''Esaïe, le prophète: C''est la voix de celui qui crie dans le désert: Préparez le chemin du Seigneur, Aplanissez ses sentiers.
verses.am: በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ ቃል መጽሐፍ። የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ ጥርጊያውንም አቅኑ እያለ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮኽ ሰው ድምፅ፤ ዐዘቅቱ ሁሉ ይሙላ ተራራውና ኮረብታውም ሁሉ ዝቅ ይበል፥ ጠማማውም የቀና መንገድ ይሁን፥ ሸካራውም መንገድ ትክክል ይሁን፤ ሥጋም የለበሰ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን ይይ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ለኃጢአት ስርየት የንስሐን ጥምቀት እየሰበከ በዮርዳኖስ ዙሪያ ወዳለችው አገር ሁሉ መጣ።

verses.en: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
verses.fr: Toute vallée sera comblée, Toute montagne et toute colline seront abaissées; Ce qui est tortueux sera redressé, Et les chemins raboteux seront aplanis.
verses.am: በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ ቃል መጽሐፍ። የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ ጥርጊያውንም አቅኑ እያለ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮኽ ሰው ድምፅ፤ ዐዘቅቱ ሁሉ ይሙላ ተራራውና ኮረብታውም ሁሉ ዝቅ ይበል፥ ጠማማውም የቀና መንገድ ይሁን፥ ሸካራውም መንገድ ትክክል ይሁን፤ ሥጋም የለበሰ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን ይይ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ለኃጢአት ስርየት የንስሐን ጥምቀት እየሰበከ በዮርዳኖስ ዙሪያ ወዳለችው አገር ሁሉ መጣ።

verses.en: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
verses.fr: Et toute chair verra le salut de Dieu.
verses.am: በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ ቃል መጽሐፍ። የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ ጥርጊያውንም አቅኑ እያለ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮኽ ሰው ድምፅ፤ ዐዘቅቱ ሁሉ ይሙላ ተራራውና ኮረብታውም ሁሉ ዝቅ ይበል፥ ጠማማውም የቀና መንገድ ይሁን፥ ሸካራውም መንገድ ትክክል ይሁን፤ ሥጋም የለበሰ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን ይይ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ለኃጢአት ስርየት የንስሐን ጥምቀት እየሰበከ በዮርዳኖስ ዙሪያ ወዳለችው አገር ሁሉ መጣ።

verses.en: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.fr: Il disait donc à ceux qui venaient en foule pour être baptisés par lui: Races de vipères, qui vous a appris à fuir la colère à venir?
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከእርሱ ሊጠመቁ ለወጡት ሕዝብ እንዲህ ይላቸው ነበር። እናንተ የእፉኝት ልጆች፥ ከሚመጣው ቍጣ እንድትሸሹ ማን አመለከታችሁ?

verses.en: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.fr: Produisez donc des fruits dignes de la repentance, et ne vous mettez pas à dire en vous-mêmes: Nous avons Abraham pour père! Car je vous déclare que de ces pierres Dieu peut susciter des enfants à Abraham.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ለንስሐ የሚገባ ፍሬ አድርጉ፤ በልባችሁም። አብርሃም አባት አለን ማለትን አትጀምሩ፤ ከእነዚህ ድንጋዮች ለአብርሃም ልጆች ሊያስነሣለት እግዚአብሔር እንዲችል እላችኋለሁና።

verses.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.fr: Déjà même la cognée est mise à la racine des arbres: tout arbre donc qui ne produit pas de bons fruits sera coupé et jeté au feu.
verses.am: አሁንስ ምሳር ደግሞ በዛፎች ሥር ተቀምጦአል፤ እንግዲህ መልካም ፍሬ የማያደርግ ዛፍ ሁሉ ይቆረጣል ወደ እሳትም ይጣላል።

verses.en: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
verses.fr: La foule l''interrogeait, disant: Que devons-nous donc faire?
verses.am: ሕዝቡም። እንግዲህ ምን እናድርግ? ብለው ይጠይቁት ነበር።

verses.en: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Que celui qui a deux tuniques partage avec celui qui n''en a point, et que celui qui a de quoi manger agisse de même.
verses.am: መልሶም። ሁለት ልብስ ያለው ለሌለው ያካፍል፥ ምግብም ያለው እንዲሁ ያድርግ ይል ነበር።

verses.en: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
verses.fr: Il vint aussi des publicains pour être baptisés, et ils lui dirent: Maître, que devons-nous faire?
verses.am: ቀራጮችም ደግሞ ሊጠመቁ መጥተው። መምህር ሆይ፥ ምን እናድርግ? አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: N''exigez rien au delà de ce qui vous a été ordonné.
verses.am: ከታዘዘላችሁ አብልጣችሁ አትውሰዱ አላቸው።

verses.en: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
verses.fr: Des soldats aussi lui demandèrent: Et nous, que devons-nous faire? Il leur répondit: Ne commettez ni extorsion ni fraude envers personne, et contentez-vous de votre solde.
verses.am: ጭፍሮችም ደግሞ። እኛ ደግሞ ምን እናድርግ? ብለው ይጠይቁት ነበር። እርሱም። በማንም ግፍ አትሥሩ ማንንም በሐሰት አትክሰሱ፥ ደመወዛችሁም ይብቃችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;
verses.fr: Comme le peuple était dans l''attente, et que tous se demandaient en eux-mêmes si Jean n''était pas le Christ,
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሲጠብቁ ሳሉ ሁሉም በልባቸው ስለ ዮሐንስ። ይህ ክርስቶስ ይሆንን? ብለው ሲያስቡ ነበር፥

verses.en: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
verses.fr: il leur dit à tous: Moi, je vous baptise d''eau; mais il vient, celui qui est plus puissant que moi, et je ne suis pas digne de délier la courroie de ses souliers. Lui, il vous baptisera du Saint-Esprit et de feu.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ መልሶ። እኔስ በውኃ አጠምቃችኋለሁ፤ ነገር ግን የጫማውን ጠፍር መፍታት ከማይገባኝ ከእኔ የሚበረታ ይመጣል፤ እርሱ በመንፈስ ቅዱስና በእሳት ያጠምቃችኋል፤

verses.en: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
verses.fr: Il a son van à la main; il nettoiera son aire, et il amassera le blé dans son grenier, mais il brûlera la paille dans un feu qui ne s''éteint point.
verses.am: መንሹም በእጁ ነው፥ አውድማውንም ፈጽሞ ያጠራል፥ ስንዴውንም በጎተራው ይከታል፥ ገለባውን ግን በማይጠፋ እሳት ያቃጥለዋል አላቸው።

verses.en: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que Jean annonçait la bonne nouvelle au peuple, en lui adressant encore beaucoup d''autres exhortations.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሕዝቡን በብዙ ሌላ ምክር እየመከራቸው ወንጌልን ይሰብክላቸው ነበር፤

verses.en: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
verses.fr: Mais Hérode le tétrarque, étant repris par Jean au sujet d''Hérodias, femme de son frère, et pour toutes les mauvaises actions qu''il avait commises,
verses.am: የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ ሄሮድስ ግን፥ ስለ ሄሮድያዳ ስለ ወንድሙ ስለ ፊልጶስ ሚስትና ሄሮድስ ስላደረገው ሌላ ክፋት ሁሉ ዮሐንስ ስለ ገሠጸው፥

verses.en: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.
verses.fr: ajouta encore à toutes les autres celle d''enfermer Jean dans la prison.
verses.am: ይህን ደግሞ ከሁሉ በላይ ጨምሮ ዮሐንስን በወኅኒ አገባው።

verses.en: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
verses.fr: Tout le peuple se faisant baptiser, Jésus fut aussi baptisé; et, pendant qu''il priait, le ciel s''ouvrit,
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ከተጠመቁ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ደግሞ ተጠመቀ። ሲጸልይም ሰማይ ተከፈተ፥

verses.en: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
verses.fr: et le Saint-Esprit descendit sur lui sous une forme corporelle, comme une colombe. Et une voix fit entendre du ciel ces paroles: Tu es mon Fils bien-aimé; en toi j''ai mis toute mon affection.
verses.am: መንፈስ ቅዱስም በአካል መልክ እንደ ርግብ በእርሱ ላይ ወረደ፤ የምወድህ ልጄ አንተ ነህ፥ በአንተ ደስ ይለኛል የሚል ድምፅም ከሰማይ መጣ።

verses.en: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,
verses.fr: Jésus avait environ trente ans lorsqu''il commença son ministère, étant, comme on le croyait, fils de Joseph, fils d''Héli,
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ሊያስተምር ሲጀምር ዕድሜው ሠላሳ ዓመት ያህል ሆኖት ነበር እንደመሰላቸው የዮሴፍ ልጅ ሆኖ፥ የኤሊ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,
verses.fr: fils de Matthat, fils de Lévi, fils de Melchi, fils de Jannaï, fils de Joseph,
verses.am: የማቲ ልጅ፥ የሌዊ ልጅ፥ የሚልኪ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,
verses.fr: fils de Mattathias, fils d''Amos, fils de Nahum, fils d''Esli, fils de Naggaï,
verses.am: የዮና ልጅ፥ የዮሴፍ ልጅ፥ የማታትዩ ልጅ፥ የአሞጽ ልጅ፥ የናሆም ልጅ፥ የኤሲሊም ልጅ

verses.en: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,
verses.fr: fils de Maath, fils de Mattathias, fils de Sémeï, fils de Josech, fils de Joda,
verses.am: የናጌ ልጅ፥ የማአት ልጅ፥ የማታትዩ ልጅ የሴሜይ ልጅ፥ የዮሴፍ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,
verses.fr: fils de Joanan, fils de Rhésa, fils de Zorobabel, fils de Salathiel, fils de Néri,
verses.am: የዮዳ ልጅ፥ የዮናን ልጅ፥ የሬስ ልጅ፥ የዘሩባቤል ልጅ፥ የሰላትያል ልጅ፥ የኔሪ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,
verses.fr: fils de Melchi, fils d''Addi, fils de Kosam, fils d''Elmadam, fils D''Er,
verses.am: የሚልኪ ልጅ፥ የሐዲ ልጅ፥ የዮሳስ ልጅ፥ የቆሳም ልጅ፥ የኤልሞዳም ልጅ፥ የኤር ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,
verses.fr: fils de Jésus, fils d''Eliézer, fils de Jorim, fils de Matthat, fils de Lévi,
verses.am: የዮሴዕ ልጅ፥ የኤልዓዘር ልጅ የዮራም ልጅ፥ የማጣት ልጅ፥ የሌዊ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,
verses.fr: fils de Siméon, fils de Juda, fils de Joseph, fils de Jonam, fils d''Eliakim,
verses.am: የስምዖን ልጅ፥ የይሁዳ ልጅ፥ የዮሴፍ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,
verses.fr: fils de Méléa, fils de Menna, fils de Mattatha, fils de Nathan, fils de David,
verses.am: የዮናን ልጅ፥ የኤልያቄም ልጅ፥ የሜልያ ልጅ፥ የማይናን ልጅ፥ የማጣት ልጅ፥ የናታን ልጅ

verses.en: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,
verses.fr: fils d''Isaï, fils de Jobed, fils de Booz, fils de Salmon, fils de Naasson,
verses.am: የዳዊት ልጅ፥ የእሴይ ልጅ፥ የኢዮቤድ ልጅ፥ የቦዔዝ ልጅ፥ የሰልሞን ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,
verses.fr: fils d''Aminadab, fils d''Admin, fils d''Arni, fils d''Esrom, fils de Pharès, fils de Juda,
verses.am: የነአሶን ልጅ፥ የአሚናዳብ ልጅ፥ የአራም ልጅ፥ የአሮኒ ልጅ፥ የኤስሮም ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,
verses.fr: fils de Jacob, fils d''Isaac, fils d''Abraham, fils de Thara, fils de Nachor,
verses.am: የፋሬስ ልጅ፥ የይሁዳ ልጅ፥ የያዕቆብ ልጅ፥ የይስሐቅ ልጅ፥ የአብርሃም ልጅ፥ የታራ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,
verses.fr: fils de Seruch, fils de Ragau, fils de Phalek, fils d''Eber, fils de Sala,
verses.am: የናኮር ልጅ፥ የሴሮህ ልጅ፥ የራጋው ልጅ፥ የፋሌቅ ልጅ፥ የአቤር ልጅ፥ የሳላ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,
verses.fr: fils de Kaïnam, fils d''Arphaxad, fils de Sem, fils de Noé, fils de Lamech,
verses.am: የቃይንም ልጅ፥ የአርፋክስድ ልጅ፥ የሴም ልጅ፥ የኖኅ ልጅ፥ የላሜህ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,
verses.fr: fils de Mathusala, fils d''Enoch, fils de Jared, fils de Maléléel, fils de Kaïnan,
verses.am: የማቱሳላ ልጅ፥ የሄኖክ ልጅ፥ የያሬድ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.
verses.fr: fils d''Enos, fils de Seth, fils d''Adam, fils de Dieu.
verses.am: የመላልኤል ልጅ፥ የቃይናን ልጅ፥ የሄኖስ ልጅ፥ የሴት ልጅ፥ የአዳም ልጅ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ።

verses.en: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
verses.fr: Jésus, rempli du Saint-Esprit, revint du Jourdain, et il fut conduit par l''Esprit dans le désert,
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መንፈስ ቅዱስ መልቶበት ከዮርዳኖስ ተመለሰ፥ በመንፈስም ወደ ምድረ በዳ ተመርቶ፥

verses.en: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
verses.fr: où il fut tenté par le diable pendant quarante jours. Il ne mangea rien durant ces jours-là, et, après qu''ils furent écoulés, il eut faim.
verses.am: አርባ ቀን ከዲያብሎስ ተፈተነ። በነዚያም ቀኖች ምንም አልበላም፥ ከተጨረሱም በኋላ ተራበ።

verses.en: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.
verses.fr: Le diable lui dit: Si tu es Fils de Dieu, ordonne à cette pierre qu''elle devienne du pain.
verses.am: ዲያብሎስም። የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ከሆንህ፥ ይህን ድንጋይ። እንጀራ ሁን ብለህ እዘዝ አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Il est écrit: L''Homme ne vivra pas de pain seulement.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሁሉ እንጂ በእንጀራ ብቻ አይኖርም ተብሎ ተጽፎአል ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
verses.fr: Le diable, l''ayant élevé, lui montra en un instant tous les royaumes de la terre,
verses.am: ዲያብሎስም ረጅም ወደ ሆነ ተራራ አውጥቶ የዓለምን መንግሥታት ሁሉ በቅጽበት አሳየው።

verses.en: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
verses.fr: et lui dit: Je te donnerai toute cette puissance, et la gloire de ces royaumes; car elle m''a été donnée, et je la donne à qui je veux.
verses.am: ዲያብሎስም። ይህ ሥልጣን ሁሉ ክብራቸውም ለእኔ ተሰጥቶአል ለምወደውም ለማንም እሰጠዋለሁና ለአንተ እሰጥሃለሁ፤

verses.en: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
verses.fr: Si donc tu te prosternes devant moi, elle sera toute à toi.
verses.am: ስለዚህ አንተ በእኔ ፊት ብትሰግድ፥ ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሆናል አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Il est écrit: Tu adoreras le Seigneur, ton Dieu, et tu le serviras lui seul.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ለጌታ ለአምላክህ ስገድ እርሱንም ብቻ አምልክ ተብሎ ተጽፎአል አለው።

verses.en: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
verses.fr: Le diable le conduisit encore à Jérusalem, le plaça sur le haut du temple, et lui dit: Si tu es Fils de Dieu, jette-toi d''ici en bas;

verses.en: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
verses.fr: car il est écrit: Il donnera des ordres à ses anges à ton sujet, Afin qu''ils te gardent;
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ደግሞ ወሰደው፤ በመቅደስም ጫፍ ላይ አቁሞ። ይጠብቁህ ዘንድ መላእክቱን ስለ አንተ ያዝልሃል፥ እግርህንም በድንጋይ ከቶ እንዳትሰናከል በእጃቸው ያነሡሃል ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና የእግዚአብሔር ልጅስ ከሆንህ፥ ከዚህ ወደ ታች ራስህን ወርውር አለው።

verses.en: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.fr: et: Ils te porteront sur les mains, De peur que ton pied ne heurte contre une pierre.
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ደግሞ ወሰደው፤ በመቅደስም ጫፍ ላይ አቁሞ። ይጠብቁህ ዘንድ መላእክቱን ስለ አንተ ያዝልሃል፥ እግርህንም በድንጋይ ከቶ እንዳትሰናከል በእጃቸው ያነሡሃል ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና የእግዚአብሔር ልጅስ ከሆንህ፥ ከዚህ ወደ ታች ራስህን ወርውር አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Il est dit: Tu ne tenteras point le Seigneur, ton Dieu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ጌታን አምላክህን አትፈታተነው ተብሎአል አለው።

verses.en: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
verses.fr: Après l''avoir tenté de toutes ces manières, le diable s''éloigna de lui jusqu''à un moment favorable.
verses.am: ዲያቢሎስም ፈተናውን ሁሉ ከጨረሰ በኋላ እስከ ጊዜው ከእርሱ ተለየ።

verses.en: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
verses.fr: Jésus, revêtu de la puissance de l''Esprit, retourna en Galilée, et sa renommée se répandit dans tout le pays d''alentour.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በመንፈስ ኃይል ወደ ገሊላ ተመለሰ፤ ስለ እርሱም በዙሪያው ባለችው አገር ሁሉ ዝና ወጣ።

verses.en: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
verses.fr: Il enseignait dans les synagogues, et il était glorifié par tous.
verses.am: እርሱም በምኵራባቸው ያስተምር፥ ሁሉም ያመሰግኑት ነበር።

verses.en: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
verses.fr: Il se rendit à Nazareth, où il avait été élevé, et, selon sa coutume, il entra dans la synagogue le jour du sabbat. Il se leva pour faire la lecture,
verses.am: ወዳደገበትም ወደ ናዝሬት መጣ፤ እንደ ልማዱም በሰንበት ቀን ወደ ምኵራብ ገባ፥ ሊያነብም ተነሣ።

verses.en: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
verses.fr: et on lui remit le livre du prophète Esaïe. L''ayant déroulé, il trouva l''endroit où il était écrit:

verses.en: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
verses.fr: L''Esprit du Seigneur est sur moi, Parce qu''il m''a oint pour annoncer une bonne nouvelle aux pauvres; Il m''a envoyé pour guérir ceux qui ont le coeur brisé, Pour proclamer aux captifs la délivrance, Et aux aveugles le recouvrement de la vue, Pour renvoyer libres les opprimés,
verses.am: የነቢዩንም የኢሳይያስን መጽሐፍ ሰጡት፥ መጽሐፉንም በተረተረ ጊዜ። የጌታ መንፈስ በእኔ ላይ ነው፥ ለድሆች ወንጌልን እሰብክ ዘንድ ቀብቶኛልና፤ ለታሰሩትም መፈታትን ለዕውሮችም ማየትን እሰብክ ዘንድ፥ የተጠቁትንም ነጻ አወጣ ዘንድ የተወደደችውንም የጌታን ዓመት እሰብክ ዘንድ ልኮኛል ተብሎ የተጻፈበትን ስፍራ አገኘ።

verses.en: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
verses.fr: Pour publier une année de grâce du Seigneur.
verses.am: የነቢዩንም የኢሳይያስን መጽሐፍ ሰጡት፥ መጽሐፉንም በተረተረ ጊዜ። የጌታ መንፈስ በእኔ ላይ ነው፥ ለድሆች ወንጌልን እሰብክ ዘንድ ቀብቶኛልና፤ ለታሰሩትም መፈታትን ለዕውሮችም ማየትን እሰብክ ዘንድ፥ የተጠቁትንም ነጻ አወጣ ዘንድ የተወደደችውንም የጌታን ዓመት እሰብክ ዘንድ ልኮኛል ተብሎ የተጻፈበትን ስፍራ አገኘ።

verses.en: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
verses.fr: Ensuite, il roula le livre, le remit au serviteur, et s''assit. Tous ceux qui se trouvaient dans la synagogue avaient les regards fixés sur lui.
verses.am: መጽሐፉንም ጠቅልሎ ለአገልጋዩ ሰጠውና ተቀመጠ፤ በምኵራብም የነበሩት ሁሉ ትኵር ብለው ይመለከቱት ነበር።

verses.en: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
verses.fr: Alors il commença à leur dire: Aujourd''hui cette parole de l''Ecriture, que vous venez d''entendre, est accomplie.
verses.am: እርሱም። ዛሬ ይህ መጽሐፍ በጆሮአችሁ ተፈጸመ ይላቸው ጀመር።

verses.en: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?
verses.fr: Et tous lui rendaient témoignage; ils étaient étonnés des paroles de grâce qui sortaient de sa bouche, et ils disaient: N''est-ce pas le fils de Joseph?
verses.am: ሁሉም ይመሰክሩለት ነበር ከአፉም ከሚወጣው ከጸጋው ቃል የተነሣ እየተደነቁ። ይህ የዮሴፍ ልጅ አይደለምን? ይሉ ነበር።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Sans doute vous m''appliquerez ce proverbe: Médecin, guéris-toi toi-même; et vous me direz: Fais ici, dans ta patrie, tout ce que nous avons appris que tu as fait à Capernaüm.
verses.am: እርሱም። ያለ ጥርጥር ይህን ምሳሌ። ባለ መድኃኒት ሆይ፥ ራስህን ፈውስ፤ በቅፍርናሆም እንዳደረግኸው የሰማነውን ሁሉ በዚህ በገዛ አገርህ ደግሞ አድርግ ትሉኛላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
verses.fr: Mais, ajouta-t-il, je vous le dis en vérité, aucun prophète n''est bien reçu dans sa patrie.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ነቢይ በገዛ አገሩ ከቶ አይወደድም።

verses.en: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité: il y avait plusieurs veuves en Israël du temps d''Elie, lorsque le ciel fut fermé trois ans et six mois et qu''il y eut une grande famine sur toute la terre;
verses.am: ነገር ግን እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በኤልያስ ዘመን ሦስት ዓመት ከስድስት ወር ሰማይ ተዘግቶ ሳለ በምድር ሁሉ ብርቱ ራብ በነበረ ጊዜ፥ በእስራኤል ብዙ መበለቶች ነበሩ፤

verses.en: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
verses.fr: et cependant Elie ne fut envoyé vers aucune d''elles, si ce n''est vers une femme veuve, à Sarepta, dans le pays de Sidon.
verses.am: ኤልያስም በሲዶና አገር ወዳለች ወደ ሰራፕታ ወደ አንዲት መበለት እንጂ ከእነርሱ ወደ አንዲቱ አልተላከም።

verses.en: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.
verses.fr: Il y avait aussi plusieurs lépreux en Israël du temps d''Elisée, le prophète; et cependant aucun d''eux ne fut purifié, si ce n''est Naaman le Syrien.
verses.am: በነቢዩ በኤልሳዕ ዘመንም በእስራኤል ብዙ ለምጻሞች ነበሩ፥ ከሶርያዊው ከንዕማን በቀር ከእነርሱ አንድ ስንኳ አልነጻም።

verses.en: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
verses.fr: Ils furent tous remplis de colère dans la synagogue, lorsqu''ils entendirent ces choses.
verses.am: በምኵራብም የነበሩ ሁሉ ይህን ሰምተው ቍጣ ሞላባቸው፥ ተነሥተውም ከከተማ ወደ ውጭ አወጡት፥

verses.en: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
verses.fr: Et s''étant levés, ils le chassèrent de la ville, et le menèrent jusqu''au sommet de la montagne sur laquelle leur ville était bâtie, afin de le précipiter en bas.
verses.am: ይጥሉትም ዘንድ ከተማቸው ተሠርታባት ወደ ነበረች ወደ ተራራው አፋፍ ወሰዱት፤

verses.en: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
verses.fr: Mais Jésus, passant au milieu d''eux, s''en alla.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን በመካከላቸው አልፎ ሄደ።

verses.en: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
verses.fr: Il descendit à Capernaüm, ville de la Galilée; et il enseignait, le jour du sabbat.
verses.am: ወደ ገሊላ ከተማም ወደ ቅፍርናሆም ወረደ። በሰንበትም ያስተምራቸው ነበር፤

verses.en: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
verses.fr: On était frappé de sa doctrine; car il parlait avec autorité.
verses.am: ቃሉ በሥልጣን ነበርና በትምህርቱ ተገረሙ።

verses.en: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
verses.fr: Il se trouva dans la synagogue un homme qui avait un esprit de démon impur, et qui s''écria d''une voix forte:
verses.am: በምኵራብም የርኵስ ጋኔን መንፈስ ያደረበት ሰው ነበረ፥ በታላቅ ድምፅም ጮኾ።

verses.en: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.
verses.fr: Ah! qu''y a-t-il entre nous et toi, Jésus de Nazareth? Tu es venu pour nous perdre. Je sais qui tu es: le Saint de Dieu.
verses.am: ተው፥ የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለን? ልታጠፋን መጣህን? ማን እንደ ሆንህ አውቄሃለሁ፥ አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ቅዱሱ አለ።

verses.en: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
verses.fr: Jésus le menaça, disant: Tais-toi, et sors de cet homme. Et le démon le jeta au milieu de l''assemblée, et sortit de lui, sans lui faire aucun mal.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ዝም በል ከእርሱም ውጣ ብሎ ገሠጸው። ጋኔኑም በመካከላቸው ጥሎት ሳይጐዳው ከእርሱ ወጣ።

verses.en: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
verses.fr: Tous furent saisis de stupeur, et ils se disaient les uns aux autres: Quelle est cette parole? il commande avec autorité et puissance aux esprits impurs, et ils sortent!
verses.am: ሁሉንም መደነቅ ያዛቸው፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም። ይህ ቃል ምንድር ነው? በሥልጣንና በኃይል ርኵሳን መናፍስትን ያዝዛልና፥ ይወጡማል ብለው ተነጋገሩ።

verses.en: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
verses.fr: Et sa renommée se répandit dans tous les lieux d''alentour.
verses.am: ዝናም በዙሪያው ባለች አገር ወደ ስፍራው ሁሉ ስለ እርሱ ወጣ።

verses.en: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
verses.fr: En sortant de la synagogue, il se rendit à la maison de Simon. La belle-mère de Simon avait une violente fièvre, et ils le prièrent en sa faveur.
verses.am: በምኵራብም ተነሥቶ ወደ ስምዖን ቤት ገባ። የስምዖንም አማት በብርቱ ንዳድ ታማ ነበር ስለ እርስዋም ለመኑት።

verses.en: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
verses.fr: S''étant penché sur elle, il menaça la fièvre, et la fièvre la quitta. A l''instant elle se leva, et les servit.
verses.am: በአጠገብዋም ቆሞ ንዳዱን ገሠጸውና ለቀቃት፤ ያንጊዜውንም ተነሥታ አገለገለቻቸው።

verses.en: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
verses.fr: Après le coucher du soleil, tous ceux qui avaient des malades atteints de diverses maladies les lui amenèrent. Il imposa les mains à chacun d''eux, et il les guérit.
verses.am: ፀሐይም በገባ ጊዜ በልዩ ልዩ ደዌ የተያዙ በሽተኞችን ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ አመጡአቸው፤ እርሱም በእያንዳቸው ላይ እጁን ጭኖ ፈወሳቸው።

verses.en: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
verses.fr: Des démons aussi sortirent de beaucoup de personnes, en criant et en disant: Tu es le Fils de Dieu. Mais il les menaçait et ne leur permettait pas de parler, parce qu''ils savaient qu''il était le Christ.
verses.am: አጋንንትም ደግሞ። አንተ ክርስቶስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህ እያሉ እየጮኹም ከብዙዎች ይወጡ ነበር፤ ገሠጻቸውም ክርስቶስም እንደ ሆነ አውቀውት ነበርና እንዲናገሩ አልፈቀደላቸውም።

verses.en: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
verses.fr: Dès que le jour parut, il sortit et alla dans un lieu désert. Une foule de gens se mirent à sa recherche, et arrivèrent jusqu''à lui; ils voulaient le retenir, afin qu''il ne les quittât point.
verses.am: በጸባም ጊዜ ወጥቶ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሄደ፤ ሕዝቡም ይፈልጉት ነበር፤ ወደ እርሱም መጡ፥ ከእነርሱም ተለይቶ እንዳይሄድ ሊከለክሉት ወደዱ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
verses.fr: Mais il leur dit: Il faut aussi que j''annonce aux autres villes la bonne nouvelle du royaume de Dieu; car c''est pour cela que j''ai été envoyé.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። ስለዚህ ተልኬአለሁና ለሌሎቹ ከተማዎች ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ወንጌል እሰብክ ዘንድ ይገባኛል አላቸው።

verses.en: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
verses.fr: Et il prêchait dans les synagogues de la Galilée.
verses.am: በገሊላም ምኵራቦች ይሰብክ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
verses.fr: Comme Jésus se trouvait auprès du lac de Génésareth, et que la foule se pressait autour de lui pour entendre la parole de Dieu,
verses.am: ሕዝቡም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እየሰሙ ሲያስጠብቡት ሳሉ፥ እርሱ ራሱ በጌንሳሬጥ ባሕር ዳር ቆሞ ነበር፤

verses.en: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
verses.fr: il vit au bord du lac deux barques, d''où les pêcheurs étaient descendus pour laver leurs filets.
verses.am: በባሕር ዳርም ቆመው የነበሩትን ሁለት ታንኳዎች አየ፤ ዓሣ አጥማጆች ግን ከእነርሱ ውስጥ ወጥተው መረቦቻቸውን ያጥቡ ነበር።

verses.en: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
verses.fr: Il monta dans l''une de ces barques, qui était à Simon, et il le pria de s''éloigner un peu de terre. Puis il s''assit, et de la barque il enseignait la foule.
verses.am: ከታንኳዎቹም የስምዖን ወደ ነበረች ወደ አንዲቱ ገብቶ ከምድር ጥቂት ፈቀቅ እንዲያደርጋት ለመነው፤ በታንኳይቱም ተቀምጦ ሕዝቡን ያስተምር ነበር።

verses.en: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il eut cessé de parler, il dit à Simon: Avance en pleine eau, et jetez vos filets pour pêcher.
verses.am: ነገሩንም ከጨረሰ በኋላ፥ ስምዖንን። ወደ ጥልቁ ፈቀቅ በል መረቦቻችሁንም ለማጥመድ ጣሉ አለው።

verses.en: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
verses.fr: Simon lui répondit: Maître, nous avons travaillé toute la nuit sans rien prendre; mais, sur ta parole, je jetterai le filet.
verses.am: ስምዖንም መልሶ። አቤቱ፥ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ አድረን ስንደክም ምንም አልያዝንም፤ ነገር ግን በቃልህ መረቦቹን እጥላለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
verses.fr: L''ayant jeté, ils prirent une grande quantité de poissons, et leur filet se rompait.
verses.am: ይህንም ባደረጉ ጊዜ እጅግ ብዙ ዓሣ ያዙ፤ መረቦቻቸውም ተቀደዱ።

verses.en: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.
verses.fr: Ils firent signe à leurs compagnons qui étaient dans l''autre barque de venir les aider. Ils vinrent et ils remplirent les deux barques, au point qu''elles enfonçaient.
verses.am: በሌላ ታንኳም የነበሩትን ጓደኞቻቸውን መጥተው እንዲያግዙአቸው ጠቀሱ፤ መጥተውም ሁለቱ ታንኳዎች እስኪሰጥሙ ድረስ ሞሉአቸው።

verses.en: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
verses.fr: Quand il vit cela, Simon Pierre tomba aux genoux de Jésus, et dit: Seigneur, retire-toi de moi, parce que je suis un homme pécheur.
verses.am: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስ ግን ባየ ጊዜ በኢየሱስ ጕልበት ላይ ወድቆ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እኔ ኃጢአተኛ ነኝና ከኔ ተለይ አለው።

verses.en: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
verses.fr: Car l''épouvante l''avait saisi, lui et tous ceux qui étaient avec lui, à cause de la pêche qu''ils avaient faite.
verses.am: ስላጠመዱት ዓሣ እርሱ ከእርሱ ጋርም የነበሩ ሁሉ ተደንቀዋልና፥

verses.en: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
verses.fr: Il en était de même de Jacques et de Jean, fils de Zébédée, les associés de Simon. Alors Jésus dit à Simon: Ne crains point; désormais tu seras pêcheur d''hommes.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ደግሞ የስምዖን ባልንጀሮች የነበሩ የዘብዴዎስ ልጆች ያዕቆብና ዮሐንስም ተደነቁ። ኢየሱስም ስምዖንን። አትፍራ፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ሰውን የምታጠምድ ትሆናለህ አለው።

verses.en: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
verses.fr: Et, ayant ramené les barques à terre, ils laissèrent tout, et le suivirent.
verses.am: ታንኳዎችንም ወደ ምድር አድርሰው ሁሉን ትተው ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.fr: Jésus était dans une des villes; et voici, un homme couvert de lèpre, l''ayant vu, tomba sur sa face, et lui fit cette prière: Seigneur, si tu le veux, tu peux me rendre pur.
verses.am: ከከተማዎችም በአንዲቱ ሳለ፥ እነሆ፥ ለምጽ የሞላበት ሰው ነበረ፤ ኢየሱስንም አይቶ በፊቱ ወደቀና። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ብትወድስ፥ ልታነጻኝ ትችላለህ ብሎ ለመነው።

verses.en: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
verses.fr: Jésus étendit la main, le toucha, et dit: Je le veux, sois pur. Aussitôt la lèpre le quitta.
verses.am: እጁንም ዘርግቶ ዳሰሰውና። እወዳለሁ፥ ንጻ አለው፤ ወዲያውም ለምጹ ለቀቀው።

verses.en: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.fr: Puis il lui ordonna de n''en parler à personne. Mais, dit-il, va te montrer au sacrificateur, et offre pour ta purification ce que Moïse a prescrit, afin que cela leur serve de témoignage.
verses.am: እርሱም ለማንም እንዳይናገር አዘዘው፥ ነገር ግን። ሄደህ ራስህን ለካህን አሳይ፥ ለእነርሱም ምስክር እንዲሆን ስለ መንጻትህ ሙሴ እንዳዘዘ መሥዋዕት አቅርብ አለው።

verses.en: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
verses.fr: Sa renommée se répandait de plus en plus, et les gens venaient en foule pour l''entendre et pour être guéris de leurs maladies.
verses.am: ወሬው ግን አብዝቶ ወጣ፥ ብዙ ሕዝብም ሊሰሙትና ከደዌአቸው ሊፈወሱ ይሰበሰቡ ነበር፤

verses.en: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
verses.fr: Et lui, il se retirait dans les déserts, et priait.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እርሱ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ፈቀቅ ብሎ ይጸልይ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
verses.fr: Un jour Jésus enseignait. Des pharisiens et des docteurs de la loi étaient là assis, venus de tous les villages de la Galilée, de la Judée et de Jérusalem; et la puissance du Seigneur se manifestait par des guérisons.
verses.am: አንድ ቀንም ያስተምር ነበር፤ ከገሊላና ከይሁዳ መንደሮችም ሁሉ ከኢየሩሳሌምም መጥተው የነበሩ ፈሪሳውያንና የሕግ መምህራን ይቀመጡ ነበር፤ እርሱም እንዲፈውስ የጌታ ኃይል ሆነለት።

verses.en: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
verses.fr: Et voici, des gens, portant sur un lit un homme qui était paralytique, cherchaient à le faire entrer et à le placer sous ses regards.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ አንድ ሽባ በአልጋ ተሸክመው አመጡ፤ አግብተውም በፊቱ ሊያኖሩት ይሹ ነበር።

verses.en: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
verses.fr: Comme ils ne savaient par où l''introduire, à cause de la foule, ils montèrent sur le toit, et ils le descendirent par une ouverture, avec son lit, au milieu de l''assemblée, devant Jésus.
verses.am: ስለ ሕዝቡም ብዛት እንዴት አድርገው እንዲያገቡት ሲያቅታቸው፥ ወደ ሰገነቱ ወጡ የጣራውንም ጡብ አሳልፈው በመካከል በኢየሱስ ፊት ከነአልጋው አወረዱት።

verses.en: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
verses.fr: Voyant leur foi, Jésus dit: Homme, tes péchés te sont pardonnés.
verses.am: እምነታቸውንም አይቶ። አንተ ሰው፥ ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ አለው።

verses.en: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
verses.fr: Les scribes et les pharisiens se mirent à raisonner et à dire: Qui est celui-ci, qui profère des blasphèmes? Qui peut pardonner les péchés, si ce n''est Dieu seul?
verses.am: ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያንም። ይህ የሚሳደብ ማን ነው? ከአንዱ ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ኃጢአት ሊያስተሰርይ ማን ይችላል? ብለው ያስቡ ጀመር።

verses.en: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?
verses.fr: Jésus, connaissant leurs pensées, prit la parole et leur dit: Quelles pensées avez-vous dans vos coeurs?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አሳባቸውን እያወቀ መልሶ። በልባችሁ ምን ታስባላችሁ?

verses.en: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?
verses.fr: Lequel est le plus aisé, de dire: Tes péchés te sont pardonnés, ou de dire: Lève-toi, et marche?
verses.am: ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ ከማለት ወይስ። ተነሣና ሂድ ከማለት ማናቸው ይቀላል?

verses.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.
verses.fr: Or, afin que vous sachiez que le Fils de l''homme a sur la terre le pouvoir de pardonner les péchés: Je te l''ordonne, dit-il au paralytique, lève-toi, prends ton lit, et va dans ta maison.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በምድር ላይ ኃጢአት ሊያስተሰርይ ለሰው ልጅ ሥልጣን እንዳለው እንድታውቁ ብሎ፥ ሽባውን። አንተን እልሃለሁ፥ ነተሣ፥ አልጋህን ተሸክመህ ወደ ቤትህ ሂድ አለው።

verses.en: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
verses.fr: Et, à l''instant, il se leva en leur présence, prit le lit sur lequel il était couché, et s''en alla dans sa maison, glorifiant Dieu.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም በፊታቸው ተነሣ፥ ተኝቶበትም የነበረውን ተሸክሞ እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገነ ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.en: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
verses.fr: Tous étaient dans l''étonnement, et glorifiaient Dieu; remplis de crainte, ils disaient: Nous avons vu aujourd''hui des choses étranges.
verses.am: ሁሉንም መገረም ያዛቸው፥ እግዚአብሔርንም አመስግነው። ዛሬስ ድንቅ ነገር አየን እያሉ ፍርሃት ሞላባቸው።

verses.en: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
verses.fr: Après cela, Jésus sortit, et il vit un publicain, nommé Lévi, assis au lieu des péages. Il lui dit: Suis-moi.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ወጥቶ ሌዊ የሚባል ቀራጭ በመቅረጫው ተቀምጦ ተመለከተና። ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.en: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
verses.fr: Et, laissant tout, il se leva, et le suivit.
verses.am: ሁሉንም ተወ፤ ተነሥቶም ተከተለው።

verses.en: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
verses.fr: Lévi lui donna un grand festin dans sa maison, et beaucoup de publicains et d''autres personnes étaient à table avec eux.
verses.am: ሌዊም በቤቱ ታላቅ ግብዣ አደረገለት፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር በማዕድ ተቀምጠው የነበሩ ከቀራጮችና ከሌሎች ሰዎች ብዙ ሕዝብ ነበሩ።

verses.en: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
verses.fr: Les pharisiens et les scribes murmurèrent, et dirent à ses disciples: Pourquoi mangez-vous et buvez-vous avec les publicains et les gens de mauvaise vie?
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንና ጻፎቻቸውም በደቀ መዛሙርቱ ላይ። ስለ ምን ከቀራጮችና ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር ትበላላችሁ ትጠጡማላችሁ? ብለው አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
verses.fr: Jésus, prenant la parole, leur dit: Ce ne sont pas ceux qui se portent bien qui ont besoin de médecin, mais les malades.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ሕመምተኞች እንጂ ባለ ጤናዎች ባለ መድኃኒት አያስፈልጋቸውም፤

verses.en: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.fr: Je ne suis pas venu appeler à la repentance des justes, mais des pécheurs.
