verses.am: ኃጢአተኞችን ወደ ንስሐ እንጂ ጻድቃንን ልጠራ አልመጣሁም አላቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: Les disciples de Jean, comme ceux des pharisiens, jeûnent fréquemment et font des prières, tandis que les tiens mangent et boivent.
verses.am: እነርሱም። የዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርት ስለ ምን ብዙ ይጦማሉ ጸሎትስ ስለ ምን ያደርጋሉ፥ ደግሞም የፈሪሳውያን ደቀ መዛሙርት ስለ ምን እንደዚሁ ያደርጋሉ፤ የአንተ ደቀ መዛሙርት ግን ይበላሉ ይጠጣሉም? አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Pouvez-vous faire jeûner les amis de l''époux pendant que l''époux est avec eux?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ሙሽራው ከእነርሱ ጋር ሳለ ሚዜዎችን ልታስጦሙ ትችላላችሁን?

verses.en: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
verses.fr: Les jours viendront où l''époux leur sera enlevé, alors ils jeûneront en ces jours-là.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ወራት ይመጣል፥ ሙሽራውም ከእነርሱ ሲወሰድ ያንጊዜ፥ በዚያ ወራት ይጦማሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.
verses.fr: Il leur dit aussi une parabole: Personne ne déchire d''un habit neuf un morceau pour le mettre à un vieil habit; car, il déchire l''habit neuf, et le morceau qu''il en a pris n''est pas assorti au vieux.
verses.am: ደግሞም ምሳሌ እንዲህ ሲል ነገራቸው። የአዲስ ልብስ እራፊ ባረጀ ልብስ ላይ የሚያኖር የለም፤ ቢደረግ ግን አዲሱን ይቀደዋል ደግሞም አዲስ እራፊ ለአሮጌው አይስማማውም።

verses.en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.
verses.fr: Et personne ne met du vin nouveau dans de vieilles outres; autrement, le vin nouveau fait rompre les outres, il se répand, et les outres sont perdues;
verses.am: ባረጀ አቁማዳም አዲስ የወይን ጠጅ የሚያኖር የለም፤ ቢደረግ ግን አዲሱ የወይን ጠጅ አቁማዳውን ያፈነዳል፥ እርሱም ይፈሳል አቁማዳውም ይጠፋል።

verses.en: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
verses.fr: mais il faut mettre le vin nouveau dans des outres neuves.
verses.am: አዲሱን የወይን ጠጅ ግን በአዲስ አቁማዳ ማኖር ይገባል፥ ሁለቱም ይጠባበቃሉ።

verses.en: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.
verses.fr: Et personne, après avoir bu du vin vieux, ne veut du nouveau, car il dit: Le vieux est bon.
verses.am: አሮጌ የወይን ጠጅ ሲጠጣ አዲሱን የሚሻ ማንም የለም፤ አሮጌው ይጣፍጣል ይላልና።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
verses.fr: Il arriva, un jour de sabbat appelé second-premier, que Jésus traversait des champs de blé. Ses disciples arrachaient des épis et les mangeaient, après les avoir froissés dans leurs mains.
verses.am: በሰንበትም በእርሻ መካከል ያልፍ ነበር ደቀ መዛሙርቱም እሸት ይቀጥፉ በእጃቸውም እያሹ ይበሉ ነበር።

verses.en: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
verses.fr: Quelques pharisiens leur dirent: Pourquoi faites-vous ce qu''il n''est pas permis de faire pendant le sabbat?
verses.am: ከፈሪሳውያን ግን አንዳንዶቹ። በሰንበት ሊያደርግ ያልተፈቀደውን ስለ ምን ታደርጋላችሁ? አሉአቸው።

verses.en: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: N''avez-vous pas lu ce que fit David, lorsqu''il eut faim, lui et ceux qui étaient avec lui;

verses.en: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
verses.fr: comment il entra dans la maison de Dieu, prit les pains de proposition, en mangea, et en donna à ceux qui étaient avec lui, bien qu''il ne soit permis qu''aux sacrificateurs de les manger?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ለእነርሱ መልሶ። ዳዊት በተራበ ጊዜ እርሱ አብረውት ከነበሩ ጋር ያደረገውን፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደ ገባ ከካህናት ብቻ በቀር መብላቱ ያልተፈቀደውን የመሥዋዕትን እንጀራ ይዞ እንደ በላ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ለነበሩት ደግሞ እንደ ሰጣቸው ይህን አላነበባችሁምን? አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
verses.fr: Et il leur dit: Le Fils de l''homme est maître même du sabbat.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ የሰንበት ጌታ ነው አላቸውም።

verses.en: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
verses.fr: Il arriva, un autre jour de sabbat, que Jésus entra dans la synagogue, et qu''il enseignait. Il s''y trouvait un homme dont la main droite était sèche.
verses.am: በሌላው ሰንበትም ወደ ምኵራብ ገብቶ አስተማረ፤ በዚያም ቀኝ እጁ የሰለለች ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.en: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
verses.fr: Les scribes et les pharisiens observaient Jésus, pour voir s''il ferait une guérison le jour du sabbat: c''était afin d''avoir sujet de l''accuser.
verses.am: ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያንም መክሰሻ ሊያገኙበት በሰንበት ይፈውስ እንደ ሆነ ይጠባበቁት ነበር።

verses.en: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
verses.fr: Mais il connaissait leurs pensées, et il dit à l''homme qui avait la main sèche: Lève-toi, et tiens-toi là au milieu. Il se leva, et se tint debout.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን አሳባቸውን አውቆ እጁ የሰለለችውን ሰው። ተነሣና በመካከል ቁም አለው፤ ተነሥቶም ቆመ።

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
verses.fr: Et Jésus leur dit: Je vous demande s''il est permis, le jour du sabbat, de faire du bien ou de faire du mal, de sauver une personne ou de la tuer.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እጠይቃችኋለሁ፤ በሰንበት በጎ ማድረግ ተፈቅዶአልን ወይስ ክፉ? ነፍስ ማዳንን ወይስ መግደል? አላቸው።

verses.en: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
verses.fr: Alors, promenant ses regards sur eux tous, il dit à l''homme: Etends ta main. Il le fit, et sa main fut guérie.
verses.am: ሁላቸውንም ዙሪያውን አየና ሰውዬውን። እጅህን ዘርጋ አለው። እርሱም እንዲህ አደረገ፥ እጁም እንደ ሁለተኛይቱ ዳነች።

verses.en: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
verses.fr: Ils furent remplis de fureur, et ils se consultèrent pour savoir ce qu''ils feraient à Jésus.
verses.am: እነርሱም ቍጣ ሞላባቸው፥ በኢየሱስም ምን እንዲያደርጉበት እርስ በርሳቸው ተባባሉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, Jésus se rendit sur la montagne pour prier, et il passa toute la nuit à prier Dieu.
verses.am: በነዚህም ወራት ይጸልይ ዘንድ ወደ ተራራ ወጣ፥ ሌሊቱንም ሁሉ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሲጸልይ አደረ።

verses.en: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
verses.fr: Quand le jour parut, il appela ses disciples, et il en choisit douze, auxquels il donna le nom d''apôtres:
verses.am: በነጋም ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ጠራ፥ ከእነርሱም አሥራ ሁለት መረጠ ደግሞም ሐዋርያት ብሎ ሰየማቸው፤

verses.en: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
verses.fr: Simon, qu''il nomma Pierre; André, son frère; Jacques; Jean; Philippe; Barthélemy;
verses.am: እነርሱም፥ ጴጥሮስ ብሎ እንደ ገና የሰየመው ስምዖን፥ ወንድሙም እንድርያስ፥ ያዕቆብም ዮሐንስም፥ ፊልጶስም በርተሎሜዎስም፥

verses.en: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,
verses.fr: Matthieu; Thomas; Jacques, fils d''Alphée; Simon, appelé le zélote;
verses.am: ማቴዎስም ቶማስም፥ የእልፍዮስ ልጅ ያዕቆብም ቀናተኛ የሚባለው ስምዖንም፥

verses.en: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
verses.fr: Jude, fils de Jacques; et Judas Iscariot, qui devint traître.
verses.am: የያዕቆብ ይሁዳም፥ አሳልፎ የሰጠውም የአስቆሮቱ ይሁዳ ናቸው።

verses.en: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
verses.fr: Il descendit avec eux, et s''arrêta sur un plateau, où se trouvaient une foule de ses disciples et une multitude de peuple de toute la Judée, de Jérusalem, et de la contrée maritime de Tyr et de Sidon. Ils étaient venus pour l''entendre, et pour être guéris de leurs maladies.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር ወርዶ በተካከለ ስፍራ ቆመ፥ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወገን ብዙ ሕዝብ ነበረ፥ ደግሞም ሊሰሙትና ከደዌአቸው ሊፈወሱ ከይሁዳ ሁሉ ከኢየሩሳሌምም ከጢሮስና ከሲዶና ባሕር ዳርም የመጡ ብዙ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
verses.fr: Ceux qui étaient tourmentés par des esprits impurs étaient guéris.
verses.am: ከርኵሳንም መናፍስት ይሠቃዩ የነበሩት ተፈወሱ፤

verses.en: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
verses.fr: Et toute la foule cherchait à le toucher, parce qu''une force sortait de lui et les guérissait tous.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ኃይል ወጥቶ ሁሉን ይፈውስ ነበርና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሊዳስሱት ይሹ ነበር።

verses.en: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: Alors Jésus, levant les yeux sur ses disciples, dit: Heureux vous qui êtes pauvres, car le royaume de Dieu est à vous!
verses.am: እርሱም ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ዓይኑን አነሣ እንዲህም አላቸው። እናንተ ድሆች ብፁዓን ናችሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት የእናንተ ነውና።

verses.en: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
verses.fr: Heureux vous qui avez faim maintenant, car vous serez rassasiés! Heureux vous qui pleurez maintenant, car vous serez dans la joie!
verses.am: እናንተ አሁን የምትራቡ ብፁዓን ናችሁ፥ ትጠግባላችሁና። እናንተ አሁን የምታለቅሱ ብፁዓን ናችሁ፥ ትስቃላችሁና።

verses.en: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.
verses.fr: Heureux serez-vous, lorsque les hommes vous haïront, lorsqu''on vous chassera, vous outragera, et qu''on rejettera votre nom comme infâme, à cause du Fils de l''homme!
verses.am: ሰዎች ስለ ሰው ልጅ ሲጠሉአችሁ ሲለዩአችሁም ሲነቅፉአችሁም ስማችሁንም እንደ ክፉ ሲያወጡ፥ ብፁዓን ናችሁ።

verses.en: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
verses.fr: Réjouissez-vous en ce jour-là et tressaillez d''allégresse, parce que votre récompense sera grande dans le ciel; car c''est ainsi que leurs pères traitaient les prophètes.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ዋጋችሁ በሰማይ ታላቅ ነውና በዚያን ቀን ደስ ይበላችሁ ዝለሉም፤ አባቶቻቸው ነቢያትን እንዲህ ያደርጉባቸው ነበርና።

verses.en: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
verses.fr: Mais, malheur à vous, riches, car vous avez votre consolation!
verses.am: ነገር ግን እናንተ ባለ ጠጎች ወዮላችሁ፥ መጽናናታችሁን ተቀብላችኋልና።

verses.en: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
verses.fr: Malheur à vous qui êtes rassasiés, car vous aurez faim! Malheur à vous qui riez maintenant, car vous serez dans le deuil et dans les larmes!
verses.am: እናንተ አሁን የጠገባችሁ ወዮላችሁ፥ ትራባላችሁና። እናንተ አሁን የምትስቁ ወዮላችሁ፥ ታዝናላችሁና ታለቅሱማላችሁ።

verses.en: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
verses.fr: Malheur, lorsque tous les hommes diront du bien de vous, car c''est ainsi qu''agissaient leurs pères à l''égard des faux prophètes!
verses.am: ሰዎች ሁሉ መልካም ሲናገሩላችሁ፥ ወዮላችሁ፤ አባቶቻቸው ለሐሰተኞች ነቢያት እንዲሁ ያደርጉላቸው ነበርና።

verses.en: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
verses.fr: Mais je vous dis, à vous qui m''écoutez: Aimez vos ennemis, faites du bien à ceux qui vous haïssent,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለእናንተ ለምትሰሙ እላችኋለሁ፥ ጠላቶቻችሁን ውደዱ፥ ለሚጠሉአችሁ መልካም አድርጉ፥

verses.en: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
verses.fr: bénissez ceux qui vous maudissent, priez pour ceux qui vous maltraitent.
verses.am: የሚረግሙአችሁንም መርቁ፥ ስለሚበድሉአችሁም ጸልዩ።

verses.en: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloak forbid not to take thy coat also.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un te frappe sur une joue, présente-lui aussi l''autre. Si quelqu''un prend ton manteau, ne l''empêche pas de prendre encore ta tunique.
verses.am: ጕንጭህን ለሚመታህ ደግሞ ሁለተኛውን ስጠው፥ መጐናጸፊያህንም ለሚወስድ እጀ ጠባብህን ደግሞ አትከልክለው።

verses.en: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
verses.fr: Donne à quiconque te demande, et ne réclame pas ton bien à celui qui s''en empare.
verses.am: ለሚለምንህ ሁሉ ስጥ፥ ገንዘብህንም የሚወስድ እንዲመልስ አትጠይቀው።

verses.en: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
verses.fr: Ce que vous voulez que les hommes fassent pour vous, faites-le de même pour eux.
verses.am: ሰዎችም ሊያደርጉላችሁ እንደምትወዱ እናንተ ደግሞ እንዲሁ አድርጉላቸው።

verses.en: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
verses.fr: Si vous aimez ceux qui vous aiment, quel gré vous en saura-t-on? Les pécheurs aussi aiment ceux qui les aiment.
verses.am: የሚወዱአችሁንማ ብትወዱ፥ ምን ምስጋና አላችሁ? ኃጢአተኞች ደግሞ የሚወዱአቸውን ይወዳሉና።

verses.en: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
verses.fr: Si vous faites du bien à ceux qui vous font du bien, quel gré vous en saura-t-on? Les pécheurs aussi agissent de même.
verses.am: መልካምም ለሚያደርጉላችሁ መልካም ብታደርጉ፥ ምን ምስጋና አላችሁ? ኃጢአተኞች ደግሞ ያን ያደርጋሉና።

verses.en: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
verses.fr: Et si vous prêtez à ceux de qui vous espérez recevoir, quel gré vous en saura-t-on? Les pécheurs aussi prêtent aux pécheurs, afin de recevoir la pareille.
verses.am: እንድትወስዱባቸው ተስፋ ለምታደርጉአቸው ብታበድሩ፥ ምን ምስጋና አላችሁ? ኃጢአተኞች ደግሞ በትክክል እንዲቀበሉ ለኃጢአተኞች ያበድራሉ።

verses.en: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
verses.fr: Mais aimez vos ennemis, faites du bien, et prêtez sans rien espérer. Et votre récompense sera grande, et vous serez fils du Très-Haut, car il est bon pour les ingrats et pour les méchants.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ጠላቶቻችሁን ውደዱ፤ መልካም አድርጉ፤ ምንም ተስፋ ሳታደርጉም አበድሩ፥ ዋጋችሁም ታላቅ ይሆናል፥ የልዑልም ልጆች ትሆናላችሁ፥ እርሱ ለማያመሰግኑ ለክፉዎችም ቸር ነውና።

verses.en: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
verses.fr: Soyez donc miséricordieux, comme votre Père est miséricordieux.
verses.am: አባታችሁ ርኅሩኅ እንደ ሆነ ርኅሩኆች ሁኑ።

verses.en: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
verses.fr: Ne jugez point, et vous ne serez point jugés; ne condamnez point, et vous ne serez point condamnés; absolvez, et vous serez absous.
verses.am: አትፍረዱ አይፈረድባችሁምም፤ አትኰንኑ አትኰነኑምም። ይቅር በሉ ይቅርም ትባላላችሁ።

verses.en: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
verses.fr: Donnez, et il vous sera donné: on versera dans votre sein une bonne mesure, serrée, secouée et qui déborde; car on vous mesurera avec la mesure dont vous vous serez servis.
verses.am: ስጡ ይሰጣችሁማል፤ በምትሰፍሩበት መስፈሪያ ተመልሶ ይሰፈርላችኋልና፥ የተጨቈነና የተነቀነቀ የተትረፈረፈም መልካም መስፈሪያ በእቅፋችሁ ይሰጣችኋል።

verses.en: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
verses.fr: Il leur dit aussi cette parabole: Un aveugle peut-il conduire un aveugle? Ne tomberont-ils pas tous deux dans une fosse?
verses.am: ምሳሌም አላቸው። ዕውር ዕውርን ሊመራ ይችላልን? ሁለቱ በጕድጓድ አይወድቁምን?

verses.en: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
verses.fr: Le disciple n''est pas plus que le maître; mais tout disciple accompli sera comme son maître.
verses.am: ደቀ መዝሙር ከመምህሩ አይበልጥም፤ ፈጽሞ የተማረ ሁሉ ግን እንደ መምህሩ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.fr: Pourquoi vois-tu la paille qui est dans l''oeil de ton frère, et n''aperçois-tu pas la poutre qui est dans ton oeil?
verses.am: በወንድምህም ዓይን ያለውን ጉድፍ ስለ ምን ታያለህ፥ በራስህ ዓይን ግን ያለውን ምሰሶ ስለ ምን አትመለከትም?

verses.en: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.
verses.fr: Ou comment peux-tu dire à ton frère: Frère, laisse-moi ôter la paille qui est dans ton oeil, toi qui ne vois pas la poutre qui est dans le tien? Hypocrite, ôte premièrement la poutre de ton oeil, et alors tu verras comment ôter la paille qui est dans l''oeil de ton frère.
verses.am: በዓይንህ ያለውን ምሰሶ ራስህ ሳታይ፥ እንዴት ወንድምህን። ወንድሜ ሆይ፥ በዓይንህ ያለውን ጉድፍ ላውጣ ፍቀድልኝ ልትል ትችላለህ? አንተ ግብዝ፥ አስቀድመህ ከዓይንህ ምሰሶውን አውጣ ከዚያም በኋላ በወንድምህ ዓይን ያለውን ጉድፍ ታወጣ ዘንድ አጥርተህ ታያለህ።

verses.en: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas un bon arbre qui porte du mauvais fruit, ni un mauvais arbre qui porte du bon fruit.
verses.am: ክፉ ፍሬ የሚያደርግ መልካም ዛፍ የለምና፥ እንዲሁም መልካም ፍሬ የሚያደርግ ክፉ ዛፍ የለም።

verses.en: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
verses.fr: Car chaque arbre se connaît à son fruit. On ne cueille pas des figues sur des épines, et l''on ne vendange pas des raisins sur des ronces.
verses.am: ዛፍ ሁሉ ከፍሬው ይታወቃልና፤ ከእሾህ በለስ አይለቅሙም፥ ከአጣጥ ቍጥቋጦም ወይን አይቈርጡም።

verses.en: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
verses.fr: L''homme bon tire de bonnes choses du bon trésor de son coeur, et le méchant tire de mauvaises choses de son mauvais trésor; car c''est de l''abondance du coeur que la bouche parle.
verses.am: በልብ ሞልቶ ከተረፈው አፉ ይናገራልና መልካም ሰው ከልብ መልካም መዝገብ መልካሙን ያወጣል፥ ክፉ ሰውም ከልብ ክፉ መዝገብ ክፉውን ያወጣል።

verses.en: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
verses.fr: Pourquoi m''appelez-vous Seigneur, Seigneur! et ne faites-vous pas ce que je dis?
verses.am: ስለ ምን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ ትሉኛላችሁ፥ የምለውንም አታደርጉም?

verses.en: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
verses.fr: Je vous montrerai à qui est semblable tout homme qui vient à moi, entend mes paroles, et les met en pratique.
verses.am: ወደ እኔ የሚመጣ ሁሉ ቃሌንም ሰምቶ የሚያደርገው፥ ማንን እንዲመስል አሳያችኋለሁ።

verses.en: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.fr: Il est semblable à un homme qui, bâtissant une maison, a creusé, creusé profondément, et a posé le fondement sur le roc. Une inondation est venue, et le torrent s''est jeté contre cette maison, sans pouvoir l''ébranler, parce qu''elle était bien bâtie.
verses.am: ቤት ሲሠራ አጥልቆ የቆፈረ በዓለት ላይም የመሠረተ ሰውን ይመስላል፤ ጐርፍም በመጣ ጊዜ ወንዙ ያን ቤት ገፋው፥ በዓለት ላይም ስለ ተመሠረተ ሊያናውጠው አልቻለም።

verses.en: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
verses.fr: Mais celui qui entend, et ne met pas en pratique, est semblable à un homme qui a bâti une maison sur la terre, sans fondement. Le torrent s''est jeté contre elle: aussitôt elle est tombée, et la ruine de cette maison a été grande.
verses.am: ሰምቶ የማያደርገው ግን ያለ መሠረት በምድር ላይ ቤቱን የሠራ ሰውን ይመስላል፤ ወንዙም ገፋው ወዲያውም ወደቀ የዚያ ቤት አወዳደቅም ታላቅ ሆነ።

verses.en: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
verses.fr: Après avoir achevé tous ces discours devant le peuple qui l''écoutait, Jésus entra dans Capernaüm.
verses.am: ቃሉን ሁሉ በሕዝብ ጆሮዎች በጨረሰ ጊዜ ወደ ቅፍርናሆም ገባ።

verses.en: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
verses.fr: Un centenier avait un serviteur auquel il était très attaché, et qui se trouvait malade, sur le point de mourir.
verses.am: አንድ የመቶ አለቃም ነበረ፤ የሚወደውም ባሪያው ታሞ ሊሞት ቀርቦ ነበር።

verses.en: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
verses.fr: Ayant entendu parler de Jésus, il lui envoya quelques anciens des Juifs, pour le prier de venir guérir son serviteur.
verses.am: ስለ ኢየሱስም በሰማ ጊዜ የአይሁድን ሽማግሎች ወደ እርሱ ላከና መጥቶ ባሪያውን እንዲያድን ለመነው።

verses.en: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
verses.fr: Ils arrivèrent auprès de Jésus, et lui adressèrent d''instantes supplications, disant: Il mérite que tu lui accordes cela;
verses.am: እነርሱም ወደ ኢየሱስ መጥተው። ይህን ልታደርግለት ይገባዋል፤

verses.en: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
verses.fr: car il aime notre nation, et c''est lui qui a bâti notre synagogue.
verses.am: ሕዝባችንን ይወዳልና ምኵራብም ራሱ ሠርቶልናል ብለው አጽንተው ለመኑት።

verses.en: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
verses.fr: Jésus, étant allé avec eux, n''était guère éloigné de la maison, quand le centenier envoya des amis pour lui dire: Seigneur, ne prends pas tant de peine; car je ne suis pas digne que tu entres sous mon toit.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ከእነርሱ ጋር ሄደ። አሁንም ወደ ቤቱ በቀረበ ጊዜ የመቶው አለቃ ወዳጆቹን ወደ እርሱ ላከ፤ አለውም። ጌታ ሆይ በቤቴ ጣራ በታች ልትገባ አይገባኝምና አትድከም፤

verses.en: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.fr: C''est aussi pour cela que je ne me suis pas cru digne d''aller en personne vers toi. Mais dis un mot, et mon serviteur sera guéri.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ወደ አንተ ልመጣ እንዲገባኝ ሰውነቴን አልቈጠርሁትም፤ ነገር ግን ቃል ተናገር፥ ብላቴናዬም ይፈወሳል።

verses.en: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
verses.fr: Car, moi qui suis soumis à des supérieurs, j''ai des soldats sous mes ordres; et je dis à l''un: Va! et il va; à l''autre: Viens! et il vient; et à mon serviteur: Fais cela! et il le fait.
verses.am: እኔ ደግሞ ከሌሎች በታች የምገዛ ሰው ነኝ፥ ከእኔም በታች ወታደሮች አሉኝ፥ አንዱንም። ሂድ ብለው ይሄዳል፥ ሌላውንም። ና ብለው ይመጣል፥ ባሪያዬንም። ይህን አድርግ ብለው ያደርጋል።

verses.en: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.fr: Lorsque Jésus entendit ces paroles, il admira le centenier, et, se tournant vers la foule qui le suivait, il dit: Je vous le dis, même en Israël je n''ai pas trouvé une aussi grande foi.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ይህን ሰምቶ በእርሱ ተደነቀ፥ ዘወርም ብሎ ለተከተሉት ሕዝብ። እላችኋለሁ፥ በእስራኤልስ እንኳ እንዲህ ያለ ትልቅ እምነት አላገኘሁም አላቸው።

verses.en: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
verses.fr: De retour à la maison, les gens envoyés par le centenier trouvèrent guéri le serviteur qui avait été malade.
verses.am: የተላኩትም ወደ ቤት ተመልሰው ባሪያውን ባለ ጤና ሆኖ አገኙት።

verses.en: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
verses.fr: Le jour suivant, Jésus alla dans une ville appelée Naïn; ses disciples et une grande foule faisaient route avec lui.
verses.am: በነገውም ናይን ወደምትባል ወደ አንዲት ከተማ ሄደ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ብዙ ሕዝብም ከእርሱ ጋር አብረው ሄዱ።

verses.en: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il fut près de la porte de la ville, voici, on portait en terre un mort, fils unique de sa mère, qui était veuve; et il y avait avec elle beaucoup de gens de la ville.
verses.am: ወደ ከተማይቱም በር በቀረበ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ የሞተ ሰው ተሸክመው አወጡ፤ እርሱም ለእናቱ አንድ ልጅ ነበረ፥ እርስዋም መበለት ነበረች፥ ብዙም የከተማ ሕዝብ ከእርስዋ ጋር አብረው ነበሩ።

verses.en: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur, l''ayant vue, fut ému de compassion pour elle, et lui dit: Ne pleure pas!
verses.am: ጌታም ባያት ጊዜ አዘነላትና። አታልቅሽ አላት።

verses.en: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
verses.fr: Il s''approcha, et toucha le cercueil. Ceux qui le portaient s''arrêtèrent. Il dit: Jeune homme, je te le dis, lève-toi!
verses.am: ቀርቦም ቃሬዛውን ነካ፥ የተሸከሙትም ቆሙ፤ አለውም። አንተ ጐበዝ፥ እልሃለሁ፥ ተነሣ።

verses.en: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
verses.fr: Et le mort s''assit, et se mit à parler. Jésus le rendit à sa mère.
verses.am: የሞተውም ቀና ብሎ ተቀመጠ ሊናገርም ጀመረ፥ ለእናቱም ሰጣት።

verses.en: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
verses.fr: Tous furent saisis de crainte, et ils glorifiaient Dieu, disant: Un grand prophète a paru parmi nous, et Dieu a visité son peuple.
verses.am: ሁሉንም ፍርሃት ያዛቸውና። ታላቅ ነቢይ በእኛ መካከል ተነሥቶአል፥ ደግሞ። እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ጐበኘ እያሉ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገኑ።

verses.en: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.
verses.fr: Cette parole sur Jésus se répandit dans toute la Judée et dans tout le pays d''alentour.
verses.am: ይህም ዝና ስለ እርሱ በይሁዳ ሁሉ በዙሪያውም ባለች አገር ሁሉ ወጣ።

verses.en: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
verses.fr: Jean fut informé de toutes ces choses par ses disciples.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ለዮሐንስ እነዚህን ሁሉ አወሩ።

verses.en: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.fr: Il en appela deux, et les envoya vers Jésus, pour lui dire: Es-tu celui qui doit venir, ou devons-nous en attendre un autre?
verses.am: ዮሐንስም ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለት ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ። የሚመጣው አንተ ነህን ወይስ ሌላውን እንጠብቅ? ብሎ ወደ ኢየሱስ ላከ።

verses.en: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.fr: Arrivés auprès de Jésus, ils dirent: Jean Baptiste nous a envoyés vers toi, pour dire: Es-tu celui qui doit venir, ou devons-nous en attendre un autre?
verses.am: ሰዎቹም ወደ እርሱ መጥተው። መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ። የሚመጣው አንተ ነህን ወይስ ሌላውን እንጠብቅ? ብሎ ወደ አንተ ላከን አሉት።

verses.en: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
verses.fr: A l''heure même, Jésus guérit plusieurs personnes de maladies, d''infirmités, et d''esprits malins, et il rendit la vue à plusieurs aveugles.
verses.am: በዚያች ሰዓት ከደዌና ከሥቃይ ከክፉዎች መናፍስትም ብዙዎችን ፈወሰ፥ ለብዙ ዕውሮችም ማየትን ሰጠ።

verses.en: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
verses.fr: Et il leur répondit: Allez rapporter à Jean ce que vous avez vu et entendu: les aveugles voient, les boiteux marchent, les lépreux sont purifiés, les sourds entendent, les morts ressuscitent, la bonne nouvelle est annoncée aux pauvres.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ሄዳችሁ ያያችሁትን የሰማችሁትንም ለዮሐንስ አውሩለት፤ ዕውሮች ያያሉ፥ አንካሶችም ይሄዳሉ፥ ለምጻሞችም ይነጻሉ፥ ደንቆሮዎችም ይሰማሉ፥ ሙታንም ይነሣሉ፥ ለድሆችም ወንጌል ይሰበካል፤

verses.en: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.fr: Heureux celui pour qui je ne serai pas une occasion de chute!
verses.am: በእኔም የማይሰናከለው ሁሉ ብፁዕ ነው አላቸው።

verses.en: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.fr: Lorsque les envoyés de Jean furent partis, Jésus se mit à dire à la foule, au sujet de Jean: Qu''êtes-vous allés voir au désert? un roseau agité par le vent?
verses.am: የዮሐንስ መልክተኞችም ከሄዱ በኋላ፥ ለሕዝቡ ስለ ዮሐንስ ይናገር ጀመር እንዲህም አለ። ምን ልታዩ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ወጣችሁ? ነፋስ የሚወዘውዘውን ሸምበቆን? ወይስ ምን ልታዩ ወጣችሁ?

verses.en: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.
verses.fr: Mais, qu''êtes-vous allés voir? un homme vêtu d''habits précieux? Voici, ceux qui portent des habits magnifiques, et qui vivent dans les délices, sont dans les maisons des rois.
verses.am: ቀጭን ልብስ የለበሰውን ሰውን? እነሆ፥ ጌጠኛ ልብስ የሚለብሱና በቅምጥልነት የሚኖሩ በነገሥታት ቤት አሉ።

verses.en: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
verses.fr: Qu''êtes-vous donc allés voir? un prophète? Oui, vous dis-je, et plus qu''un prophète.
verses.am: ወይስ ምን ልታዩ ወጣችሁ? ነቢይን? አዎን እላችኋለሁ፥ ከነቢይም የሚበልጠውን።

verses.en: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.fr: C''est celui dont il est écrit: Voici, j''envoie mon messager devant ta face, Pour préparer ton chemin devant toi.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ መንገድህን በፊትህ የሚጠርግ መልክተኛዬን በፊትህ እልካለሁ ተብሎ የተጻፈለት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis, parmi ceux qui sont nés de femmes, il n''y en a point de plus grand que Jean. Cependant, le plus petit dans le royaume de Dieu est plus grand que lui.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ ከሴቶች ከተወለዱት መካከል ከመጥምቁ ዮሐንስ የሚበልጥ ማንም የለም፤ በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ግን ከሁሉ የሚያንሰው ይበልጠዋል።

verses.en: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
verses.fr: Et tout le peuple qui l''a entendu et même les publicains ont justifié Dieu, en se faisant baptiser du baptême de Jean;
verses.am: የሰሙትም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ቀራጮች እንኳ ሳይቀሩ በዮሐንስ ጥምቀት ተጠምቀው እግዚአብሔርን አጸደቁ፤

verses.en: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.
verses.fr: mais les pharisiens et les docteurs de la loi, en ne se faisant pas baptiser par lui, ont rendu nul à leur égard le dessein de Dieu.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንና ሕግ አዋቂዎች ግን በእርሱ ስለ አልተጠመቁ የእግዚአብሔርን ምክር ከራሳቸው ጣሉ።

verses.en: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
verses.fr: A qui donc comparerai-je les hommes de cette génération, et à qui ressemblent-ils?
verses.am: እንግዲህ የዚችን ትውልድ ሰዎች በምን አስመስላቸዋለሁ? ማንንስ ይመስላሉ?

verses.en: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
verses.fr: Ils ressemblent aux enfants assis dans la place publique, et qui, se parlant les uns aux autres, disent: Nous vous avons joué de la flûte, et vous n''avez pas dansé; nous vous avons chanté des complaintes, et vous n''avez pas pleuré.
verses.am: በገበያ የሚቀመጡትን ልጆች ይመስላሉ፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም እየተጠራሩ። እንቢልታ ነፋንላችሁ አልዘፈናችሁምም፤ ሙሾ አወጣንላችሁ አላለቀሳችሁምም ይላል።

verses.en: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.
verses.fr: Car Jean Baptiste est venu, ne mangeant pas de pain et ne buvant pas de vin, et vous dites: Il a un démon.
verses.am: መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ እንጀራ ሳይበላ የወይን ጠጅም ሳይጠጣ መጥቶ ነበርና። ጋኔን አለበት አላችሁት።

verses.en: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
verses.fr: Le Fils de l''homme est venu, mangeant et buvant, et vous dites: C''est un mangeur et un buveur, un ami des publicains et des gens de mauvaise vie.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ እየበላና እየጠጣ መጥቶአልና። እነሆ፥ በላተኛና የወይን ጠጅ ጠጭ፥ የቀራጮችና የኃጢአተኞች ወዳጅ አላችሁት።

verses.en: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
verses.fr: Mais la sagesse a été justifiée par tous ses enfants.
verses.am: ጥበብም ለልጆችዋ ሁሉ ጸደቀች።

verses.en: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.
verses.fr: Un pharisien pria Jésus de manger avec lui. Jésus entra dans la maison du pharisien, et se mit à table.
verses.am: ከፈሪሳውያንም አንድ ከእርሱ ጋር ይበላ ዘንድ ለመነው፤ በፈሪሳዊው ቤትም ገብቶ በማዕድ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
verses.fr: Et voici, une femme pécheresse qui se trouvait dans la ville, ayant su qu''il était à table dans la maison du pharisien, apporta un vase d''albâtre plein de parfum,
verses.am: እነሆም በዚያች ከተማ ኃጢአተኛ የነበረች አንዲት ሴት፤ በፈሪሳዊው ቤት በማዕድ እንደ ተቀመጠ ባወቀች ጊዜ፥ ሽቱ የሞላበት የአልባስጥሮስ ቢልቃጥ አመጣች።

verses.en: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
verses.fr: et se tint derrière, aux pieds de Jésus. Elle pleurait; et bientôt elle lui mouilla les pieds de ses larmes, puis les essuya avec ses cheveux, les baisa, et les oignit de parfum.
verses.am: በስተ ኋላውም በእግሩ አጠገብ ቆማ እያለቀሰች በእንባዋ እግሩን ታርስ ጀመረች፥ በራስ ጠጕርዋም ታብሰው እግሩንም ትስመው ሽቱም ትቀባው ነበረች።

verses.en: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
verses.fr: Le pharisien qui l''avait invité, voyant cela, dit en lui-même: Si cet homme était prophète, il connaîtrait qui et de quelle espèce est la femme qui le touche, il connaîtrait que c''est une pécheresse.
verses.am: የጠራው ፈሪሳዊም አይቶ። ይህስ ነቢይ ቢሆን፥ ይህች የምትዳስሰው ሴት ማን እንደ ሆነች እንዴትስ እንደ ነበረች ባወቀ ነበር፥ ኃጢአተኛ ናትና ብሎ በልቡ አሰበ።

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
verses.fr: Jésus prit la parole, et lui dit: Simon, j''ai quelque chose à te dire. - Maître, parle, répondit-il. -
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ስምዖን ሆይ፥ የምነግርህ ነገር አለኝ አለው። እርሱም። መምህር ሆይ፥ ተናገር አለ።

verses.en: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
verses.fr: Un créancier avait deux débiteurs: l''un devait cinq cents deniers, et l''autre cinquante.
verses.am: ለአንድ አበዳሪ ሁለት ተበዳሪዎች ነበሩት በአንዱ አምስት መቶ ዲናር ነበረበት በሁለተኛውም አምሳ።

verses.en: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
verses.fr: Comme ils n''avaient pas de quoi payer, il leur remit à tous deux leur dette. Lequel l''aimera le plus?
verses.am: የሚከፍሉትም ቢያጡ ለሁለቱም ተወላቸው። እንግዲህ ከእነርሱ አብልጦ የሚወደው ማንኛው ነው?

verses.en: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
verses.fr: Simon répondit: Celui, je pense, auquel il a le plus remis. Jésus lui dit: Tu as bien jugé.
verses.am: ስምዖንም መልሶ። ብዙ የተወለቱ ይመስለኛል አለ። እርሱም። በእውነት ፈረድህ አለው።

verses.en: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
verses.fr: Puis, se tournant vers la femme, il dit à Simon: Vois-tu cette femme? Je suis entré dans ta maison, et tu ne m''as point donné d''eau pour laver mes pieds; mais elle, elle les a mouillés de ses larmes, et les a essuyés avec ses cheveux.
verses.am: ወደ ሴቲቱም ዘወር ብሎ ስምዖንን እንዲህ አለው። ይህችን ሴት ታያለህን? እኔ ወደ ቤትህ ገባሁ፥ ውኃ ስንኳ ለእግሬ አላቀረብህልኝም፤ እርስዋ ግን በእንባዋ እግሬን አራሰች በጠጕርዋም አበሰች።

verses.en: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
verses.fr: Tu ne m''as point donné de baiser; mais elle, depuis que je suis entré, elle n''a point cessé de me baiser les pieds.
verses.am: አንተ አልሳምኸኝም፤ እርስዋ ግን ከገባሁ ጀምራ እግሬን ከመሳም አላቋረጠችም።

verses.en: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
verses.fr: Tu n''as point versé d''huile sur ma tête; mais elle, elle a versé du parfum sur mes pieds.
verses.am: አንተ ራሴን ዘይት አልቀባኸኝም፤ እርስዋ ግን እግሬን ሽቱ ቀባች።

verses.en: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, je te le dis, ses nombreux péchés ont été pardonnés: car elle a beaucoup aimé. Mais celui à qui on pardonne peu aime peu.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እልሃለሁ፥ እጅግ ወዳለችና ብዙ ያለው ኃጢአትዋ ተሰርዮላታል፤ ጥቂት ግን የሚሰረይለት ጥቂት ይወዳል።

verses.en: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
verses.fr: Et il dit à la femme: Tes péchés sont pardonnés.
verses.am: እርስዋንም። ኃጢአትሽ ተሰርዮልሻል አላት።

verses.en: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
verses.fr: Ceux qui étaient à table avec lui se mirent à dire en eux-mêmes: Qui est celui-ci, qui pardonne même les péchés?
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር በማዕድ ተቀምጠው የነበሩት በልባቸው። ኃጢአትን እንኳ የሚያስተሰርይ ይህ ማን ነው? ይሉ ጀመር።

verses.en: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus dit à la femme: Ta foi t''a sauvée, va en paix.
verses.am: ሴቲቱንም። እምነትሽ አድኖሻል፤ በሰላም ሂጂ አላት።

verses.en: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,
verses.fr: Ensuite, Jésus allait de ville en ville et de village en village, prêchant et annonçant la bonne nouvelle du royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ እየሰበከና ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት የምሥራች እየተናገረ በየከተማይቱ በየመንደሩም ያልፍ ነበር፤

verses.en: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
verses.fr: Les douze étaient avec lui et quelques femmes qui avaient été guéries d''esprits malins et de maladies: Marie, dite de Magdala, de laquelle étaient sortis sept démons,
verses.am: አሥራ ሁለቱም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩ፥ ከክፉዎች መናፍስትና ከደዌም ተፈውሰው የነበሩ አንዳንድ ሴቶች፤ እነርሱም ሰባት አጋንንት የወጡላት መግደላዊት የምትባል ማርያም፥

verses.en: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
verses.fr: Jeanne, femme de Chuza, intendant d''Hérode, Susanne, et plusieurs autres, qui l''assistaient de leurs biens.
verses.am: የሄሮድስ አዛዥ የኩዛ ሚስት ዮሐናም ሶስናም ብዙዎች ሌሎችም ሆነው በገንዘባቸው ያገለግሉት ነበር።

verses.en: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
verses.fr: Une grande foule s''étant assemblée, et des gens étant venus de diverses villes auprès de lui, il dit cette parabole:
verses.am: ብዙ ሕዝብም በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ ከከተማዎችም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ በመጡ ጊዜ በምሳሌ እንዲህ ሲል ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
verses.fr: Un semeur sortit pour semer sa semence. Comme il semait, une partie de la semence tomba le long du chemin: elle fut foulée aux pieds, et les oiseaux du ciel la mangèrent.
verses.am: ዘሪ ዘሩን ሊዘራ ወጣ። ሲዘራም አንዳንዱ በመንገድ ዳር ወደቀ ተረገጠም፥ የሰማይ ወፎችም በሉት።

verses.en: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
verses.fr: Une autre partie tomba sur le roc: quand elle fut levée, elle sécha, parce qu''elle n''avait point d''humidité.
verses.am: ሌላውም በዓለት ላይ ወደቀ፥ በበቀለም ጊዜ እርጥበት ስላልነበረው ደረቀ።

verses.en: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
verses.fr: Une autre partie tomba au milieu des épines: les épines crûrent avec elle, et l''étouffèrent.
verses.am: ሌላውም በእሾህ መካከል ወደቀ፥ እሾሁም አብሮ በቀለና አነቀው።

verses.en: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.fr: Une autre partie tomba dans la bonne terre: quand elle fut levée, elle donna du fruit au centuple. Après avoir ainsi parlé, Jésus dit à haute voix: Que celui qui a des oreilles pour entendre entende!
verses.am: ሌላውም በመልካም መሬት ላይ ወደቀ፤ በበቀለም ጊዜ መቶ እጥፍ አፈራ። ይህን በተናገረ ጊዜ። የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
verses.fr: Ses disciples lui demandèrent ce que signifiait cette parabole.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። ይህ ምሳሌ ምንድር ነው? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Il vous a été donné de connaître les mystères du royaume de Dieu; mais pour les autres, cela leur est dit en paraboles, afin qu''en voyant ils ne voient point, et qu''en entendant ils ne comprennent point.
verses.am: እርሱም እንዲህ አለ። ለእናንተ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ምሥጢር ማወቅ ተሰጥቶአችኋል፤ ለሌሎች ግን እያዩ እንዳያዩ እየሰሙም እንዳያስተውሉ በምሳሌ ነው።

verses.en: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
verses.fr: Voici ce que signifie cette parabole: La semence, c''est la parole de Dieu.
verses.am: ምሳሌው ይህ ነው። ዘሩ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ነው።

verses.en: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
verses.fr: Ceux qui sont le long du chemin, ce sont ceux qui entendent; puis le diable vient, et enlève de leur coeur la parole, de peur qu''ils ne croient et soient sauvés.
verses.am: በመንገድ ዳርም ያሉት የሚሰሙ ናቸው፤ ከዚህ በኋላም ዲያብሎስ ይመጣል አምነውም እንዳይድኑ ቃሉን ከልባቸው ይወስዳል።

verses.en: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
verses.fr: Ceux qui sont sur le roc, ce sont ceux qui, lorsqu''ils entendent la parole, la reçoivent avec joie; mais ils n''ont point de racine, ils croient pour un temps, et ils succombent au moment de la tentation.
verses.am: በዓለት ላይም ያሉት ሲሰሙ ቃሉን በደስታ የሚቀበሉ ናቸው፤ እነርሱም ለጊዜው ብቻ ያምናሉ እንጂ በፈተና ጊዜ የሚክዱ ሥር የሌላቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
verses.fr: Ce qui est tombé parmi les épines, ce sont ceux qui, ayant entendu la parole, s''en vont, et la laissent étouffer par les soucis, les richesses et les plaisirs de la vie, et ils ne portent point de fruit qui vienne à maturité.
verses.am: በእሾህ መካከልም የወደቀ እነዚህ የሚሰሙት ናቸው፤ መንገዳቸውንም ሄደው በሕይወት ዘመን በአሳብና በባለ ጠግነት ምቾት ይታነቃሉ፥ ሙሉ ፍሬም አያፈሩም።

verses.en: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
verses.fr: Ce qui est tombé dans la bonne terre, ce sont ceux qui, ayant entendu la parole avec un coeur honnête et bon, la retiennent, et portent du fruit avec persévérance.
verses.am: በመልካም መሬት ላይም የወደቀ እነርሱ በመልካምና በበጎ ልብ ቃሉን ሰምተው የሚጠብቁት በመጽናትም ፍሬ የሚያፈሩ ናቸው።

verses.en: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
verses.fr: Personne, après avoir allumé une lampe, ne la couvre d''un vase, ou ne la met sous un lit; mais il la met sur un chandelier, afin que ceux qui entrent voient la lumière.
verses.am: መብራትንም አብርቶ በዕቃ የሚከድነው ወይም ከአልጋ በታች የሚያኖረው የለም፥ የሚገቡት ሰዎች ብርሃኑን እንዲያዩ በመቅረዝ ላይ ያኖረዋል እንጂ።

verses.en: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
verses.fr: Car il n''est rien de caché qui ne doive être découvert, rien de secret qui ne doive être connu et mis au jour.
verses.am: የማይገለጥ የተሰወረ የለምና፥ የማይታወቅም ወደ ግልጥም የማይመጣ የተሸሸገ የለም።

verses.en: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.
verses.fr: Prenez donc garde à la manière dont vous écoutez; car on donnera à celui qui a, mais à celui qui n''a pas on ôtera même ce qu''il croit avoir.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንዴት እንድትሰሙ ተጠበቁ፤ ላለው ሁሉ ይሰጠዋልና፥ ከሌለውም ሁሉ፥ ያው ያለው የሚመስለው እንኳ ይወሰድበታል።

verses.en: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
verses.fr: La mère et les frères de Jésus vinrent le trouver; mais ils ne purent l''aborder, à cause de la foule.
verses.am: እናቱና ወንድሞቹም ወደ እርሱ መጡ፥ ከሕዝቡም ብዛት የተነሣ ሊያገኙት አልተቻላቸውም።

verses.en: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
verses.fr: On lui dit: Ta mère et tes frères sont dehors, et ils désirent te voir.
verses.am: እናትህና ወንድሞችህ ሊያዩህ ወድደው በውጭ ቆመዋል ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.en: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.
verses.fr: Mais il répondit: Ma mère et mes frères, ce sont ceux qui écoutent la parole de Dieu, et qui la mettent en pratique.
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። እናቴና ወንድሞቼስ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሰምተው የሚያደርጉት እነዚህ ናቸው አላቸው።

verses.en: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
verses.fr: Un jour, Jésus monta dans une barque avec ses disciples. Il leur dit: Passons de l''autre côté du lac. Et ils partirent.
verses.am: ከዕለታቱም በአንዱ እርሱ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ወደ ታንኳ ገብቶ። ወደ ባሕር ማዶ እንሻገር አላቸው፤ ተነሡም።

verses.en: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''ils naviguaient, Jésus s''endormit. Un tourbillon fondit sur le lac, la barque se remplissait d''eau, et ils étaient en péril.
verses.am: ሲሄዱም አንቀላፋ። ዓውሎ ነፋስም በባሕር ላይ ወረደ፥ ውኃውም ታንኳይቱን ይሞላ ነበርና ይጨነቁ ነበር።

verses.en: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
verses.fr: Ils s''approchèrent et le réveillèrent, en disant: Maître, maître, nous périssons! S''étant réveillé, il menaça le vent et les flots, qui s''apaisèrent, et le calme revint.
verses.am: ቀርበውም። አቤቱ፥ አቤቱ ጠፋን እያሉ አስነሡት። እርሱም ነቅቶ ነፋሱንና የውኃውን ማዕበል ገሠጻቸው፤ ተዉም፥ ጽጥታም ሆነ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.
verses.fr: Puis il leur dit: Où est votre foi? Saisis de frayeur et d''étonnement, ils se dirent les uns aux autres: Quel est donc celui-ci, qui commande même au vent et à l''eau, et à qui ils obéissent?
verses.am: እርሱም። እምነታችሁ የት ነው? አላቸው። ፈርተውም ተደነቁ፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም። እንዲህ ነፋሳትንና ውኃን እንኳ የሚያዝ ለእርሱም የሚታዘዙለት ይህ ማን ነው? አሉ።

verses.en: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
verses.fr: Ils abordèrent dans le pays des Géraséniens, qui est vis-à-vis de la Galilée.
verses.am: በገሊላም አንጻር ወዳለችው ወደ ጌርጌሴኖን አገር በታንኳ ደረሱ።

verses.en: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
verses.fr: Lorsque Jésus fut descendu à terre, il vint au-devant de lui un homme de la ville, qui était possédé de plusieurs démons. Depuis longtemps il ne portait point de vêtement, et avait sa demeure non dans une maison, mais dans les sépulcres.
verses.am: ወደ ምድርም በወጣ ጊዜ አጋንንት ያደሩበት አንድ ሰው ከከተማ ወጥቶ ተገናኘው፥ ከብዙ ዘመንም ጀምሮ ልብስ ሳይለብስ በመቃብር እንጂ በቤት አይኖርም ነበር።

verses.en: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.
verses.fr: Ayant vu Jésus, il poussa un cri, se jeta à ses pieds, et dit d''une voix forte: Qu''y a-t-il entre moi et toi, Jésus, Fils du Dieu Très-Haut? Je t''en supplie, ne me tourmente pas.
verses.am: ኢየሱስንም ባየ ጊዜ ጮኾ በፊቱ ተደፋ በታላቅ ድምፅም። የልዑል እግዚአብሔር ልጅ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለኝ? እንዳትሣቀየኝ እለምንሃለሁ አለ።

verses.en: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
verses.fr: Car Jésus commandait à l''esprit impur de sortir de cet homme, dont il s''était emparé depuis longtemps; on le gardait lié de chaînes et les fers aux pieds, mais il rompait les liens, et il était entraîné par le démon dans les déserts.
verses.am: ርኵሱን መንፈስ ከሰውዬው እንዲወጣ ያዘው ነበርና። ብዙ ዘመንም ይዞት ነበርና፥ በሰንሰለትና በእግር ብረትም ታስሮ ይጠበቅ ነበር፤ እስራቱንም ሰብሮ በጋኔኑ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ይነዳ ነበር።

verses.en: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
verses.fr: Jésus lui demanda: Quel est ton nom? Légion, répondit-il. Car plusieurs démons étaient entrés en lui.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ስምህ ማን ነው? ብሎ ጠየቀው። እርሱም ብዙዎች አጋንንት ገብተውበት ነበርና። ሌጌዎን አለው።

verses.en: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
verses.fr: Et ils priaient instamment Jésus de ne pas leur ordonner d''aller dans l''abîme.
verses.am: ወደ ጥልቁም ሊሄዱ እንዳያዛቸው ለመኑት።

verses.en: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.
verses.fr: Il y avait là, dans la montagne, un grand troupeau de pourceaux qui paissaient. Et les démons supplièrent Jésus de leur permettre d''entrer dans ces pourceaux. Il le leur permit.
verses.am: በዚያም በተራራው የብዙ እሪያ መንጋ ይሰማሩ ነበር፤ ወደ እነርሱም ሊገቡ እንዲፈቅድላቸው ለመኑት፤ ፈቀደላቸውም።

verses.en: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
verses.fr: Les démons sortirent de cet homme, entrèrent dans les pourceaux, et le troupeau se précipita des pentes escarpées dans le lac, et se noya.
verses.am: አጋንንትም ከሰውዬው ወጥተው ወደ እሪያዎች ገቡ፥ መንጋውም ከአፋፉ ወደ ባሕር ተጣደፉና ሰጠሙ።

verses.en: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.
verses.fr: Ceux qui les faisaient paître, voyant ce qui était arrivé, s''enfuirent, et répandirent la nouvelle dans la ville et dans les campagnes.
verses.am: እረኞችም የሆነውን ባዩ ጊዜ ሸሽተው በከተማውና በአገሩ አወሩት።

verses.en: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
verses.fr: Les gens allèrent voir ce qui était arrivé. Ils vinrent auprès de Jésus, et ils trouvèrent l''homme de qui étaient sortis les démons, assis à ses pieds, vêtu, et dans son bon sens; et ils furent saisis de frayeur.
verses.am: የሆነውን ነገር ሊያዩ ወጥተውም ወደ ኢየሱስ መጡ፥ አጋንንትም የወጡለትን ሰው ለብሶ ልቡም ተመልሶ በኢየሱስ እግር አጠገብ ተቀምጦ አገኙትና ፈሩ።

verses.en: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
verses.fr: Ceux qui avaient vu ce qui s''était passé leur racontèrent comment le démoniaque avait été guéri.
verses.am: ያዩትም ደግሞ አጋንንት ያደሩበት ሰው እንዴት እንደ ዳነ አወሩላቸው።

verses.en: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.
verses.fr: Tous les habitants du pays des Géraséniens prièrent Jésus de s''éloigner d''eux, car ils étaient saisis d''une grande crainte. Jésus monta dans la barque, et s''en retourna.
verses.am: በዙሪያውም በጌርጌሴኖን አገር ያሉት ሕዝብ ሁሉ ታላቅ ፍርሃት ይዞአቸዋልና ከእነርሱ እንዲሄድ ለመኑት በታንኳም ገብቶ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
verses.fr: L''homme de qui étaient sortis les démons lui demandait la permission de rester avec lui. Mais Jésus le renvoya, en disant:
verses.am: አጋንንት የወጡለት ሰውም ከእርሱ ጋር ይኖር ዘንድ ለመነው፤

verses.en: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.
verses.fr: Retourne dans ta maison, et raconte tout ce que Dieu t''a fait. Il s''en alla, et publia par toute la ville tout ce que Jésus avait fait pour lui.
verses.am: ነገር ግን። ወደ ቤትህ ተመለስ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዴት ያለ ታላቅ ነገር እንዳደረግልህ ንገር ብሎ አሰናበተው። ኢየሱስም እንዴት ያለ ታላቅ ነገር እንዳደረገለት በከተማው ሁሉ እየሰበከ ሄደ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.
verses.fr: A son retour, Jésus fut reçu par la foule, car tous l''attendaient.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በተመለሰ ጊዜ ሁሉ ይጠብቁት ነበርና ሕዝቡ ተቀበሉት።

verses.en: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
verses.fr: Et voici, il vint un homme, nommé Jaïrus, qui était chef de la synagogue. Il se jeta à ses pieds, et le supplia d''entrer dans sa maison,
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ኢያኢሮስ የሚባል ሰው መጣ፥ እርሱም የምኵራብ አለቃ ነበረ በኢየሱስም እግር ላይ ወድቆ ወደ ቤቱ እንዲገባ ለመነው፤

verses.en: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.
verses.fr: parce qu''il avait une fille unique d''environ douze ans qui se mourait. Pendant que Jésus y allait, il était pressé par la foule.
verses.am: አሥራ ሁለት ዓመት የሆናት አንዲት ሴት ልጅ ነበረችውና፤ እርስዋም ለሞት ቀርባ ነበረች። ሲሄድም ሕዝቡ ያጨናንቁት ነበር።

verses.en: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,
verses.fr: Or, il y avait une femme atteinte d''une perte de sang depuis douze ans, et qui avait dépensé tout son bien pour les médecins, sans qu''aucun ait pu la guérir.
verses.am: ከአሥራ ሁለት ዓመትም ጀምሮ ደም የሚፈሳት ሴት ነበረች፥ ትዳርዋንም ሁሉ ለባለመድኃኒቶች ከስራ ማንም ሊፈውሳት አልተቻለውም።

verses.en: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
verses.fr: Elle s''approcha par derrière, et toucha le bord du vêtement de Jésus. Au même instant la perte de sang s''arrêta.
verses.am: በኋላውም ቀርባ የልብሱን ጫፍ ዳሰሰች፥ የደምዋም ፈሳሽ በዚያን ጊዜ ቆመ።

verses.en: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
verses.fr: Et Jésus dit: Qui m''a touché? Comme tous s''en défendaient, Pierre et ceux qui étaient avec lui dirent: Maître, la foule t''entoure et te presse, et tu dis: Qui m''a touché?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። የዳሰሰኝ ማን ነው? አለ። ሁሉም በካዱ ጊዜ፥ ጴጥሮስና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት። አቤቱ፥ ሕዝቡ ያጫንቁሃልና ያጋፉህማል፤ የዳሰሰኝ ማን ነው ትላለህን? አሉ።

verses.en: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus répondit: Quelqu''un m''a touché, car j''ai connu qu''une force était sortie de moi.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን። አንድ ሰው ዳስሶኛል፥ ኃይል ከእኔ እንደ ወጣ እኔ አውቃለሁና አለ።

verses.en: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
verses.fr: La femme, se voyant découverte, vint toute tremblante se jeter à ses pieds, et déclara devant tout le peuple pourquoi elle l''avait touché, et comment elle avait été guérie à l''instant.
verses.am: ሴቲቱም እንዳልተሰወረች ባየች ጊዜ እየተንቀጠቀጠች መጥታ በፊቱ ተደፋች፥ በምን ምክንያትም እንደ ዳሰሰችው ፈጥናም እንደ ተፈወሰች በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት አወራች።

verses.en: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Ma fille, ta foi t''a sauvée; va en paix.
verses.am: እርሱም። ልጄ ሆይ፥ እምነትሽ አድኖሻል፤ በሰላም ሂጂ አላት።

verses.en: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
verses.fr: Comme il parlait encore, survint de chez le chef de la synagogue quelqu''un disant: Ta fille est morte; n''importune pas le maître.
verses.am: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር አንድ ሰው ከምኵራብ አለቃው ቤት መጥቶ። ልጅህ ሞታለች፤ እንግዲህ መምህሩን አታድክም አለ።

verses.en: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus, ayant entendu cela, dit au chef de la synagogue: Ne crains pas, crois seulement, et elle sera sauvée.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን ሰምቶ። አትፍራ፤ እመን ብቻ ትድንማለች ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il fut arrivé à la maison, il ne permit à personne d''entrer avec lui, si ce n''est à Pierre, à Jean et à Jacques, et au père et à la mère de l''enfant.
verses.am: ወደ ቤትም ሲገባ ከጴጥሮስና ከያዕቆብ ከዮሐንስም ከብላቴናይቱም አባትና እናት በቀር ማንም ከእርሱ ጋር ይገባ ዘንድ አልፈቀደም።

verses.en: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.
verses.fr: Tous pleuraient et se lamentaient sur elle. Alors Jésus dit: Ne pleurez pas; elle n''est pas morte, mais elle dort.
verses.am: ሁሉም እያለቀሱላት ዋይ ዋይ ይሉ ነበር። እርሱ ግን። አታልቅሱ፤ ተኝታለች እንጂ አልሞተችም አለ።

verses.en: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
verses.fr: Et ils se moquaient de lui, sachant qu''elle était morte.
verses.am: እንደ ሞተችም አውቀው በጣም ሳቁበት።

verses.en: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.
verses.fr: Mais il la saisit par la main, et dit d''une voix forte: Enfant, lève-toi.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን እጅዋን ይዞ። አንቺ ብላቴና፥ ተነሺ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
verses.fr: Et son esprit revint en elle, et à l''instant elle se leva; et Jésus ordonna qu''on lui donnât à manger.
verses.am: ነፍስዋም ተመለሰች፥ ፈጥናም ቆመች፥ የምትበላውንም እንዲሰጡአት አዘዘ።

verses.en: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.
verses.fr: Les parents de la jeune fille furent dans l''étonnement, et il leur recommanda de ne dire à personne ce qui était arrivé.
verses.am: ወላጆችዋም ተገረሙ፤ እርሱ ግን የሆነውን ለማንም እንዳይነግሩ አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.
verses.fr: Jésus, ayant assemblé les douze, leur donna force et pouvoir sur tous les démons, avec la puissance de guérir les maladies.
verses.am: አሥራ ሁለቱንም ሐዋርያት በአንድነት ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ በአጋንንት ሁሉ ላይ ደዌንም ይፈውሱ ዘንድ ኃይልና ሥልጣን ሰጣቸው፤

verses.en: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
verses.fr: Il les envoya prêcher le royaume de Dieu, et guérir les malades.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም መንግሥት እንዲሰብኩና ድውዮችን እንዲፈውሱ ላካቸው፥

verses.en: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
verses.fr: Ne prenez rien pour le voyage, leur dit-il, ni bâton, ni sac, ni pain, ni argent, et n''ayez pas deux tuniques.
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። በትርም ቢሆን፥ ከረጢትም ቢሆን፥ እንጀራም ቢሆን፥ ብርም ቢሆን ለመንገድ ምንም አትያዙ፥ ሁለት እጀ ጠባብም አይሁንላችሁ።

verses.en: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
verses.fr: Dans quelque maison que vous entriez, restez-y; et c''est de là que vous partirez.
verses.am: በማናቸውም በምትገቡበት ቤት በዚያ ተቀመጡ ከዚያም ውጡ።

verses.en: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
verses.fr: Et, si les gens ne vous reçoivent pas, sortez de cette ville, et secouez la poussière de vos pieds, en témoignage contre eux.
verses.am: ማናቸውም የማይቀበሉአችሁ ቢሆኑ፥ ከዚያ ከተማ ወጥታችሁ ምስክር እንዲሆንባቸው ከእግራችሁ ትቢያ አራግፉ።

verses.en: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
verses.fr: Ils partirent, et ils allèrent de village en village, annonçant la bonne nouvelle et opérant partout des guérisons.
verses.am: ወጥተውም ወንጌልን እየሰበኩና በስፍራው ሁሉ እየፈወሱ በየመንደሩ ያልፉ ነበር።

verses.en: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;
verses.fr: Hérode le tétrarque entendit parler de tout ce qui se passait, et il ne savait que penser. Car les uns disaient que Jean était ressuscité des morts;
verses.am: የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ ሄሮድስም የተደረገውን ነገር ሁሉ ሰምቶ፥ አንዳንድ ሰዎች።

verses.en: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
verses.fr: d''autres, qu''Elie était apparu; et d''autres, qu''un des anciens prophètes était ressuscité.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ ከሙታን ተነሣ፥ ሌሎችም። ኤልያስ ተገለጠ፥ ሌሎችም። ከቀደሙት ነቢያት አንዱ ተነሥቶአል ይሉ ስለ ነበሩ አመነታ።

verses.en: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.
verses.fr: Mais Hérode disait: J''ai fait décapiter Jean; qui donc est celui-ci, dont j''entends dire de telles choses? Et il cherchait à le voir.
verses.am: ሄሮድስም። ዮሐንስንስ እኔ ራሱን አስቈረጥሁት፤ ይህ እንዲህ ያለ ነገር የምሰማበት ማን ነው? አለ። ሊያየውም ይሻ ነበር።

verses.en: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
verses.fr: Les apôtres, étant de retour, racontèrent à Jésus tout ce qu''ils avaient fait. Il les prit avec lui, et se retira à l''écart, du côté d''une ville appelée Bethsaïda.
verses.am: ሐዋርያትም ተመልሰው ያደረጉትን ሁሉ ነገሩት። ከእርሱ ጋርም ወስዶአቸው ቤተ ሳይዳ ከምትባል ከተማ አጠገብ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ለብቻው ፈቀቅ አለ።

verses.en: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.
verses.fr: Les foules, l''ayant su, le suivirent. Jésus les accueillit, et il leur parlait du royaume de Dieu; il guérit aussi ceux qui avaient besoin d''être guéris.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም አውቀው ተከተሉት፤ ተቀብሎአቸውም ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ይነግራቸው ነበር፥ መፈወስ ያስፈለጋቸውንም ፈወሳቸው።

verses.en: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.
verses.fr: Comme le jour commençait à baisser, les douze s''approchèrent, et lui dirent: Renvoie la foule, afin qu''elle aille dans les villages et dans les campagnes des environs, pour se loger et pour trouver des vivres; car nous sommes ici dans un lieu désert.
verses.am: ቀኑም ይመሽ ጀመር፤ አሥራ ሁለቱም ቀርበው። በዚህ በምድረ በዳ ነንና በዙሪያችን ወዳሉ መንደሮችና ገጠሮች ሄደው እንዲያድሩና ምግብ እንዲያገኙ ሕዝቡን አሰናብት አሉት።

verses.en: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Donnez-leur vous-mêmes à manger. Mais ils répondirent: Nous n''avons que cinq pains et deux poissons, à moins que nous n''allions nous-mêmes acheter des vivres pour tout ce peuple.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። እናንተ የሚበሉትን ስጡአቸው አላቸው። እነርሱም። ሄደን ለዚህ ሁሉ ሕዝብ ምግብ ካልገዛን፥ ከአምስት እንጀራና ከሁለት ዓሣ የሚበልጥ የለንም አሉት፤

verses.en: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
verses.fr: Or, il y avait environ cinq mille hommes. Jésus dit à ses disciples: Faites-les asseoir par rangées de cinquante.
verses.am: አምስት ሺህ ሰዎች ያህሉ ነበርና። ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ። በየክፍሉ አምሳ አምሳውን አስቀምጡአቸው አላቸው።

verses.en: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
verses.fr: Ils firent ainsi, ils les firent tous asseoir.
verses.am: እንዲህም አደረጉ ሁሉንም አስቀመጡአቸው።

verses.en: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
verses.fr: Jésus prit les cinq pains et les deux poissons, et, levant les yeux vers le ciel, il les bénit. Puis, il les rompit, et les donna aux disciples, afin qu''ils les distribuassent à la foule.
verses.am: አምስቱንም እንጀራና ሁለቱን ዓሣ ይዞ፥ ወደ ሰማይ አሻቅቦ አየና ባረካቸው ቆርሶም ለሕዝቡ እንዲያቀርቡ ለደቀ መዛርሙርቱ ሰጠ።

verses.en: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.
verses.fr: Tous mangèrent et furent rassasiés, et l''on emporta douze paniers pleins des morceaux qui restaient.
verses.am: ሁሉም በልተው ጠገቡ፥ ከእነርሱም የተረፈውን ቍርስራሽ አሥራ ሁለት መሶብ ወሰዱ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?
verses.fr: Un jour que Jésus priait à l''écart, ayant avec lui ses disciples, il leur posa cette question: Qui dit-on que je suis?
verses.am: ለብቻውም ሲጸልይ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩና። ሕዝቡ እኔ ማን እንደ ሆንሁ ይላሉ? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው።

verses.en: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
verses.fr: Ils répondirent: Jean Baptiste; les autres, Elie; les autres, qu''un des anciens prophètes est ressuscité.
verses.am: እነርሱም መልሰው። መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ፥ ሌሎችም። ኤልያስ፥ ሌሎችም። ከቀደሙት ነቢያት አንዱ ተነሥቶአል ይላሉ አሉት።

verses.en: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
verses.fr: Et vous, leur demanda-t-il, qui dites-vous que je suis? Pierre répondit: Le Christ de Dieu.
verses.am: እናንተስ እኔ ማን እንደ ሆንሁ ትላላችሁ? አላቸው። ጴጥሮስም መልሶ። ከእግዚአብሔር የተቀባህ ነህ አለ።

verses.en: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;
verses.fr: Jésus leur recommanda sévèrement de ne le dire à personne.
verses.am: ለሁሉም እንዲህ አላቸው። በኋላዬ ሊመጣ የሚወድ ቢኖር፥ ራሱን ይካድ መስቀሉንም ዕለት ዕለት ተሸክሞ ይከተለኝ።

verses.en: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.
verses.fr: Il ajouta qu''il fallait que le Fils de l''homme souffrît beaucoup, qu''il fût rejeté par les anciens, par les principaux sacrificateurs et par les scribes, qu''il fût mis à mort, et qu''il ressuscitât le troisième jour.
verses.am: ለሁሉም እንዲህ አላቸው። በኋላዬ ሊመጣ የሚወድ ቢኖር፥ ራሱን ይካድ መስቀሉንም ዕለት ዕለት ተሸክሞ ይከተለኝ።

verses.en: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
verses.fr: Puis il dit à tous: Si quelqu''un veut venir après moi, qu''il renonce à lui-même, qu''il se charge chaque jour de sa croix, et qu''il me suive.
verses.am: ነፍሱን ሊያድን የሚወድ ሁሉ ያጠፋታልና፤ ስለ እኔ ነፍሱን የሚያጠፋ ሁሉ ግን እርሱ ያድናታል።

verses.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
verses.fr: Car celui qui voudra sauver sa vie la perdra, mais celui qui la perdra à cause de moi la sauvera.
verses.am: ሰው ዓለሙን ሁሉ አትርፎ ራሱን ቢያጠፋ ወይም ቢያጐድል ምን ይጠቅመዋል?

verses.en: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?
verses.fr: Et que servirait-il à un homme de gagner tout le monde, s''il se détruisait ou se perdait lui-même?
verses.am: በእኔና በቃሌ የሚያፍር ሁሉ፥ የሰው ልጅ በክብሩ በአባቱና በቅዱሳን መላእክቱ ክብርም ሲመጣ በእርሱ ያፍርበታል።

verses.en: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.
verses.fr: Car quiconque aura honte de moi et de mes paroles, le Fils de l''homme aura honte de lui, quand il viendra dans sa gloire, et dans celle du Père et des saints anges.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በዚህ ከሚቆሙት ሰዎች የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት እስኪያዩ ድረስ ሞትን የማይቀምሱ አንዳንድ አሉ።

verses.en: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, quelques-uns de ceux qui sont ici ne mourront point qu''ils n''aient vu le royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: ከዚህም ቃል በኋላ ስምንት ቀን ያህል ቈይቶ ጴጥሮስንና ዮሐንስን ያዕቆብንም ይዞ ሊጸልይ ወደ ተራራ ወጣ።

verses.en: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.
verses.fr: Environ huit jours après qu''il eut dit ces paroles, Jésus prit avec lui Pierre, Jean et Jacques, et il monta sur la montagne pour prier.
verses.am: ሲጸልይም የፊቱ መልክ ተለወጠ፤ ልብሱም ተብለጭልጮ ነጭ ሆነ።

verses.en: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''il priait, l''aspect de son visage changea, et son vêtement devint d''une éclatante blancheur.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ሁለት ሰዎች እነርሱም ሙሴና ኤልያስ ከእርሱ ጋር ይነጋገሩ ነበር፤

verses.en: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:
verses.fr: Et voici, deux hommes s''entretenaient avec lui: c''étaient Moïse et Elie,
verses.am: በክብርም ታይተው በኢየሩሳሌም ሊፈጽም ስላለው ስለ መውጣቱ ይናገሩ ነበር።

verses.en: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
verses.fr: qui, apparaissant dans la gloire, parlaient de son départ qu''il allait accomplir à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ጴጥሮስንና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት እንቅልፍ ከበደባቸው፤ ነቅተው ግን ክብሩንና ከእርሱ ጋር ቆመው የነበሩትን ሁለት ሰዎች አዩ።

verses.en: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
verses.fr: Pierre et ses compagnons étaient appesantis par le sommeil; mais, s''étant tenus éveillés, ils virent la gloire de Jésus et les deux hommes qui étaient avec lui.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ሲለዩ ጴጥሮስ ኢየሱስን። አቤቱ፥ በዚህ መሆን ለእኛ መልካም ነውና አንድ ለአንተ አንድም ለሙሴ አንድም ለኤልያስ ሦስት ዳሶች እንሥራ አለው፤ የሚለውንም አያውቅም ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.
verses.fr: Au moment où ces hommes se séparaient de Jésus, Pierre lui dit: Maître, il est bon que nous soyons ici; dressons trois tentes, une pour toi, une pour Moïse, et une pour Elie. Il ne savait ce qu''il disait.
verses.am: ይህንም ሲናገር ደመና መጣና ጋረዳቸው፤ ወደ ደመናውም ሲገቡ ሳሉ ፈሩ።

verses.en: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
verses.fr: Comme il parlait ainsi, une nuée vint les couvrir; et les disciples furent saisis de frayeur en les voyant entrer dans la nuée.
verses.am: ከደመናውም። የመረጥሁት ልጄ ይህ ነው፥ እርሱን ስሙት የሚል ድምፅ መጣ።

verses.en: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
verses.fr: Et de la nuée sortit une voix, qui dit: Celui-ci est mon Fils élu: écoutez-le!
verses.am: ድምፁም ከመጣ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ብቻውን ሆኖ ተገኘ። እነርሱም ዝም አሉ ካዩትም ነገር በዚያ ወራት ምንም ለማንም አላወሩም።

verses.en: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
verses.fr: Quand la voix se fit entendre, Jésus se trouva seul. Les disciples gardèrent le silence, et ils ne racontèrent à personne, en ce temps-là, rien de ce qu''ils avaient vu.
verses.am: በነገውም ከተራራ ሲወርዱ ብዙ ሕዝብ ተገናኙት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, lorsqu''ils furent descendus de la montagne, une grande foule vint au-devant de Jésus.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ከሕዝቡ አንድ ሰው እንዲህ እያለ ጮኸ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ለእኔ አንድ ልጅ ነውና ልጄን እንድታይልኝ እለምንሃለሁ።

verses.en: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.
verses.fr: Et voici, du milieu de la foule un homme s''écria: Maître, je t''en prie, porte les regards sur mon fils, car c''est mon fils unique.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ጋኔን ይይዘዋል፥ ድንገትም ይጮኻል አረፋም እያስደፈቀው ያንፈራግጠዋል፥ እየቀጠቀጠም በጭንቅ ይለቀዋል፤

verses.en: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.
verses.fr: Un esprit le saisit, et aussitôt il pousse des cris; et l''esprit l''agite avec violence, le fait écumer, et a de la peine à se retirer de lui, après l''avoir tout brisé.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርትህንም እንዲያወጡት ለመንሁ፥ አልቻሉምም።

verses.en: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.
verses.fr: J''ai prié tes disciples de le chasser, et ils n''ont pas pu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እናንተ የማታምን ጠማማ ትውልድ፥ እስከ መቼ ከእናንተ ጋር እኖራለሁ? እስከ መቼስ እታገሣችኋለሁ? ልጅህን ወደዚህ አምጣው አለ።

verses.en: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
verses.fr: Race incrédule et perverse, répondit Jésus, jusqu''à quand serai-je avec vous, et vous supporterai-je? Amène ici ton fils.
verses.am: ሲቀርብም ጋኔኑ ጣለውና አንፈራገጠው፤ ኢየሱስ ግን ርኵሱን መንፈስ ገሥጾ ብላቴናውን ፈወሰው ለአባቱም መለሰው።

verses.en: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
verses.fr: Comme il approchait, le démon le jeta par terre, et l''agita avec violence. Mais Jésus menaça l''esprit impur, guérit l''enfant, et le rendit à son père.
verses.am: ሁሉም ከእግዚአብሔር ታላቅነት የተነሣ ተገረሙ። ሁሉም ኢየሱስ ባደረገው ሁሉ ሲደነቁ፥

verses.en: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
verses.fr: Et tous furent frappés de la grandeur de Dieu. Tandis que chacun était dans l''admiration de tout ce que faisait Jésus, il dit à ses disciples:
verses.am: ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ። የሰው ልጅ በሰው እጅ ይሰጥ ዘንድ አለውና እናንተ ይህን ቃል በጆሮአችሁ አኑሩ አለ።

verses.en: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
verses.fr: Pour vous, écoutez bien ceci: Le Fils de l''homme doit être livré entre les mains des hommes.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን ይህን ነገር አላስተዋሉም፥ እንዳይገባቸውም ተሰውሮባቸው ነበር፤ ስለዚህ ነገርም እንዳይጠይቁት ፈሩ።

verses.en: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.
verses.fr: Mais les disciples ne comprenaient pas cette parole; elle était voilée pour eux, afin qu''ils n''en eussent pas le sens; et ils craignaient de l''interroger à ce sujet.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ማን እንዲበልጥ ክርክር ተነሣባቸው።

verses.en: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
verses.fr: Or, une pensée leur vint à l''esprit, savoir lequel d''entre eux était le plus grand.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም የልባቸውን አሳብ አውቆ ሕፃንን ያዘ፤ በአጠገቡም አቁሞ።

verses.en: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,
verses.fr: Jésus, voyant la pensée de leur coeur, prit un petit enfant, le plaça près de lui,
verses.am: ማንም ይህን ሕፃን በስሜ የሚቀበል እኔን ይቀበላል፤ የሚቀበለኝም ሁሉ የላከኝን ይቀበላል፤ ከሁላችሁ የሚያንስ እርሱ ታላቅ ነውና አላቸው።

verses.en: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.
verses.fr: et leur dit: Quiconque reçoit en mon nom ce petit enfant me reçoit moi-même; et quiconque me reçoit reçoit celui qui m''a envoyé. Car celui qui est le plus petit parmi vous tous, c''est celui-là qui est grand.
verses.am: ዮሐንስም መልሶ። አቤቱ፥ አንድ ሰው በስምህ አጋንንትን ሲያወጣ አየነው፥ ከእኛ ጋርም ስለማይከተል ከለከልነው አለው።

verses.en: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
verses.fr: Jean prit la parole, et dit: Maître, nous avons vu un homme qui chasse des démons en ton nom; et nous l''en avons empêché, parce qu''il ne nous suit pas.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን። የማይቃወማችሁ ከእናንተ ጋር ነውና አትከልክሉት አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.
verses.fr: Ne l''en empêchez pas, lui répondit Jésus; car qui n''est pas contre vous est pour vous.
verses.am: የሚወጣበትም ወራት በቀረበ ጊዜ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ለመሄድ ፊቱን አቀና፥

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
verses.fr: Lorsque le temps où il devait être enlevé du monde approcha, Jésus prit la résolution de se rendre à Jérusalem.
verses.am: በፊቱም መልክተኞችን ሰደደ። ሄደውም ሊያሰናዱለት ወደ አንድ ወደ ሳምራውያን መንደር ገቡ፤

verses.en: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
verses.fr: Il envoya devant lui des messagers, qui se mirent en route et entrèrent dans un bourg des Samaritains, pour lui préparer un logement.
verses.am: ፊቱም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንደሚሄድ ስለ ነበረ አልተቀበሉትም።

verses.en: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Mais on ne le reçut pas, parce qu''il se dirigeait sur Jérusalem.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ያዕቆብና ዮሐንስ አይተው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ኤልያስ ደግሞ እንዳደረገ እሳት ከሰማይ ወርዶ ያጥፋቸው እንል ዘንድ ትወዳለህን? አሉት።

verses.en: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
verses.fr: Les disciples Jacques et Jean, voyant cela, dirent: Seigneur, veux-tu que nous commandions que le feu descende du ciel et les consume?
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ዘወር ብሎ ገሠጻቸውና። ምን ዓይነት መንፈስ እንደ ሆነላችሁ አታውቁም፤

verses.en: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.
verses.fr: Jésus se tourna vers eux, et les réprimanda, disant: Vous ne savez de quel esprit vous êtes animés.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ የሰውን ነፍስ ሊያድን እንጂ ሊያጠፋ አልመጣም አለ። ወደ ሌላ መንደርም ሄዱ።

verses.en: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.
verses.fr: Car le Fils de l''homme est venu, non pour perdre les âmes des hommes, mais pour les sauver. Et ils allèrent dans un autre bourg.
verses.am: እነርሱም በመንገድ ሲሄዱ አንድ ሰው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወደ ምትሄድበት ሁሉ እከተልሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''ils étaient en chemin, un homme lui dit: Seigneur, je te suivrai partout où tu iras.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ለቀበሮዎች ጕድጓድ ለሰማይም ወፎች መሳፈሪያ አላቸው፥ ለሰው ልጅ ግን ራሱን የሚያስጠጋበት የለውም አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Les renards ont des tanières, et les oiseaux du ciel ont des nids: mais le Fils de l''homme n''a pas un lieu où il puisse reposer sa tête.
verses.am: ሌላውንም። ተከተለኝ አለው። እርሱ ግን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አስቀድሜ ልሂድና አባቴን እቀብር ዘንድ ፍቀድልኝ አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.fr: Il dit à un autre: Suis-moi. Et il répondit: Seigneur, permets-moi d''aller d''abord ensevelir mon père.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ሙታናቸውን እንዲቀብሩ ሙታንን ተዋቸው፤ አንተስ ሄደህ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ስበክ አለው።

verses.en: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus lui dit: Laisse les morts ensevelir leurs morts; et toi, va annoncer le royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: ደግሞ ሌላው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እከተልሃለሁ፤ ነገር ግን አስቀድሜ ከቤቴ ሰዎች እንድሰናበት ፍቀድልኝ አለ።

verses.en: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
verses.fr: Un autre dit: Je te suivrai, Seigneur, mais permets-moi d''aller d''abord prendre congé de ceux de ma maison.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን። ማንም ዕርፍ በእጁ ይዞ ወደ ኋላ የሚመለከት ለእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት የተገባ አይደለም አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Quiconque met la main à la charrue, et regarde en arrière, n''est pas propre au royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን። ማንም ዕርፍ በእጁ ይዞ ወደ ኋላ የሚመለከት ለእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት የተገባ አይደለም አለው።

verses.en: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
