verses.fr: et, de retour à la maison, il appelle ses amis et ses voisins, et leur dit: Réjouissez-vous avec moi, car j''ai retrouvé ma brebis qui était perdue.
verses.am: ወደ ቤትም በመጣ ጊዜ ወዳጆቹንና ጐረቤቶቹን በአንድነት ጠርቶ። የጠፋውን በጌን አግኝቼዋለሁና ከእኔ ጋር ደስ ይበላችሁ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
verses.fr: De même, je vous le dis, il y aura plus de joie dans le ciel pour un seul pécheur qui se repent, que pour quatre-vingt-dix-neuf justes qui n''ont pas besoin de repentance.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ እንዲሁ ንስሐ ከማያስፈልጋቸው ከዘጠና ዘጠኝ ጻድቃን ይልቅ ንስሐ በሚገባ በአንድ ኃጢአተኛ በሰማይ ደስታ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?
verses.fr: Ou quelle femme, si elle a dix drachmes, et qu''elle en perde une, n''allume une lampe, ne balaie la maison, et ne cherche avec soin, jusqu''à ce qu''elle la retrouve?
verses.am: ወይም አሥር ድሪም ያላት አንድ ድሪም ቢጠፋባት፥ መብራት አብርታ ቤትዋንም ጠርጋ እስክታገኘው ድረስ አጥብቃ የማትፈልግ ሴት ማን ናት?

verses.en: And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''elle l''a retrouvée, elle appelle ses amies et ses voisines, et dit: Réjouissez-vous avec moi, car j''ai retrouvé la drachme que j''avais perdue.
verses.am: ባገኘችውም ጊዜ ወዳጆችዋንና ጐረቤቶችዋን በአንድነት ጠርታ። የጠፋውን ድሪሜን አግኝቼዋለሁና ከእኔ ጋር ደስ ይበላችሁ ትላቸዋለች።

verses.en: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.
verses.fr: De même, je vous le dis, il y a de la joie devant les anges de Dieu pour un seul pécheur qui se repent.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ እንዲሁ ንስሐ በሚገባ በአንድ ኃጢአተኛ በእግዚአብሔር መላእክት ፊት ደስታ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And he said, A certain man had two sons:
verses.fr: Il dit encore: Un homme avait deux fils.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። አንድ ሰው ሁለት ልጆች ነበሩት።

verses.en: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.
verses.fr: Le plus jeune dit à son père: Mon père, donne-moi la part de bien qui doit me revenir. Et le père leur partagea son bien.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ታናሹ አባቱን። አባቴ ሆይ፥ ከገንዘብህ የሚደርሰኝን ክፍል ስጠኝ አለው። ገንዘቡንም አካፈላቸው።

verses.en: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.
verses.fr: Peu de jours après, le plus jeune fils, ayant tout ramassé, partit pour un pays éloigné, où il dissipa son bien en vivant dans la débauche.
verses.am: ከጥቂት ቀንም በኋላ ታናሹ ልጅ ገንዘቡን ሁሉ ሰብስቦ ወደ ሩቅ አገር ሄደ፥ ከዚያም እያባከነ ገዘቡን በተነ።

verses.en: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il eut tout dépensé, une grande famine survint dans ce pays, et il commença à se trouver dans le besoin.
verses.am: ሁሉንም ከከሰረ በኋላ በዚያች አገር ጽኑ ራብ ሆነ፥ እርሱም ይጨነቅ ጀመር።

verses.en: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
verses.fr: Il alla se mettre au service d''un des habitants du pays, qui l''envoya dans ses champs garder les pourceaux.
verses.am: ሄዶም ከዚያች አገር ሰዎች ከአንዱ ጋር ተዳበለ፥ እርሱም እሪያ ሊያሰማራ ወደ ሜዳ ሰደደው።

verses.en: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
verses.fr: Il aurait bien voulu se rassasier des carouges que mangeaient les pourceaux, mais personne ne lui en donnait.
verses.am: እሪያዎችም ከሚበሉት አሰር ሊጠግብ ይመኝ ነበር፥ የሚሰጠውም አልነበረም።

verses.en: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
verses.fr: Etant rentré en lui-même, il se dit: Combien de mercenaires chez mon père ont du pain en abondance, et moi, ici, je meurs de faim!
verses.am: ወደ ልቡም ተመልሶ እንዲህ አለ። እንጀራ የሚተርፋቸው የአባቴ ሞያተኞች ስንት ናቸው? እኔ ግን ከዚህ በራብ እጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
verses.fr: Je me lèverai, j''irai vers mon père, et je lui dirai: Mon père, j''ai péché contre le ciel et contre toi,
verses.am: ተነሥቼም ወደ አባቴ እሄዳለሁና። አባቴ ሆይ፥ በሰማይና በፊትህ በደልሁ፥

verses.en: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.
verses.fr: je ne suis plus digne d''être appelé ton fils; traite-moi comme l''un de tes mercenaires.
verses.am: ወደ ፊትም ልጅህ ልባል አይገባኝም፤ ከሞያተኞችህ እንደ አንዱ አድርገኝ እለዋለሁ።

verses.en: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
verses.fr: Et il se leva, et alla vers son père. Comme il était encore loin, son père le vit et fut ému de compassion, il courut se jeter à son cou et le baisa.
verses.am: ተነሥቶም ወደ አባቱ መጣ። እርሱም ገና ሩቅ ሳለ አባቱ አየውና አዘነለት፥ ሮጦም አንገቱን አቀፈውና ሳመው።

verses.en: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
verses.fr: Le fils lui dit: Mon père, j''ai péché contre le ciel et contre toi, je ne suis plus digne d''être appelé ton fils.
verses.am: ልጁም። አባቴ ሆይ፥ በሰማይና በፊትህ በደልሁ፥ ወደ ፊትም ልጅህ ልባል አይገባኝም አለው።

verses.en: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:
verses.fr: Mais le père dit à ses serviteurs: Apportez vite la plus belle robe, et l''en revêtez; mettez-lui un anneau au doigt, et des souliers aux pieds.
verses.am: አባቱ ግን ባሪያዎቹን አለ። ፈጥናችሁ ከሁሉ የተሻለ ልብስ አምጡና አልብሱት፥ ለእጁ ቀለበት ለእግሩም ጫማ ስጡ፤

verses.en: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:
verses.fr: Amenez le veau gras, et tuez-le. Mangeons et réjouissons-nous;
verses.am: የሰባውን ፊሪዳ አምጥታችሁ እረዱት፥ እንብላም ደስም ይበለን፤

verses.en: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
verses.fr: car mon fils que voici était mort, et il est revenu à la vie; il était perdu, et il est retrouvé. Et ils commencèrent à se réjouir.
verses.am: ይህ ልጄ ሞቶ ነበርና ደግሞም ሕያው ሆኖአል፤ ጠፍቶም ነበር ተገኝቶአልም። ደስም ይላቸው ጀመር።

verses.en: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.
verses.fr: Or, le fils aîné était dans les champs. Lorsqu''il revint et approcha de la maison, il entendit la musique et les danses.
verses.am: ታላቁ ልጁ በእርሻ ነበረ፤ መጥቶም ወደ ቤት በቀረበ ጊዜ የመሰንቆና የዘፈን ድምፅ ሰማ፤

verses.en: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.
verses.fr: Il appela un des serviteurs, et lui demanda ce que c''était.
verses.am: ከብላቴናዎችም አንዱን ጠርቶ። ይህ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ ጠየቀ።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.
verses.fr: Ce serviteur lui dit: Ton frère est de retour, et, parce qu''il l''a retrouvé en bonne santé, ton père a tué le veau gras.
verses.am: እርሱም። ወንድምህ መጥቶአልና በደኅና ስላገኘው አባትህ የሰባውን ፊሪዳ አረደለት አለው።

verses.en: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.
verses.fr: Il se mit en colère, et ne voulut pas entrer. Son père sortit, et le pria d''entrer.
verses.am: ተቈጣም ሊገባም አልወደደም፤ አባቱም ወጥቶ ለመነው።

verses.en: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:
verses.fr: Mais il répondit à son père: Voici, il y a tant d''années que je te sers, sans avoir jamais transgressé tes ordres, et jamais tu ne m''as donné un chevreau pour que je me réjouisse avec mes amis.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ አባቱን። እነሆ፥ ይህን ያህል ዓመት እንደ ባሪያ ተገዝቼልሃለሁ ከትእዛዝህም ከቶ አልተላለፍሁም፤ ለእኔም ከወዳጆቼ ጋር ደስ እንዲለኝ አንድ ጥቦት ስንኳ አልሰጠኸኝም፤

verses.en: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.
verses.fr: Et quand ton fils est arrivé, celui qui a mangé ton bien avec des prostituées, c''est pour lui que tu as tué le veau gras!
verses.am: ነገር ግን ገንዘብህን ከጋለሞቶች ጋር በልቶ ይህ ልጅህ በመጣ ጊዜ፥ የሰባውን ፊሪዳ አረድህለት አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.
verses.fr: Mon enfant, lui dit le père, tu es toujours avec moi, et tout ce que j''ai est à toi;
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። ልጄ ሆይ፥ አንተ ሁልጊዜ ከእኔ ጋር ነህ፥ ለእኔም የሆነ ሁሉ የአንተ ነው፤

verses.en: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
verses.fr: mais il fallait bien s''égayer et se réjouir, parce que ton frère que voici était mort et qu''il est revenu à la vie, parce qu''il était perdu et qu''il est retrouvé.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን ይህ ወንድምህ ሞቶ ነበረ ሕያው ስለ ሆነ ጠፍቶም ነበር ስለ ተገኘ ደስ እንዲለን ፍሥሐም እንድናደርግ ይገባናል አለው።

verses.en: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.
verses.fr: Jésus dit aussi à ses disciples: Un homme riche avait un économe, qui lui fut dénoncé comme dissipant ses biens.
verses.am: ደግሞም ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንዲህ አለ። መጋቢ የነበረው አንድ ባለ ጠጋ ሰው ነበረ፥ በእርሱ ዘንድ። ይህ ሰው ያለህን ይበትናል ብለው ከሰሱት።

verses.en: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.
verses.fr: Il l''appela, et lui dit: Qu''est-ce que j''entends dire de toi? Rends compte de ton administration, car tu ne pourras plus administrer mes biens.
verses.am: ጠርቶም። ይህ የምሰማብህ ምንድር ነው? ወደ ፊት ለእኔ መጋቢ ልትሆን አትችልምና የመጋቢነትህን ሂሳብ አስረክበኝ አለው።

verses.en: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.
verses.fr: L''économe dit en lui-même: Que ferai-je, puisque mon maître m''ôte l''administration de ses biens? Travailler à la terre? je ne le puis. Mendier? j''en ai honte.
verses.am: መጋቢውም በልቡ። ጌታዬ መጋቢነቱን ከእኔ ይወስዳልና ምን ላድርግ? ለመቈፈር ኃይል የለኝም፥ መለመንም አፍራለሁ።

verses.en: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
verses.fr: Je sais ce que je ferai, pour qu''il y ait des gens qui me reçoivent dans leurs maisons quand je serai destitué de mon emploi.
verses.am: ከመጋቢነቱ ብሻር በቤታቸው እንዲቀበሉኝ የማደርገውን አውቃለሁ አለ።

verses.en: So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
verses.fr: Et, faisant venir chacun des débiteurs de son maître, il dit au premier: Combien dois-tu à mon maître?
verses.am: የጌታውንም ባለ ዕዳዎች እያንዳንዳቸውን ጠርቶ የፊተኛውን። ለጌታዬ ምን ያህል ዕዳ አለብህ? አለው።

verses.en: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.
verses.fr: Cent mesures d''huile, répondit-il. Et il lui dit: Prends ton billet, assieds-toi vite, et écris cinquante.
verses.am: እርሱም። መቶ ማድጋ ዘይት አለ። ደብዳቤህን እንካ ፈጥነህም ተቀምጠህ አምሳ ብለህ ጻፍ አለው።

verses.en: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.
verses.fr: Il dit ensuite à un autre: Et toi, combien dois-tu? Cent mesures de blé, répondit-il. Et il lui dit: Prends ton billet, et écris quatre-vingts.
verses.am: በኋላም ሌላውን። አንተስ ስንት ዕዳ አለብህ? አለው። እርሱም። መቶ ጫን ስንዴ አለ። ደብዳቤህን እንካ ሰማንያ ብለህም ጻፍ አለው።

verses.en: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.
verses.fr: Le maître loua l''économe infidèle de ce qu''il avait agi prudemment. Car les enfants de ce siècle sont plus prudents à l''égard de leurs semblables que ne le sont les enfants de lumière.
verses.am: ጌታውም ዓመፀኛውን መጋቢ በልባምነት ስላደረገ አመሰገነው የዚህ ዓለም ልጆች ለትውልዳቸው ከብርሃን ልጆች ይልቅ ልባሞች ናቸውና።

verses.en: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.
verses.fr: Et moi, je vous dis: Faites-vous des amis avec les richesses injustes, pour qu''ils vous reçoivent dans les tabernacles éternels, quand elles viendront à vous manquer.
verses.am: እኔም እላችኋለሁ፥ የዓመፃ ገንዘብ ሲያልቅ በዘላለም ቤቶች እንዲቀበሉአችሁ፥ በእርሱ ወዳጆችን ለራሳችሁ አድርጉ።

verses.en: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
verses.fr: Celui qui est fidèle dans les moindres choses l''est aussi dans les grandes, et celui qui est injuste dans les moindres choses l''est aussi dans les grandes.
verses.am: ከሁሉ በሚያንስ የታመነ በብዙ ደግሞ የታመነ ነው፥ ከሁሉ በሚያንስም የሚያምፅ በብዙ ደግሞ ዓመፀኛ ነው።

verses.en: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
verses.fr: Si donc vous n''avez pas été fidèles dans les richesses injustes, qui vous confiera les véritables?
verses.am: እንግዲያስ በዓመፃ ገንዘብ ካልታመናችሁ፥ እውነተኛውን ገንዘብ ማን አደራ ይሰጣችኋል?

verses.en: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?
verses.fr: Et si vous n''avez pas été fidèles dans ce qui est à autrui, qui vous donnera ce qui est à vous?
verses.am: በሌላ ሰው ገንዘብ ካልታመናችሁ፥ የእናንተን ማን ይሰጣችኋል?

verses.en: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
verses.fr: Nul serviteur ne peut servir deux maîtres. Car, ou il haïra l''un et aimera l''autre; ou il s''attachera à l''un et méprisera l''autre. Vous ne pouvez servir Dieu et Mamon.
verses.am: ለሁለት ጌቶች መገዛት የሚቻለው ባርያ ማንም የለም፤ ወይም አንዱን ይጠላልና ሁለተኛውንም ይወዳል፥ ወይም ወደ አንዱ ይጠጋል ሁለተኛውንም ይንቃል። ለእግዚአብሔርና ለገንዘብ መገዛት አትችሉም።

verses.en: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.
verses.fr: Les pharisiens, qui étaient avares, écoutaient aussi tout cela, et ils se moquaient de lui.
verses.am: ገንዘብንም የሚወዱ ፈሪሳውያን ይህን ሁሉ ሰምተው ያፌዙበት ነበር።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Vous, vous cherchez à paraître justes devant les hommes, mais Dieu connaît vos coeurs; car ce qui est élevé parmi les hommes est une abomination devant Dieu.
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። ራሳችሁን በሰው ፊት የምታጸድቁ እናንተ ናችሁ፥ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ልባችሁን ያውቃል፤ በሰው ዘንድ የከበረ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ርኵሰት ነውና።

verses.en: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.
verses.fr: La loi et les prophètes ont subsisté jusqu''à Jean; depuis lors, le royaume de Dieu est annoncé, et chacun use de violence pour y entrer.
verses.am: ሕግና ነቢያት እስከ ዮሐንስ ነበሩ፤ ከዚያ ጀምሮ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ይሰበካል፤ ሁሉም ወደ እርስዋ በኃይል ይገቡባታል።

verses.en: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.
verses.fr: Il est plus facile que le ciel et la terre passent, qu''il ne l''est qu''un seul trait de lettre de la loi vienne à tomber.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከሕግ አንዲት ነጥብ ከምትወድቅ ሰማይና ምድር ሊያልፍ ይቀላል።

verses.en: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.
verses.fr: Quiconque répudie sa femme et en épouse une autre commet un adultère, et quiconque épouse une femme répudiée par son mari commet un adultère.
verses.am: ሚስቱንም የሚፈታ ሁሉ ሌላይቱንም የሚያገባ ያመነዝራል፥ ከባልዋም የተፈታችውን የሚያገባ ያመነዝራል።

verses.en: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:
verses.fr: Il y avait un homme riche, qui était vêtu de pourpre et de fin lin, et qui chaque jour menait joyeuse et brillante vie.
verses.am: ቀይ ልብስና ቀጭን የተልባ እግር የለበሰ አንድ ባለ ጠጋ ሰው ነበረ፥ ዕለት ዕለትም እየተመቸው በደስታ ይኖር ነበር።

verses.en: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,
verses.fr: Un pauvre, nommé Lazare, était couché à sa porte, couvert d''ulcères,
verses.am: አልዓዛርም የሚባል አንድ ድሀ በቍስል ተወርሶ በደጁ ተኝቶ ነበር፥

verses.en: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
verses.fr: et désireux de se rassasier des miettes qui tombaient de la table du riche; et même les chiens venaient encore lécher ses ulcères.
verses.am: ከባለ ጠጋውም ማዕድ ከሚወድቀው ፍርፋሪ ሊጠግብ ይመኝ ነበር፤ ውሾች እንኳ መጥተው ቍስሎቹን ይልሱ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;
verses.fr: Le pauvre mourut, et il fut porté par les anges dans le sein d''Abraham. Le riche mourut aussi, et il fut enseveli.
verses.am: ድሀውም ሞተ፥ መላእክትም ወደ አብርሃም እቅፍ ወሰዱት፤ ባለ ጠጋው ደግሞ ሞተና ተቀበረ።

verses.en: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
verses.fr: Dans le séjour des morts, il leva les yeux; et, tandis qu''il était en proie aux tourments, il vit de loin Abraham, et Lazare dans son sein.
verses.am: በሲኦልም በሥቃይ ሳለ አሻቅቦ አብርሃምን በሩቅ አየ አልዓዛርንም በእቅፉ።

verses.en: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.
verses.fr: Il s''écria: Père Abraham, aie pitié de moi, et envoie Lazare, pour qu''il trempe le bout de son doigt dans l''eau et me rafraîchisse la langue; car je souffre cruellement dans cette flamme.
verses.am: እርሱም እየጮኸ። አብርሃም አባት ሆይ፥ ማረኝ፥ በዚህ ነበልባል እሣቀያለሁና የጣቱን ጫፍ በውኃ ነክሮ መላሴን እንዲያበርድልኝ አልዓዛርን ስደድልኝ አለ።

verses.en: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.
verses.fr: Abraham répondit: Mon enfant, souviens-toi que tu as reçu tes biens pendant ta vie, et que Lazare a eu les maux pendant la sienne; maintenant il est ici consolé, et toi, tu souffres.
verses.am: አብርሃም ግን። ልጄ ሆይ፥ አንተ በሕይወትህ ሳለህ መልካም እንደ ተቀበልህ አስብ አልዓዛርም እንዲሁ ክፉ፤ አሁን ግን እርሱ በዚህ ይጽናናል አንተም ትሣቀያለህ።

verses.en: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.
verses.fr: D''ailleurs, il y a entre nous et vous un grand abîme, afin que ceux qui voudraient passer d''ici vers vous, ou de là vers nous, ne puissent le faire.
verses.am: ከዚህም ሁሉ ጋር ከዚህ ወደ እናንተ ሊያልፉ የሚፈልጉ እንዳይችሉ፥ ወዲያ ያሉ ደግሞ ወደ እኛ እንዳይሻገሩ በእኛና በእናንተ መካከል ታላቅ ገደል ተደርጎአል አለ።

verses.en: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:
verses.fr: Le riche dit: Je te prie donc, père Abraham, d''envoyer Lazare dans la maison de mon père;
verses.am: እርሱም። እንኪያስ፥ አባት ሆይ፥ ወደ አባቴ ቤት እንድትሰደው እለምንሃለሁ፤ አምስት ወንድሞች አሉኝና፤

verses.en: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
verses.fr: car j''ai cinq frères. C''est pour qu''il leur atteste ces choses, afin qu''ils ne viennent pas aussi dans ce lieu de tourments.
verses.am: እነርሱ ደግሞ ወደዚህ ሥቃይ ስፍራ እንዳይመጡ ይመስክርላቸው አለ።

verses.en: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.
verses.fr: Abraham répondit: Ils ont Moïse et les prophètes; qu''ils les écoutent.
verses.am: አብርሃም ግን። ሙሴና ነቢያት አሉአቸው፤ እነርሱን ይስሙ አለው።

verses.en: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Non, père Abraham, mais si quelqu''un des morts va vers eux, ils se repentiront.
verses.am: እርሱም። አይደለም፥ አብርሃም አባት ሆይ፥ ነገር ግን ከሙታን አንዱ ቢሄድላቸው ንስሐ ይገባሉ አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.
verses.fr: Et Abraham lui dit: S''ils n''écoutent pas Moïse et les prophètes, ils ne se laisseront pas persuader quand même quelqu''un des morts ressusciterait.
verses.am: ሙሴንና ነቢያትንም የማይሰሙ ከሆነ፥ ከሙታንም እንኳ አንድ ቢነሣ አያምኑም አለው።

verses.en: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!
verses.fr: Jésus dit à ses disciples: Il est impossible qu''il n''arrive pas des scandales; mais malheur à celui par qui ils arrivent!
verses.am: ለደቀ መዛሙርቱም እንዲህ አለ። መሰናክል ግድ ሳይመጣ አይቀርም፥ ነገር ግን መሰናክሉን ለሚያመጣው ወዮለት፤

verses.en: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
verses.fr: Il vaudrait mieux pour lui qu''on mît à son cou une pierre de moulin et qu''on le jetât dans la mer, que s''il scandalisait un de ces petits.
verses.am: ከእነዚህ ከታናናሾች አንዱን ከማሰናከል ይልቅ የወፍጮ ድንጋይ በአንገቱ ታስሮ ወደ ባሕር ቢጣል ይጠቅመው ነበር።

verses.en: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
verses.fr: Prenez garde à vous-mêmes. Si ton frère a péché, reprends-le; et, s''il se repent, pardonne-lui.
verses.am: ለራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ። ወንድምህ ቢበድልህ ገሥጸው፥ ቢጸጸትም ይቅር በለው።

verses.en: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.
verses.fr: Et s''il a péché contre toi sept fois dans un jour et que sept fois il revienne à toi, disant: Je me repens, -tu lui pardonneras.
verses.am: በቀንም ሰባት ጊዜ እንኳ ቢበድልህ በቀንም ሰባት ጊዜ። ተጸጸትሁ እያለ ወደ አንተ ቢመለስ፥ ይቅር በለው።

verses.en: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.
verses.fr: Les apôtres dirent au Seigneur: Augmente-nous la foi.
verses.am: ሐዋርያትም ጌታን። እምነት ጨምርልን አሉት።

verses.en: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.
verses.fr: Et le Seigneur dit: Si vous aviez de la foi comme un grain de sénevé, vous diriez à ce sycomore: Déracine-toi, et plante-toi dans la mer; et il vous obéirait.
verses.am: ጌታም አለ። የሰናፍጭ ቅንጣት የሚያህል እምነት ቢኖራችሁ፥ ይህን ሾላ። ተነቅለህ ወደ ባሕር ተተከል ብትሉት፥ ይታዘዝላችሁ ነበር።

verses.en: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?
verses.fr: Qui de vous, ayant un serviteur qui laboure ou paît les troupeaux, lui dira, quand il revient des champs: Approche vite, et mets-toi à table?
verses.am: ከእናንተም የሚያርስ ወይም ከብትን የሚጠብቅ ባሪያ ያለው፥ ከእርሻ ሲመለስ። ወዲያው ቅረብና በማዕድ ተቀመጥ የሚለው ማን ነው?

verses.en: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
verses.fr: Ne lui dira-t-il pas au contraire: Prépare-moi à souper, ceins-toi, et sers-moi, jusqu''à ce que j''aie mangé et bu; après cela, toi, tu mangeras et boiras?
verses.am: የምበላውን እራቴን አሰናዳልኝ፥ እስክበላና እስክጠጣ ድረስ ታጥቀህ አገልግለኝ፥ በኋላም አንተ ብላና ጠጣ የሚለው አይደለምን?

verses.en: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.
verses.fr: Doit-il de la reconnaissance à ce serviteur parce qu''il a fait ce qui lui était ordonné?
verses.am: ያንን ባሪያ ያዘዘውን ስላደረገ ያመሰግነዋልን?

verses.en: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.
verses.fr: Vous de même, quand vous avez fait tout ce qui vous a été ordonné, dites: Nous sommes des serviteurs inutiles, nous avons fait ce que nous devions faire.
verses.am: እንዲሁ እናንተ ደግሞ የታዘዛችሁትን ሁሉ ባደረጋችሁ ጊዜ። የማንጠቅም ባሪያዎች ነን፥ ልናደርገው የሚገባንን አድርገናል በሉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
verses.fr: Jésus, se rendant à Jérusalem, passait entre la Samarie et la Galilée.
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ሲሄድ በገሊላና በሰማርያ መካከል አለፈ።

verses.en: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:
verses.fr: Comme il entrait dans un village, dix lépreux vinrent à sa rencontre. Se tenant à distance,
verses.am: ወደ አንዲት መንደርም ሲገባ በሩቅ የቆሙት አሥር ለምጻሞች ተገናኙት፤

verses.en: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.
verses.fr: ils élevèrent la voix, et dirent: Jésus, maître, aie pitié de nous!
verses.am: እነርሱም እየጮኹ። ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ አቤቱ፥ ማረን አሉ።

verses.en: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.
verses.fr: Dès qu''il les eut vus, il leur dit: Allez vous montrer aux sacrificateurs. Et, pendant qu''ils y allaient, il arriva qu''ils furent guéris.
verses.am: አይቶም። ሂዱ፥ ራሳችሁን ለካህናት አሳዩ አላቸው።

verses.en: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,
verses.fr: L''un d''eux, se voyant guéri, revint sur ses pas, glorifiant Dieu à haute voix.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ሲሄዱ ነጹ። ከእነርሱም አንዱ እንደ ተፈወሰ ባየ ጊዜ በታላቅ ድምፅ እግዚአብሔርን እያከበረ ተመለሰ፥

verses.en: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
verses.fr: Il tomba sur sa face aux pieds de Jésus, et lui rendit grâces. C''était un Samaritain.
verses.am: እያመሰገነውም በእግሩ ፊት በግንባሩ ወደቀ፤ እርሱም ሳምራዊ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
verses.fr: Jésus, prenant la parole, dit: Les dix n''ont-ils pas été guéris? Et les neuf autres, où sont-ils?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። አሥሩ አልነጹምን? ዘጠኙስ ወዴት አሉ?

verses.en: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.
verses.fr: Ne s''est-il trouvé que cet étranger pour revenir et donner gloire à Dieu?
verses.am: ከዚህ ከልዩ ወገን በቀር እግዚአብሔርን ሊያከብሩ የተመለሱ አልተገኙም አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
verses.fr: Puis il lui dit: Lève-toi, va; ta foi t''a sauvé.
verses.am: እርሱንም። ተነሣና ሂድ፤ እምነትህ አድኖሃል አለው።

verses.en: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:
verses.fr: Les pharisiens demandèrent à Jésus quand viendrait le royaume de Dieu. Il leur répondit: Le royaume de Dieu ne vient pas de manière à frapper les regards.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም። የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት መቼ ትመጣለች ብለው ቢጠይቁት፥ መልሶ። የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት በመጠባበቅ አትመጣም፤

verses.en: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
verses.fr: On ne dira point: Il est ici, ou: Il est là. Car voici, le royaume de Dieu est au milieu de vous.
verses.am: ደግሞም። እንኋት በዚህ ወይም። እንኋት በዚያ አይሉአትም። እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት በመካከላችሁ ናትና አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.
verses.fr: Et il dit aux disciples: Des jours viendront où vous désirerez voir l''un des jours du Fils de l''homme, et vous ne le verrez point.
verses.am: ለደቀ መዛሙርቱም እንዲህ አለ። ከሰው ልጅ ቀኖች አንዱን ልታዩ የምትመኙበት ወራት ይመጣል አታዩትምም።

verses.en: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.
verses.fr: On vous dira: Il est ici, il est là. N''y allez pas, ne courez pas après.
verses.am: እነርሱም። እነሆ በዚህ፥ ወይም። እነሆ በዚያ ይሉአችኋል፤ አትሂዱ አትከተሉአቸውም።

verses.en: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.
verses.fr: Car, comme l''éclair resplendit et brille d''une extrémité du ciel à l''autre, ainsi sera le Fils de l''homme en son jour.
verses.am: መብረቅ በርቆ ከሰማይ በታች ካለ ከአንድ አገር ከሰማይ በታች ወዳለው ወደ ሌላ አገር እንደሚያበራ፥ የሰው ልጅ በቀኑ እንዲህ ይሆናል።

verses.en: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.
verses.fr: Mais il faut auparavant qu''il souffre beaucoup, et qu''il soit rejeté par cette génération.
verses.am: አስቀድሞ ግን ብዙ መከራ እንዲቀበል ከዚህም ትውልድ እንዲጣል ይገባዋል።

verses.en: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
verses.fr: Ce qui arriva du temps de Noé arrivera de même aux jours du Fils de l''homme.
verses.am: በኖኅ ዘመንም እንደ ሆነ፥ በሰው ልጅ ዘመን ደግሞ እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
verses.fr: Les hommes mangeaient, buvaient, se mariaient et mariaient leurs enfants, jusqu''au jour où Noé entra dans l''arche; le déluge vint, et les fit tous périr.
verses.am: ኖኅ ወደ መርከብ እስከ ገባበት ቀን ድረስ፥ ይበሉና ይጠጡ ያገቡና ይጋቡም ነበር፥ የጥፋት ውኃም መጣ ሁሉንም አጠፋ።

verses.en: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
verses.fr: Ce qui arriva du temps de Lot arrivera pareillement. Les hommes mangeaient, buvaient, achetaient, vendaient, plantaient, bâtissaient;
verses.am: እንዲሁ በሎጥ ዘመን እንደ ሆነ፤ ይበሉ ይጠጡም ይገዙም ይሸጡም ይተክሉም ቤትም ይሠሩ ነበር፤

verses.en: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.
verses.fr: mais le jour où Lot sortit de Sodome, une pluie de feu et de soufre tomba du ciel, et les fit tous périr.
verses.am: ሎጥ ከሰዶም በወጣበት ቀን ግን ከሰማይ እሳትና ዲን ዘነበ ሁሉንም አጠፋ።

verses.en: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
verses.fr: Il en sera de même le jour où le Fils de l''homme paraîtra.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ በሚገለጥበት ቀን እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, que celui qui sera sur le toit, et qui aura ses effets dans la maison, ne descende pas pour les prendre; et que celui qui sera dans les champs ne retourne pas non plus en arrière.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን በሰገነት ያለ በቤቱ ያለውን ዕቃ ሊወስድ አይውረድ፥ እንዲሁም በእርሻ ያለ ወደ ኋላው አይመለስ።

verses.en: Remember Lot's wife.
verses.fr: Souvenez-vous de la femme de Lot.
verses.am: የሎጥን ሚስት አስቡአት።

verses.en: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.
verses.fr: Celui qui cherchera à sauver sa vie la perdra, et celui qui la perdra la retrouvera.
verses.am: ነፍሱን ሊያድን የሚፈልግ ሁሉ ያጠፋታል፥ ነፍሱንም የሚያጠፋ ሁሉ በሕይወት ይጠብቃታል።

verses.en: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis, en cette nuit-là, de deux personnes qui seront dans un même lit, l''une sera prise et l''autre laissée;
verses.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ በዚያች ሌሊት ሁለት ሰዎች በአንድ አልጋ ይሆናሉ፤ አንዱ ይወሰዳል ሁለተኛውም ይቀራል።

verses.en: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.fr: de deux femmes qui moudront ensemble, l''une sera prise et l''autre laissée.
verses.am: ሁለት ሴቶች በአንድ ወፍጮ ይፈጫሉ፤ አንዲቱ ትወሰዳለች ሁለተኛይቱም ትቀራለች።

verses.en: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.fr: De deux hommes qui seront dans un champ, l''un sera pris et l''autre laissé.
verses.am: ሁለት ሰዎች በእርሻ ይሆናሉ፤ አንዱ ይወሰዳል ሁለተኛውም ይቀራል።

verses.en: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.
verses.fr: Les disciples lui dirent: Où sera-ce, Seigneur? Et il répondit: Où sera le corps, là s''assembleront les aigles.
verses.am: መልሰውም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወዴት ነው? አሉት። እርሱም። ሥጋ ወዳለበት በዚያ አሞራዎች ይሰበሰባሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
verses.fr: Jésus leur adressa une parabole, pour montrer qu''il faut toujours prier, et ne point se relâcher.
verses.am: ሳይታክቱም ዘወትር ሊጸልዩ እንዲገባቸው የሚል ምሳሌን ነገራቸው፥

verses.en: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:
verses.fr: Il dit: Il y avait dans une ville un juge qui ne craignait point Dieu et qui n''avait d''égard pour personne.
verses.am: እንዲህ ሲል። በአንዲት ከተማ እግዚአብሔርን የማይፈራ ሰውንም የማያፍር አንድ ዳኛ ነበረ።

verses.en: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
verses.fr: Il y avait aussi dans cette ville une veuve qui venait lui dire: Fais-moi justice de ma partie adverse.
verses.am: በዚያችም ከተማ አንዲት መበለት ነበረች፥ ወደ እርሱም እየመጣች። ከባላጋራዬ ፍረድልኝ ትለው ነበር።

verses.en: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
verses.fr: Pendant longtemps il refusa. Mais ensuite il dit en lui-même: Quoique je ne craigne point Dieu et que je n''aie d''égard pour personne,
verses.am: አያሌ ቀንም አልወደደም፤ ከዚህ በኋላ ግን በልቡ። ምንም እግዚአብሔርን ባልፈራ ሰውንም ባላፍር፥

verses.en: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
verses.fr: néanmoins, parce que cette veuve m''importune, je lui ferai justice, afin qu''elle ne vienne pas sans cesse me rompre la tête.
verses.am: ይህች መበለት ስለምታደክመኝ ሁልጊዜም እየመጣች እንዳታውከኝ እፈርድላታለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur ajouta: Entendez ce que dit le juge inique.
verses.am: ጌታም አለ። ዓመፀኛው ዳኛ ያለውን ስሙ።

verses.en: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?
verses.fr: Et Dieu ne fera-t-il pas justice à ses élus, qui crient à lui jour et nuit, et tardera-t-il à leur égard?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንኪያስ ቀንና ሌሊት ወደ እርሱ ለሚጮኹ ለሚታገሣቸውም ምርጦቹ አይፈርድላቸውምን?

verses.en: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
verses.fr: Je vous le dis, il leur fera promptement justice. Mais, quand le Fils de l''homme viendra, trouvera-t-il la foi sur la terre?
verses.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ ፈጥኖ ይፈርድላቸዋል። ነገር ግን የሰው ልጅ በመጣ ጊዜ በምድር እምነትን ያገኝ ይሆንን?

verses.en: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
verses.fr: Il dit encore cette parabole, en vue de certaines personnes se persuadant qu''elles étaient justes, et ne faisant aucun cas des autres:
verses.am: ጻድቃን እንደ ሆኑ በራሳቸው ለሚታመኑና ሌሎቹን ሁሉ በጣም ለሚንቁ ይህን ምሳሌ ነገራቸው፥

verses.en: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
verses.fr: Deux hommes montèrent au temple pour prier; l''un était pharisien, et l''autre publicain.
verses.am: እንዲህ ሲል። ሁለት ሰዎች ሊጸልዩ ወደ መቅደስ ወጡ፥ አንዱ ፈሪሳዊ ሁለተኛውም ቀራጭ።

verses.en: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
verses.fr: Le pharisien, debout, priait ainsi en lui-même: O Dieu, je te rends grâces de ce que je ne suis pas comme le reste des hommes, qui sont ravisseurs, injustes, adultères, ou même comme ce publicain;
verses.am: ፈሪሳዊም ቆሞ በልቡ ይህን ሲጸልይ። እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ እንደ ሌላ ሰው ሁሉ፥ ቀማኞችና ዓመፀኞች አመንዝሮችም፥ ወይም እንደዚህ ቀራጭ ስላልሆንሁ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤

verses.en: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
verses.fr: je jeûne deux fois la semaine, je donne la dîme de tous mes revenus.
verses.am: በየሳምንቱ ሁለት ጊዜ እጦማለሁ፥ ከማገኘውም ሁሉ አሥራት አወጣለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
verses.fr: Le publicain, se tenant à distance, n''osait même pas lever les yeux au ciel; mais il se frappait la poitrine, en disant: O Dieu, sois apaisé envers moi, qui suis un pécheur.
verses.am: ቀራጩ ግን በሩቅ ቆሞ ዓይኖቹን ወደ ሰማይ ሊያነሣ እንኳ አልወደደም፥ ነገር ግን። አምላክ ሆይ፥ እኔን ኃጢአተኛውን ማረኝ እያለ ደረቱን ይደቃ ነበር።

verses.en: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis, celui-ci descendit dans sa maison justifié, plutôt que l''autre. Car quiconque s''élève sera abaissé, et celui qui s''abaisse sera élevé.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ ከዚያ ይልቅ ይህ ጻድቅ ሆኖ ወደ ቤቱ ተመለሰ፤ ራሱን ከፍ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ይዋረዳልና፥ ራሱን ግን የሚያዋርድ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.en: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
verses.fr: On lui amena aussi les petits enfants, afin qu''il les touchât. Mais les disciples, voyant cela, reprenaient ceux qui les amenaient.
verses.am: እንዲዳስሳቸውም ሕፃናትን ደግሞ ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም አይተው ገሠጹአቸው።

verses.en: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: Et Jésus les appela, et dit: Laissez venir à moi les petits enfants, et ne les en empêchez pas; car le royaume de Dieu est pour ceux qui leur ressemblent.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን ሕፃናትን ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ። ሕፃናት ወደ እኔ ይመጡ ዘንድ ተዉአቸው አትከልክሉአቸውም፤ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደ እነዚህ ላሉት ናትና።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, quiconque ne recevra pas le royaume de Dieu comme un petit enfant n''y entrera point.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት እንደ ሕፃን የማይቀበላት ሁሉ ከቶ አይገባባትም አለ።

verses.en: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.fr: Un chef interrogea Jésus, et dit: Bon maître, que dois-je faire pour hériter la vie éternelle?
verses.am: ከአለቆችም አንዱ። ቸር መምህር፥ የዘላለምን ሕይወት እንድወርስ ምን ላድርግ? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Pourquoi m''appelles-tu bon? Il n''y a de bon que Dieu seul.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ስለ ምን ቸር ትለኛለህ? ከአንዱ ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ቸር ማንም የለም።

verses.en: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.
verses.fr: Tu connais les commandements: Tu ne commettras point d''adultère; tu ne tueras point; tu ne déroberas point; tu ne diras point de faux témoignage; honore ton père et ta mère.
verses.am: ትእዛዛቱን ታውቃለህ፥ አታመንዝር፥ አትግደል፥ አትስረቅ፥ በሐሰት አትመስክር፥ አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር አለው።

verses.en: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
verses.fr: J''ai, dit-il, observé toutes ces choses dès ma jeunesse.
verses.am: እርሱም። ይህን ሁሉ ከሕፃንናቴ ጀምሬ ጠብቄአለሁ አለ።

verses.en: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
verses.fr: Jésus, ayant entendu cela, lui dit: Il te manque encore une chose: vends tout ce que tu as, distribue- le aux pauvres, et tu auras un trésor dans les cieux. Puis, viens, et suis-moi.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ይህን ሰምቶ። አንዲት ገና ቀርታሃለች፤ ያለህን ሁሉ ሽጠህ ለድሆች ስጥ፥ በሰማይም መዝገብ ታገኛለህ፥ መጥተህም ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.en: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il entendit ces paroles, il devint tout triste; car il était très riche.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ይህን ሰምቶ እጅግ ባለ ጠጋ ነበርና ብዙ አዘነ።

verses.en: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.fr: Jésus, voyant qu''il était devenu tout triste, dit: Qu''il est difficile à ceux qui ont des richesses d''entrer dans le royaume de Dieu!
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ብዙ እንዳዘነ አይቶ። ገንዘብ ላላቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት መግባት እንዴት ጭንቅ ይሆናል።

verses.en: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: Car il est plus facile à un chameau de passer par le trou d''une aiguille qu''à un riche d''entrer dans le royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: ባለ ጠጋ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከሚገባ ይልቅ ግመል በመርፌ ቀዳዳ ሊገባ ይቀላል አለ።

verses.en: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?
verses.fr: Ceux qui l''écoutaient dirent: Et qui peut être sauvé?
verses.am: የሰሙትም። እንግዲህ ማን ሊድን ይችላል? አሉ።

verses.en: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: Ce qui est impossible aux hommes est possible à Dieu.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። በሰው ዘንድ የማይቻል በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ይቻላል አለ።

verses.en: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.
verses.fr: Pierre dit alors: Voici, nous avons tout quitté, et nous t''avons suivi.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም። እነሆ፥ እኛ ሁሉን ትተን ተከተልንህ አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,
verses.fr: Et Jésus leur dit: Je vous le dis en vérité, il n''est personne qui, ayant quitté, à cause du royaume de Dieu, sa maison, ou sa femme, ou ses frères, ou ses parents, ou ses enfants,
verses.am: እርሱም። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ቤትን ወይም ወላጆችን ወይም ወንድሞችን ወይም ሚስትን ወይም ልጆችን የተወ፥

verses.en: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
verses.fr: ne reçoive beaucoup plus dans ce siècle-ci, et, dans le siècle à venir, la vie éternelle.
verses.am: በዚህ ዘመን ብዙ እጥፍ በሚመጣውም ዓለም የዘላለምን ሕይወት የማይቀበል ማንም የለም አላቸው።

verses.en: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.
verses.fr: Jésus prit les douze auprès de lui, et leur dit: Voici, nous montons à Jérusalem, et tout ce qui a été écrit par les prophètes au sujet du Fils de l''homme s''accomplira.
verses.am: አሥራ ሁለቱንም ወደ እርሱ አቅርቦ እንዲህ አላቸው። እነሆ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንወጣለን፥ ስለ ሰው ልጅም በነቢያት የተጻፈው ሁሉ ይፈጸማል።

verses.en: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:
verses.fr: Car il sera livré aux païens; on se moquera de lui, on l''outragera, on crachera sur lui,
verses.am: ለአሕዛብ አሳልፈው ይሰጡታልና፥ ይዘብቱበትማል ያንገላቱትማል ይተፉበትማል፤

verses.en: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.fr: et, après l''avoir battu de verges, on le fera mourir; et le troisième jour il ressuscitera.
verses.am: ከገረፉትም በኋላ ይገድሉታል፥ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ይነሣል።

verses.en: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
verses.fr: Mais ils ne comprirent rien à cela; c''était pour eux un langage caché, des paroles dont ils ne saisissaient pas le sens.
verses.am: እነርሱም ከዚህ ነገር ምንም አላስተዋሉም፥ ይህም ቃል ተሰውሮባቸው ነበር፥ የተናገረውንም አላወቁም።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
verses.fr: Comme Jésus approchait de Jéricho, un aveugle était assis au bord du chemin, et mendiait.
verses.am: ወደ ኢያሪኮም በቀረበ ጊዜ አንድ ዕውር እየለመነ በመንገድ ዳር ተቀምጦ ነበር።

verses.en: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
verses.fr: Entendant la foule passer, il demanda ce que c''était.
verses.am: ሕዝብም ሲያልፍ ሰምቶ። ይህ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ ጠየቀ።

verses.en: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
verses.fr: On lui dit: C''est Jésus de Nazareth qui passe.
verses.am: እነርሱም። የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ ያልፋል ብለው አወሩለት።

verses.en: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.fr: Et il cria: Jésus, Fils de David, aie pitié de moi!
verses.am: እርሱም። የዳዊት ልጅ፥ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ማረኝ እያለ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.fr: Ceux qui marchaient devant le reprenaient, pour le faire taire; mais il criait beaucoup plus fort: Fils de David, aie pitié de moi!
verses.am: በስተ ፊት ይሄዱ የነበሩትም ዝም እንዲል ገሠጹት፤ እርሱ ግን። የዳዊት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ማረኝ እያለ አብዝቶ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
verses.fr: Jésus, s''étant arrêté, ordonna qu''on le lui amène; et, quand il se fut approché, il lui demanda:
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ቆሞ ወደ እርሱ እንዲያመጡት አዘዘ። በቀረበም ጊዜ። ምን ላደርግልህ ትወዳለህ? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.en: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.
verses.fr: Que veux-tu que je te fasse? Il répondit: Seigneur, que je recouvre la vue.
verses.am: እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አይ ዘንድ ነው አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
verses.fr: Et Jésus lui dit: Recouvre la vue; ta foi t''a sauvé.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እይ፤ እምነትህ አድኖሃል አለው።

verses.en: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
verses.fr: A l''instant il recouvra la vue, et suivit Jésus, en glorifiant Dieu. Tout le peuple, voyant cela, loua Dieu.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም አየ፥ እግዚአብሔንም እያከበረ ተከተለው። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አይተው እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገኑ።

verses.en: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
verses.fr: Jésus, étant entré dans Jéricho, traversait la ville.
verses.am: ወደ ኢያሪኮም ገብቶ ያልፍ ነበር። እነሆም ዘኬዎስ የሚባል ሰው፥

verses.en: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
verses.fr: Et voici, un homme riche, appelé Zachée, chef des publicains,
verses.am: እርሱም የቀራጮች አለቃ ነበረ፥ ባለ ጠጋም ነበረ።

verses.en: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
verses.fr: cherchait à voir qui était Jésus; mais il ne pouvait y parvenir, à cause de la foule, car il était de petite taille.
verses.am: ኢየሱስንም የትኛው እንደ ሆነ ሊያይ ይፈልግ ነበር፤ ቁመቱም አጭር ነበረና ስለ ሕዝቡ ብዛት አቃተው።

verses.en: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
verses.fr: Il courut en avant, et monta sur un sycomore pour le voir, parce qu''il devait passer par là.
verses.am: በዚያችም መንገድ ያልፍ ዘንድ አለውና ያየው ዘንድ ወደ ፊት ሮጦ በአንድ ሾላ ላይ ወጣ።

verses.en: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
verses.fr: Lorsque Jésus fut arrivé à cet endroit, il leva les yeux et lui dit: Zachée, hâte-toi de descendre; car il faut que je demeure aujourd''hui dans ta maison.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደዚያ ስፍራ በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ አሻቅቦ አየና። ዘኬዎስ ሆይ፥ ዛሬ በቤትህ እውል ዘንድ ይገባኛልና ፈጥነህ ውረድ አለው።

verses.en: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
verses.fr: Zachée se hâta de descendre, et le reçut avec joie.
verses.am: ፈጥኖም ወረደ በደስታም ተቀበለው።

verses.en: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
verses.fr: Voyant cela, tous murmuraient, et disaient: Il est allé loger chez un homme pécheur.
verses.am: ሁሉም አይተው። ከኃጢአተኛ ሰው ጋር ሊውል ገባ ብለው አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.en: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord: Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
verses.fr: Mais Zachée, se tenant devant le Seigneur, lui dit: Voici, Seigneur, je donne aux pauvres la moitié de mes biens, et, si j''ai fait tort de quelque chose à quelqu''un, je lui rends le quadruple.
verses.am: ዘኬዎስ ግን ቆሞ ጌታን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ካለኝ ሁሉ እኵሌታውን ለድሆች እሰጣለሁ፤ ማንንም በሐሰት ከስሼ እንደ ሆንሁ አራት እጥፍ እመልሳለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Le salut est entré aujourd''hui dans cette maison, parce que celui-ci est aussi un fils d''Abraham.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እርሱ ደግሞ የአብርሃም ልጅ ነውና ዛሬ ለዚህ ቤት መዳን ሆኖለታል፤

verses.en: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
verses.fr: Car le Fils de l''homme est venu chercher et sauver ce qui était perdu.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ የጠፋውን ሊፈልግና ሊያድን መጥቶአለና አለው።

verses.en: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.
verses.fr: Ils écoutaient ces choses, et Jésus ajouta une parabole, parce qu''il était près de Jérusalem, et qu''on croyait qu''à l''instant le royaume de Dieu allait paraître.
verses.am: እነርሱም ይህን ሲሰሙ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መቅረቡ ስለ ሆነ የእግዚአብሔርም መንግሥት ፈጥኖ ሊገለጥ እንዳለው ስለ መሰላቸው ምሳሌ ጭምር ተናገረ።

verses.en: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
verses.fr: Il dit donc: Un homme de haute naissance s''en alla dans un pays lointain, pour se faire investir de l''autorité royale, et revenir ensuite.
verses.am: ስለዚህም እንዲህ አላቸው። አንድ መኰንን ለራሱ መንግሥትን ይዞ ሊመለሰ ወደ ሩቅ አገር ሄደ።

verses.en: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.
verses.fr: Il appela dix de ses serviteurs, leur donna dix mines, et leur dit: Faites-les valoir jusqu''à ce que je revienne.
verses.am: አሥር ባሪያዎችንም ጠርቶ አሥር ምናን ሰጣቸውና። እስክመጣ ድረስ ነግዱ አላቸው።

verses.en: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.
verses.fr: Mais ses concitoyens le haïssaient, et ils envoyèrent une ambassade après lui, pour dire: Nous ne voulons pas que cet homme règne sur nous.
verses.am: የአገሩ ሰዎች ግን ይጠሉት ነበርና። ይህ በላያችን ሊነግሥ አንወድም ብለው በኋላው መልክተኞችን ላኩ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il fut de retour, après avoir été investi de l''autorité royale, il fit appeler auprès de lui les serviteurs auxquels il avait donné l''argent, afin de connaître comment chacun l''avait fait valoir.
verses.am: መንግሥትንም ይዞ በተመለሰ ጊዜ፥ ገንዘብ የሰጣቸውን እነዚህን ባሪያዎች ነግደው ምን ያህል እንዳተረፉ ያውቅ ዘንድ እንዲጠሩለት አዘዘ።

verses.en: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
verses.fr: Le premier vint, et dit: Seigneur, ta mine a rapporté dix mines.
verses.am: የፊተኛውም ደርሶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ምናንህ አሥር ምናን አተረፈ አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
verses.fr: Il lui dit: C''est bien, bon serviteur; parce que tu as été fidèle en peu de chose, reçois le gouvernement de dix villes.
verses.am: እርሱም። መልካም፥ አንተ በጎ ባሪያ፥ በጥቂት የታመንህ ስለ ሆንህ በአሥር ከተማዎች ላይ ሥልጣን ይሁንልህ አለው።

verses.en: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.
verses.fr: Le second vint, et dit: Seigneur, ta mine a produit cinq mines.
verses.am: ሁለተኛውም መጥቶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ምናንህ አምስት ምናን አተረፈ አለው።

verses.en: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.
verses.fr: Il lui dit: Toi aussi, sois établi sur cinq villes.
verses.am: ይህንም ደግሞ። አንተም በአምስት ከተማዎች ላይ ሁን አለው።

verses.en: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
verses.fr: Un autre vint, et dit: Seigneur, voici ta mine, que j''ai gardée dans un linge;
verses.am: ሌላውም መጥቶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በጨርቅ ጠቅልዬ የጠበቅኋት ምናንህ እነሆ፤

verses.en: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.
verses.fr: car j''avais peur de toi, parce que tu es un homme sévère; tu prends ce que tu n''as pas déposé, et tu moissonnes ce que tu n''as pas semé.
verses.am: ፈርቼሃለሁና፥ ጨካኝ ሰው ስለ ሆንህ፤ ያላኖርኸውን ትወስዳለህ ያልዘራኸውንም ታጭዳለህ አለው።

verses.en: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:
verses.fr: Il lui dit: Je te juge sur tes paroles, méchant serviteur; tu savais que je suis un homme sévère, prenant ce que je n''ai pas déposé, et moissonnant ce que je n''ai pas semé;
verses.am: እርሱም። አንተ ክፉ ባሪያ፥ አፍህ በተናገረው እፈርድብሃለሁ። እኔ ያላኖርሁትን የምወስድና ያልዘራሁትን የማጭድ ጨካኝ ሰው እንደ ሆንሁ አወቅህ፤ ምን ነው ገንዘቤን ለለዋጮች አደራ ያልሰጠኸው?

verses.en: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?
verses.fr: pourquoi donc n''as-tu pas mis mon argent dans une banque, afin qu''à mon retour je le retirasse avec un intérêt?
verses.am: እኔም መጥቼ ከትርፉ ጋር እወስደው ነበር አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.
verses.fr: Puis il dit à ceux qui étaient là: Otez-lui la mine, et donnez-la à celui qui a les dix mines.
verses.am: በዚያም ቆመው የነበሩትን። ምናኑን ውሰዱበት አሥሩ ምናን ላለውም ስጡት አላቸው።

verses.en: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: Seigneur, il a dix mines. -
verses.am: እነርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አሥር ምናን አለው አሉት።

verses.en: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis, on donnera à celui qui a, mais à celui qui n''a pas on ôtera même ce qu''il a.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ ላለው ሁሉ ይሰጠዋል፥ ከሌለው ግን ያው ያለው ስንኳ ይወሰድበታል።

verses.en: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
verses.fr: Au reste, amenez ici mes ennemis, qui n''ont pas voulu que je régnasse sur eux, et tuez-les en ma présence.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እነዚያን በላያቸው ልነግሥ ያልወደዱትን ጠላቶቼን ወደዚህ አምጡአቸው በፊቴም እረዱአቸው።

verses.en: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Après avoir ainsi parlé, Jésus marcha devant la foule, pour monter à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ይህንም ከተናገረ በኋላ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሲወጣ ይቀድማቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il approcha de Bethphagé et de Béthanie, vers la montagne appelée montagne des oliviers, Jésus envoya deux de ses disciples,
verses.am: ደብረ ዘይትም በሚባል ተራራ አጠገብ ወዳሉት ወደ ቤተ ፋጌና ወደ ቢታንያ በቀረበ ጊዜ፥ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለቱን ላከና።

verses.en: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.
verses.fr: en disant: Allez au village qui est en face; quand vous y serez entrés, vous trouverez un ânon attaché, sur lequel aucun homme ne s''est jamais assis; détachez-le, et amenez-le.
verses.am: በፊታችሁ ወዳለችው መንደር ሂዱ፥ ወደ እርስዋም ገብታችሁ ከሰው ማንም ገና ያልተቀመጠበት ውርንጫ ታስሮ ታገኛላችሁ፥ ፈትታችሁም አምጡት።

verses.en: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un vous demande: Pourquoi le détachez-vous? vous lui répondrez: Le Seigneur en a besoin.
verses.am: ማንም። ስለ ምን ትፈቱታላችሁ? ብሎ ቢጠይቃችሁ፥ እንዲሁ። ለጌታ ያስፈልገዋል በሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.
verses.fr: Ceux qui étaient envoyés allèrent, et trouvèrent les choses comme Jésus leur avait dit.
verses.am: የተላኩትም ሄደው እንዳላቸው አገኙ።

verses.en: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?
verses.fr: Comme ils détachaient l''ânon, ses maîtres leur dirent: Pourquoi détachez-vous l''ânon?
verses.am: እነርሱም ውርንጫውን ሲፈቱ ጌቶቹ። ውርንጫውን ስለ ምን ትፈቱታላችሁ? አሉአቸውም

verses.en: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
verses.fr: Ils répondirent: Le Seigneur en a besoin.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ለጌታ ያስፈልገዋል አሉ።

verses.en: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.
verses.fr: Et ils amenèrent à Jésus l''ânon, sur lequel ils jetèrent leurs vêtements, et firent monter Jésus.
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሱስም አመጡት፥ በውርንጫውም ላይ ልብሳቸውን ጭነው ኢየሱስን አስቀመጡት።

verses.en: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.
verses.fr: Quand il fut en marche, les gens étendirent leurs vêtements sur le chemin.
verses.am: ሲሄድም ልብሳቸውን በመንገድ ያነጥፉ ነበር።

verses.en: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;
verses.fr: Et lorsque déjà il approchait de Jérusalem, vers la descente de la montagne des oliviers, toute la multitude des disciples, saisie de joie, se mit à louer Dieu à haute voix pour tous les miracles qu''ils avaient vus.
verses.am: ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ቍልቍለትም አሁን በቀረበ ጊዜ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁላቸው ደስ እያላቸው ተአምራትን ሁሉ ስላዩ በታላቅ ድምፅ እግዚአብሔርን ሊያመሰግኑ ጀምረው።

verses.en: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
verses.fr: Ils disaient: Béni soit le roi qui vient au nom du Seigneur! Paix dans le ciel, et gloire dans les lieux très hauts!
verses.am: በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ ንጉሥ የተባረከ ነው፤ በሰማይ ሰላም በአርያምም ክብር አሉ።

verses.en: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.
verses.fr: Quelques pharisiens, du milieu de la foule, dirent à Jésus: Maître, reprends tes disciples.
verses.am: ከሕዝብም መካከል ከፈሪሳውያን አንዳንዱ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርትህን ገሥጻቸው አሉት።

verses.en: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
verses.fr: Et il répondit: Je vous le dis, s''ils se taisent, les pierres crieront!
verses.am: መልሶም። እላችኋለሁ፥ እነዚህ ዝም ቢሉ ድንጋዮች ይጮኻሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,
verses.fr: Comme il approchait de la ville, Jésus, en la voyant, pleura sur elle,
verses.am: ሲቀርብም ከተማይቱን አይቶ አለቀሰላት፥

verses.en: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
verses.fr: et dit: Si toi aussi, au moins en ce jour qui t''est donné, tu connaissais les choses qui appartiennent à ta paix! Mais maintenant elles sont cachées à tes yeux.
verses.am: እንዲህ እያለ። ለሰላምሽ የሚሆነውን በዚህ ቀን አንቺስ ስንኳ ብታውቂ፤ አሁን ግን ከዓይንሽ ተሰውሮአል።

verses.en: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
verses.fr: Il viendra sur toi des jours où tes ennemis t''environneront de tranchées, t''enfermeront, et te serreront de toutes parts;
verses.am: ወራት ይመጣብሻልና፥ ጠላቶችሽም ቅጥር ይቀጥሩብሻል ይከቡሻልም በየበኵሉም ያስጨንቁሻል፤

verses.en: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
verses.fr: ils te détruiront, toi et tes enfants au milieu de toi, et ils ne laisseront pas en toi pierre sur pierre, parce que tu n''as pas connu le temps où tu as été visitée.
verses.am: አንቺንም በአንቺም ውስጥ የሚኖሩትን ልጆችሽን ወደ ታች ይጥላሉ፥ በአንቺ ውስጥም ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ አይተዉም፥ የመጐብኘትሽን ዘመን አላወቅሽምና።

verses.en: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;
verses.fr: Il entra dans le temple, et il se mit à chasser ceux qui vendaient,
verses.am: ወደ መቅደስም ገብቶ በእርሱ የሚሸጡትን የሚገዙትንም ያወጣ ጀመር፤

verses.en: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.fr: leur disant: Il est écrit: Ma maison sera une maison de prière. Mais vous, vous en avez fait une caverne de voleurs.
verses.am: እርሱም። ቤቴ የጸሎት ቤት ይሆናል ተብሎ ተጽፎአል፤ እናንተ ግን የወንበዴዎች ዋሻ አደረጋችሁት አላቸው።

verses.en: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,
verses.fr: Il enseignait tous les jours dans le temple. Et les principaux sacrificateurs, les scribes, et les principaux du peuple cherchaient à le faire périr;
verses.am: ዕለት ዕለትም በመቅደስ ያስተምር ነበር፤ ነገር ግን የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎች የሕዝቡ ታላላቆችም ሊገድሉት ይፈልጉ ነበር፥

verses.en: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.
verses.fr: mais ils ne savaient comment s''y prendre, car tout le peuple l''écoutait avec admiration.
verses.am: የሚያደርጉበትንም አጡ፤ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሲሰሙት ተንጠልጥለውበት ነበርና።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,
verses.fr: Un de ces jours-là, comme Jésus enseignait le peuple dans le temple et qu''il annonçait la bonne nouvelle, les principaux sacrificateurs et les scribes, avec les anciens, survinrent,
verses.am: አንድ ቀንም ሕዝቡን በመቅደስ ሲያስተምር ወንጌልንም ሲሰብክላቸው፥ የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎች ከሽማግሌዎች ጋር ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡና።

verses.en: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
verses.fr: et lui dirent: Dis-nous, par quelle autorité fais-tu ces choses, ou qui est celui qui t''a donné cette autorité?
verses.am: እስኪ ንገረን፤ እነዚህን በምን ሥልጣን ታደርጋለህ ወይስ ይህን ሥልጣን የሰጠህ ማን ነው? ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.en: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Je vous adresserai aussi une question. Dites-moi,
verses.am: መልሶም። እኔ ደግሞ አንዲት ነገር እጠይቃችኋለሁ፥ እናንተም ንገሩኝ፤

verses.en: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?
verses.fr: le baptême de Jean venait-il du ciel, ou des hommes?
verses.am: የዮሐንስ ጥምቀት ከሰማይ ነበረችን ወይስ ከሰው? አላቸው።

verses.en: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?
verses.fr: Mais ils raisonnèrent ainsi entre eux: Si nous répondons: Du ciel, il dira: Pourquoi n''avez-vous pas cru en lui?
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸውም ሲነጋገሩ። ከሰማይ ብንል። ስለ ምን አላመናችሁበትም? ይለናል፤

verses.en: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.
verses.fr: Et si nous répondons: Des hommes, tout le peuple nous lapidera, car il est persuadé que Jean était un prophète.
verses.am: ከሰው ብንል ግን ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ይወግሩናል፤ ዮሐንስ ነቢይ እንደ ነበረ ሁሉ ያምኑ ነበርና አሉ።

verses.en: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.
verses.fr: Alors ils répondirent qu''ils ne savaient d''où il venait.
verses.am: መልሰውም። ከወዴት እንደ ሆነ አናውቅም አሉት።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.fr: Et Jésus leur dit: Moi non plus, je ne vous dirai pas par quelle autorité je fais ces choses.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እኔም በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን እንዳደርግ አልነግራችሁም አላቸው።

verses.en: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.
verses.fr: Il se mit ensuite à dire au peuple cette parabole: Un homme planta une vigne, l''afferma à des vignerons, et quitta pour longtemps le pays.
verses.am: ይህንም ምሳሌ ለሕዝቡ ይላቸው ጀመር። አንድ ሰው የወይን አትክልት ተከለ ለገበሬዎችም አከራይቶ ለብዙ ዘመን ወደ ሌላ አገር ሄደ።

verses.en: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.fr: Au temps de la récolte, il envoya un serviteur vers les vignerons, pour qu''ils lui donnent une part du produit de la vigne. Les vignerons le battirent, et le renvoyèrent à vide.
verses.am: በጊዜውም ከወይኑ አትክልት ፍሬ እንዲሰጡት አንድ ባሪያ ወደ ገበሬዎች ላከ፤ ገበሬዎቹ ግን ደበደቡት ባዶውንም ሰደዱት።

verses.en: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
verses.fr: Il envoya encore un autre serviteur; ils le battirent, l''outragèrent, et le renvoyèrent à vide.
verses.am: ጨምሮም ሌላውን ባሪያ ላከ፤ እነርሱም ያን ደግሞ ደበደቡት አዋርደውም ባዶውን ሰደዱት።

verses.en: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.
verses.fr: Il en envoya encore un troisième; ils le blessèrent, et le chassèrent.
verses.am: ጨምሮም ሦስተኛውን ላከ፤ እነርሱም ይህን ደግሞ አቍሰለው አወጡት።

verses.en: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.
verses.fr: Le maître de la vigne dit: Que ferai-je? J''enverrai mon fils bien-aimé; peut-être auront-ils pour lui du respect.
verses.am: የወይኑም አትክልት ጌታ። ምን ላድርግ? የምወደውን ልጄን እልካለሁ፤ ምናልባት እርሱን አይተው ያፍሩታል አለ።

verses.en: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
verses.fr: Mais, quand les vignerons le virent, ils raisonnèrent entre eux, et dirent: Voici l''héritier; tuons-le, afin que l''héritage soit à nous.
verses.am: ገበሬዎቹ ግን አይተውት እርስ በርሳቸው ሲነጋገሩ። ወራሹ ይህ ነው፤ ርስቱ ለእኛ እንዲሆን ኑ እንግደለው አሉ።

verses.en: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?
verses.fr: Et ils le jetèrent hors de la vigne, et le tuèrent. Maintenant, que leur fera le maître de la vigne?
verses.am: ከወይኑም አትክልት ወደ ውጭ አውጥተው ገደሉት። እንግዲህ የወይኑ አትክልት ጌታ ምን ያደርጋቸዋል?

verses.en: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.
verses.fr: Il viendra, fera périr ces vignerons, et il donnera la vigne à d''autres. Lorsqu''ils eurent entendu cela, ils dirent: A Dieu ne plaise!
verses.am: ይመጣል እነዚህንም ገበሬዎች ያጠፋል፥ የወይኑንም አትክልት ለሌሎች ይሰጣል። ይህንም በሰሙ ጊዜ። ይህስ አይሁን አሉ።

verses.en: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?
verses.fr: Mais, jetant les regards sur eux, Jésus dit: Que signifie donc ce qui est écrit: La pierre qu''ont rejetée ceux qui bâtissaient Est devenue la principale de l''angle?
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ወደ እነርሱ ተመልክቶ። እንግዲህ። ግንበኞች የናቁት ድንጋይ እርሱ የማዕዘን ራስ ሆነ ተብሎ የተጻፈው ይህ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
verses.fr: Quiconque tombera sur cette pierre s''y brisera, et celui sur qui elle tombera sera écrasé.
verses.am: በዚያም ድንጋይ ላይ የሚወድቅ ሁሉ ይቀጠቀጣል፤ የሚወድቅበትን ሁሉ ግን ይፈጨዋል አለ።

verses.en: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.
verses.fr: Les principaux sacrificateurs et les scribes cherchèrent à mettre la main sur lui à l''heure même, mais ils craignirent le peuple. Ils avaient compris que c''était pour eux que Jésus avait dit cette parabole.
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎችም ይህን ምሳሌ በእነርሱ ላይ እንደ ተናገረ አውቀው በዚያች ሰዓት እጃቸውን ሊጭኑበት ፈለጉ ነገር ግን ሕዝቡን ፈሩ።

verses.en: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.
verses.fr: Ils se mirent à observer Jésus; et ils envoyèrent des gens qui feignaient d''être justes, pour lui tendre des pièges et saisir de lui quelque parole, afin de le livrer au magistrat et à l''autorité du gouverneur.
verses.am: ሲጠባበቁም ወደ ገዢ ግዛትና ሥልጣን አሳልፈው እንዲሰጡት ጻድቃን መስለው በቃሉ የሚያጠምዱትን ሸማቂዎች ሰደዱበት።

verses.en: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:
verses.fr: Ces gens lui posèrent cette question: Maître, nous savons que tu parles et enseignes droitement, et que tu ne regardes pas à l''apparence, mais que tu enseignes la voie de Dieu selon la vérité.
verses.am: ጠይቀውም። መምህር ሆይ፥ እውነትን እንድትናገርና እንድታስተምር ለሰው ፊትም እንዳታደላ እናውቃለን፥ በእውነት የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ ታስተምራለህ እንጂ፤

verses.en: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?
verses.fr: Nous est-il permis, ou non, de payer le tribut à César?
verses.am: ለቄሣር ግብር ልንሰጥ ተፈቅዶአልን? ወይስ አልተፈቀደም? አሉት።

verses.en: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?
verses.fr: Jésus, apercevant leur ruse, leur répondit:
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ተንኰላቸውንም ተመልክቶ። ስለ ምን ትፈትኑኛላችሁ? አንድ ዲናር አሳዩኝ፤

verses.en: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.
verses.fr: Montrez-moi un denier. De qui porte-t-il l''effigie et l''inscription? De César, répondirent-ils.
verses.am: መልኩ ጽሕፈቱስ የማን ነው? አላቸው። መልሰውም። የቄሣር ነው አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.
verses.fr: Alors il leur dit: Rendez donc à César ce qui est à César, et à Dieu ce qui est à Dieu.
verses.am: እርሱም። እንኪያስ የቄሣርን ለቄሣር የእግዚአብሔርንም ለእግዚአብሔር አስረክቡ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
verses.fr: Ils ne purent rien reprendre dans ses paroles devant le peuple; mais, étonnés de sa réponse, ils gardèrent le silence.
verses.am: በሕዝቡም ፊት በቃሉ ሊያጠምዱት አልቻሉም በመልሱም እየተደነቁ ዝም አሉ።

verses.en: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
verses.fr: Quelques-uns des sadducéens, qui disent qu''il n''y a point de résurrection, s''approchèrent, et posèrent à Jésus cette question:
verses.am: ትንሣኤ ሙታንንም የሚክዱ ከሰዱቃውያን አንዳንዶቹ ቀርበው ጠየቁት፥

verses.en: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.fr: Maître, voici ce que Moïse nous a prescrit: Si le frère de quelqu''un meurt, ayant une femme sans avoir d''enfants, son frère épousera la femme, et suscitera une postérité à son frère.
verses.am: እንዲህ ሲሉ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ሙሴ። ሚስት ያለችው የአንድ ሰው ወንድም ልጅ ሳይወልድ ቢሞት፥ ወንድሙ ሚስቱን አግብቶ ለወንድሙ ዘር ይተካ ብሎ ጻፈልን።

verses.en: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.
verses.fr: Or, il y avait sept frères. Le premier se maria, et mourut sans enfants.
verses.am: እንግዲያስ ሰባት ወንድማማች ነበሩ፤ የፊተኛውም ሚስት አግብቶ ልጅ ሳይወልድ ሞተ፤

verses.en: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.
verses.fr: Le second et le troisième épousèrent la veuve;
verses.am: ከሁሉም በኋላ ሴቲቱ ደግሞ ሞተች።

verses.en: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.
verses.fr: il en fut de même des sept, qui moururent sans laisser d''enfants.
verses.am: ከሁሉም በኋላ ሴቲቱ ደግሞ ሞተች።

verses.en: Last of all the woman died also.
verses.fr: Enfin, la femme mourut aussi.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሰባቱ አግብተዋታልና ሴቲቱ በትንሣኤ ከእነርሱ ለማንኛቸው ሚስት ትሆናለች?

verses.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.
verses.fr: A la résurrection, duquel d''entre eux sera-t-elle donc la femme? Car les sept l''ont eue pour femme.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። የዚህ ዓለም ልጆች ያገባሉ ይጋባሉም፥

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Les enfants de ce siècle prennent des femmes et des maris;
verses.am: ያን ዓለምና ከሙታን ትንሣኤ ሊያገኙ የሚገባቸው እነዚያ ግን አያገቡም አይጋቡምም፥ እንደ መላእክት ናቸውና፥

verses.en: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:
verses.fr: mais ceux qui seront trouvés dignes d''avoir part au siècle à venir et à la résurrection des morts ne prendront ni femmes ni maris.
verses.am: ሊሞቱም ወደ ፊት አይቻላቸውም፥ የትንሣኤም ልጆች ስለ ሆኑ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.en: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.
verses.fr: Car ils ne pourront plus mourir, parce qu''ils seront semblables aux anges, et qu''ils seront fils de Dieu, étant fils de la résurrection.
verses.am: ሙታን እንዲነሡ ግን ሙሴ ደግሞ በቍጥቋጦው ዘንድ ጌታን የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም አምላክ የያዕቆብም አምላክ በማለቱ አስታወቀ፤

verses.en: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
verses.fr: Que les morts ressuscitent, c''est ce que Moïse a fait connaître quand, à propos du buisson, il appelle le Seigneur le Dieu d''Abraham, le Dieu d''Isaac, et le Dieu de Jacob.
verses.am: ሁሉ ለእርሱ ሕያዋን ስለ ሆኑ፥ የሕያዋን አምላክ ነው እንጂ የሙታን አይደለም።

verses.en: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
verses.fr: Or, Dieu n''est pas Dieu des morts, mais des vivants; car pour lui tous sont vivants.
verses.am: ከጻፎችም አንዳንዶቹ መልሰው። መምህር ሆይ፥ መልካም ተናገርህ አሉት።

verses.en: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.
verses.fr: Quelques-uns des scribes, prenant la parole, dirent: Maître, tu as bien parlé.
verses.am: ወደ ፊትም አንድ ነገር ስንኳ ሊጠይቁት አልደፈሩም።

verses.en: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.
verses.fr: Et ils n''osaient plus lui faire aucune question.
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። ክርስቶስ የዳዊት ልጅ ነው እንዴት ይላሉ?

verses.en: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Comment dit-on que le Christ est fils de David?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ዳዊት። ጌታ ብሎ ይጠራዋል፥ እንዴትስ ልጁ ይሆናል?

verses.en: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
verses.fr: David lui-même dit dans le livre des Psaumes: Le Seigneur a dit à mon Seigneur: Assieds-toi à ma droite,
verses.am: እንግዲህ ዳዊት። ጌታ ብሎ ይጠራዋል፥ እንዴትስ ልጁ ይሆናል?

verses.en: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.fr: Jusqu''à ce que je fasse de tes ennemis ton marchepied.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ሲሰሙ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን።

verses.en: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?
verses.fr: David donc l''appelle Seigneur; comment est-il son fils?
verses.am: ረጃጅም ልብስ ለብሰው መዞር ከሚፈልጉ፥ በገበያም ሰላምታ፥ በምኵራብም የከበሬታ ወንበር፥ በምሳም የከበሬታ ስፍራ ከሚወዱ ከጻፎች ተጠበቁ፤

verses.en: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,
verses.fr: Tandis que tout le peuple l''écoutait, il dit à ses disciples:
verses.am: የመበለቶችን ቤት የሚበሉ ጸሎታቸውንም በማስረዘም የሚያመካኙ፥ እነዚህ የባሰ ፍርድ ይቀበላሉ አለ።

verses.en: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;
verses.fr: Gardez-vous des scribes, qui aiment à se promener en robes longues, et à être salués dans les places publiques; qui recherchent les premiers sièges dans les synagogues, et les premières places dans les festins;
verses.am: ረጃጅም ልብስ ለብሰው መዞር ከሚፈልጉ፥ በገበያም ሰላምታ፥ በምኵራብም የከበሬታ ወንበር፥ በምሳም የከበሬታ ስፍራ ከሚወዱ ከጻፎች ተጠበቁ፤

verses.en: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
verses.fr: qui dévorent les maisons des veuves, et qui font pour l''apparence de longues prières. Ils seront jugés plus sévèrement.
verses.am: የመበለቶችን ቤት የሚበሉ ጸሎታቸውንም በማስረዘም የሚያመካኙ፥ እነዚህ የባሰ ፍርድ ይቀበላሉ አለ።

verses.en: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
verses.fr: Jésus, ayant levé les yeux, vit les riches qui mettaient leurs offrandes dans le tronc.
verses.am: ዓይኑንም አንሥቶ መባቸውን በመዝገብ የሚጥሉ ባለ ጠጎችን አየ።

verses.en: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
verses.fr: Il vit aussi une pauvre veuve, qui y mettait deux petites pièces.
verses.am: አንዲትም ድሀ መበለት ሁለት ሳንቲም በዚያ ስትጥል አየና።

verses.en: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:
verses.fr: Et il dit: Je vous le dis en vérité, cette pauvre veuve a mis plus que tous les autres;
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህች ድሀ መበለት ከሁሉ ይልቅ አብልጣ ጣለች፤

verses.en: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
verses.fr: car c''est de leur superflu que tous ceux-là ont mis des offrandes dans le tronc, mais elle a mis de son nécessaire, tout ce qu''elle avait pour vivre.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ ከትርፋቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር መዝገብ ጥለዋልና፤ ይህች ግን ከጕድለትዋ የነበራትን ትዳርዋን ሁሉ ጣለች አለ።

verses.en: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
verses.fr: Comme quelques-uns parlaient des belles pierres et des offrandes qui faisaient l''ornement du temple, Jésus dit:
verses.am: አንዳንዶቹም ስለ መቅደስ በመልካም ድንጋይና በተሰጠው ሽልማት እንዳጌጠ ሲነጋገሩ። ይህማ የምታዩት ሁሉ፥

verses.en: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.fr: Les jours viendront où, de ce que vous voyez, il ne restera pas pierre sur pierre qui ne soit renversée.
verses.am: ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ ሳይፈርስ በዚህ የማይቀርበት ዘመን ይመጣል አለ።

verses.en: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
verses.fr: Ils lui demandèrent: Maître, quand donc cela arrivera-t-il, et à quel signe connaîtra-t-on que ces choses vont arriver?
verses.am: እነርሱም። መምህር ሆይ፥ እንግዲህ ይህ መቼ ይሆናል? ይህስ ይሆን ዘንድ እንዳለው ምልክቱ ምንድር ነው? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: Prenez garde que vous ne soyez séduits. Car plusieurs viendront en mon nom, disant: C''est moi, et le temps approche. Ne les suivez pas.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። እንዳትስቱ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ብዙዎች። እኔ ነኝ፥ ዘመኑም ቀርቦአል እያሉ በስሜ ይመጣሉና፤ እነርሱን ተከትላችሁ አትሂዱ።

verses.en: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
verses.fr: Quand vous entendrez parler de guerres et de soulèvements, ne soyez pas effrayés, car il faut que ces choses arrivent premièrement. Mais ce ne sera pas encore la fin.
verses.am: ጦርንና ሁከትንም በሰማችሁ ጊዜ አትደንግጡ፤ ይህ አስቀድሞ ይሆን ዘንድ ግድ ነውና፥ ነገር ግን መጨረሻው ወዲያው አይሆንም።

verses.en: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
verses.fr: Alors il leur dit: Une nation s''élèvera contre une nation, et un royaume contre un royaume;
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ እንዲህ አላቸው። ሕዝብ በሕዝብ ላይ፥ መንግሥትም በመንግሥት ላይ ይነሣል፤

verses.en: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
verses.fr: il y aura de grands tremblements de terre, et, en divers lieux, des pestes et des famines; il y aura des phénomènes terribles, et de grands signes dans le ciel.
verses.am: ታላቅም የምድር መናወጥና በልዩ ልዩ ስፍራ ቸነፈር ራብም ይሆናል፤ የሚያስፈራም ነገር ከሰማይም ታላቅ ምልክት ይሆናል።

verses.en: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.
verses.fr: Mais, avant tout cela, on mettra la main sur vous, et l''on vous persécutera; on vous livrera aux synagogues, on vous jettera en prison, on vous mènera devant des rois et devant des gouverneurs, à cause de mon nom.
verses.am: ከዚህም ሁሉ በፊት እጃቸውን በላያችሁ ይጭናሉ ያሳድዱአችሁማል፤ ስለ ስሜም ወደ ምኵራብና ወደ ወኅኒ አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል፥ ወደ ነገሥታትና ወደ ገዥዎችም ይወስዱአችኋል፤

verses.en: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
verses.fr: Cela vous arrivera pour que vous serviez de témoignage.
verses.am: ይህም ለምስክርነት ይሆንላችኋል።

verses.en: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
verses.fr: Mettez-vous donc dans l''esprit de ne pas préméditer votre défense;
verses.am: ሰለዚህ እንዴት እንድትመልሱ አስቀድማችሁ እንዳታስቡ በልባችሁ አኑሩት፤

verses.en: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
verses.fr: car je vous donnerai une bouche et une sagesse à laquelle tous vos adversaires ne pourront résister ou contredire.
verses.am: ወደረኞቻችሁ ሁሉ ሊቃወሙና ሊከራከሩ የማይችሉትን አፍና ጥበብ እሰጣችኋለሁና።

verses.en: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
verses.fr: Vous serez livrés même par vos parents, par vos frères, par vos proches et par vos amis, et ils feront mourir plusieurs d''entre vous.
verses.am: ወላጆችም ስንኳ ወንድሞችም ዘመዶችም ወዳጆችም አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል፥ ከእናንተም አንዳንዱን ይገድላሉ፤

verses.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.
verses.fr: Vous serez haïs de tous, à cause de mon nom.
verses.am: በሁሉም ስለ ስሜ የተጠላችሁ ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.en: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
verses.fr: Mais il ne se perdra pas un cheveu de votre tête;
verses.am: ከራሳችሁም አንዲት ጠጉር ስንኳ አትጠፋም፤

verses.en: In your patience possess ye your souls.
verses.fr: par votre persévérance vous sauverez vos âmes.
verses.am: በመታገሣችሁም ነፍሳችሁን ታገኛላችሁ።

verses.en: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
verses.fr: Lorsque vous verrez Jérusalem investie par des armées, sachez alors que sa désolation est proche.
