verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ግን በጭፍራ ተከባ ስታዩ በዚያን ጊዜ ጥፋትዋ እንደ ቀረበ እወቁ።

verses.en: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
verses.fr: Alors, que ceux qui seront en Judée fuient dans les montagnes, que ceux qui seront au milieu de Jérusalem en sortent, et que ceux qui seront dans les champs n''entrent pas dans la ville.
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜ በይሁዳ ያሉ ወደ ተራራዎች ይሽሹ፥ በመካከልዋም ያሉ ከእርስዋ ፈቀቅ ይበሉ፥ በገጠር ያሉም ወደ እርስዋ አይግቡ፤

verses.en: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
verses.fr: Car ce seront des jours de vengeance, pour l''accomplissement de tout ce qui est écrit.
verses.am: የተጻፈው ሁሉ እንዲፈጸም ይህ የበቀል ጊዜ ነውና።

verses.en: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
verses.fr: Malheur aux femmes qui seront enceintes et à celles qui allaiteront en ces jours-là! Car il y aura une grande détresse dans le pays, et de la colère contre ce peuple.
verses.am: በዚያን ወራት ለእርጕዞችና ለሚያጠቡ ወዮላቸው፤ ታላቅ ችግር በምድር ላይ፥ በዚህም ሕዝብ ላይ ቍጣ ይሆናልና፤

verses.en: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
verses.fr: Ils tomberont sous le tranchant de l''épée, ils seront emmenés captifs parmi toutes les nations, et Jérusalem sera foulée aux pieds par les nations, jusqu''à ce que les temps des nations soient accomplis.
verses.am: በሰይፍ ስለትም ይወድቃሉ፤ ወደ አሕዛብ ሁሉም ይማረካሉ፤ የአሕዛብም ዘመን እስኪፈጸም ድረስ ኢየሩሳሌም በአሕዛብ የተረገጠች ትሆናለች።

verses.en: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
verses.fr: Il y aura des signes dans le soleil, dans la lune et dans les étoiles. Et sur la terre, il y aura de l''angoisse chez les nations qui ne sauront que faire, au bruit de la mer et des flots,
verses.am: በፀሐይና በጨረቃም በከዋክብትም ምልክት ይሆናል፤ በምድር ላይም አሕዛብ ከባሕሩና ከሞገዱም ድምፅ የተነሣ እያመነቱ ይጨነቃሉ፤

verses.en: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
verses.fr: les hommes rendant l''âme de terreur dans l''attente de ce qui surviendra pour la terre; car les puissances des cieux seront ébranlées.
verses.am: ሰዎችም ከፍርሃትና በዓለም የሚመጣበትን ከመጠበቅ የተነሣ ይደክማሉ፤ የሰማያት ኃይላት ይናወጣሉና።

verses.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.fr: Alors on verra le Fils de l''homme venant sur une nuée avec puissance et une grande gloire.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም የሰው ልጅ በኃይልና በብዙ ክብር በደመና ሲመጣ ያዩታል።

verses.en: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
verses.fr: Quand ces choses commenceront à arriver, redressez-vous et levez vos têtes, parce que votre délivrance approche.
verses.am: ይህም ሊሆን ሲጀምር ቤዛችሁ ቀርቦአልና አሻቅባችሁ ራሳችሁን አንሡ።

verses.en: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
verses.fr: Et il leur dit une comparaison: Voyez le figuier, et tous les arbres.
verses.am: ምሳሌንም ነገራቸው እንዲህ ሲል። በለስንና ዛፎችን ሁሉ እዩ፤

verses.en: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
verses.fr: Dès qu''ils ont poussé, vous connaissez de vous-mêmes, en regardant, que déjà l''été est proche.
verses.am: ሲያቈጠቍጡ ተመልክታችሁ በጋ አሁን እንደ ቀረበ ራሳችሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
verses.fr: De même, quand vous verrez ces choses arriver, sachez que le royaume de Dieu est proche.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ደግሞ እናንተ ይህ ሁሉ መሆኑን ስታዩ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደ ቀረበች እወቁ።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, cette génération ne passera point, que tout cela n''arrive.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህ ሁሉ እስኪሆን ድረስ ይህ ትውልድ አያልፍም።

verses.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.fr: Le ciel et la terre passeront, mais mes paroles ne passeront point.
verses.am: ሰማይና ምድር ያልፋሉ ቃሌ ግን አያልፍም።

verses.en: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
verses.fr: Prenez garde à vous-mêmes, de crainte que vos coeurs ne s''appesantissent par les excès du manger et du boire, et par les soucis de la vie, et que ce jour ne vienne sur vous à l''improviste;
verses.am: ነገር ግን ልባችሁ በመጠጥ ብዛትና በስካር ስለ ትዳርም በማሰብ እንዳይከብድ፥ ያ ቀንም በድንገት እንዳይመጣባችሁ ለራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ፤

verses.en: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
verses.fr: car il viendra comme un filet sur tous ceux qui habitent sur la face de toute la terre.
verses.am: በምድር ሁሉ ላይ በሚቀመጡ ሁሉ እንደ ወጥመድ ይደርስባቸዋልና።

verses.en: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
verses.fr: Veillez donc et priez en tout temps, afin que vous ayez la force d''échapper à toutes ces choses qui arriveront, et de paraître debout devant le Fils de l''homme.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሊመጣ ካለው ከዚህ ሁሉ ለማምለጥ፥ በሰው ልጅም ፊት ለመቆም እንድትችሉ ስትጸልዩ ሁል ጊዜ ትጉ።

verses.en: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
verses.fr: Pendant le jour, Jésus enseignait dans le temple, et il allait passer la nuit à la montagne appelée montagne des oliviers.
verses.am: ዕለት ዕለትም በመቅደስ ያስተምር ነበር፥ ሌሊት ግን ደብረ ዘይት ወደምትባል ተራራ ወጥቶ ያድር ነበር።

verses.en: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
verses.fr: Et tout le peuple, dès le matin, se rendait vers lui dans le temple pour l''écouter.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ይሰሙት ዘንድ ማልደው በመቅደስ ወደ እርሱ ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
verses.fr: La fête des pains sans levain, appelée la Pâque, approchait.
verses.am: ፋሲካም የሚባለው የቂጣ በዓል ቀረበ።

verses.en: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
verses.fr: Les principaux sacrificateurs et les scribes cherchaient les moyens de faire mourir Jésus; car ils craignaient le peuple.
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎችም እንዴት እንዲያጠፉት ይፈልጉ ነበር፤ ሕዝቡን ይፈሩ ነበርና።

verses.en: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
verses.fr: Or, Satan entra dans Judas, surnommé Iscariot, qui était du nombre des douze.
verses.am: ሰይጣንም ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ቍጥር አንዱ በነበረው የአስቆሮቱ በሚባለው በይሁዳ ገባ፤

verses.en: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
verses.fr: Et Judas alla s''entendre avec les principaux sacrificateurs et les chefs des gardes, sur la manière de le leur livrer.
verses.am: ሄዶም እንዴት አሳልፎ እንዲሰጣቸው ከካህናት አለቆችና ከመቅደስ አዛዦች ጋር ተነጋገረ።

verses.en: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
verses.fr: Ils furent dans la joie, et ils convinrent de lui donner de l''argent.
verses.am: እነርሱም ደስ አላቸው፥ ገንዘብም ሊሰጡት ተዋዋሉ።

verses.en: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
verses.fr: Après s''être engagé, il cherchait une occasion favorable pour leur livrer Jésus à l''insu de la foule.
verses.am: እሺም አለ፥ ሕዝብም በሌለበት አሳልፎ እንዲሰጣቸው ምቹ ጊዜ ይፈልግ ነበር።

verses.en: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
verses.fr: Le jour des pains sans levain, où l''on devait immoler la Pâque, arriva,
verses.am: ፋሲካንም ሊያርዱበት የሚገባው የቂጣ በዓል ደረሰ፤

verses.en: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
verses.fr: et Jésus envoya Pierre et Jean, en disant: Allez nous préparer la Pâque, afin que nous la mangions.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስንና ዮሐንስንም። ፋሲካን እንድንበላ ሄዳችሁ አዘጋጁልን ብሎ ላካቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: Où veux-tu que nous la préparions?
verses.am: እነርሱም። ወዴት እናዘጋጅ ዘንድ ትወዳለህ? አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Voici, quand vous serez entrés dans la ville, vous rencontrerez un homme portant une cruche d''eau; suivez-le dans la maison où il entrera,
verses.am: እርሱም አላቸው። እነሆ፥ ወደ ከተማ ስትገቡ ማድጋ ውኃ የተሸከመ ሰው ይገናኛችኋል፤ ወደ ሚገባበት ቤት ተከተሉት፤

verses.en: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.fr: et vous direz au maître de la maison: Le maître te dit: Où est le lieu où je mangerai la Pâque avec mes disciples?
verses.am: ለባለቤቱም። መምህሩ። ከደቀ መዛሙርቴ ጋር ፋሲካን የምበላበት የእንግዳ ቤት ክፍል ወዴት ነው? ይልሃል በሉት፤

verses.en: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
verses.fr: Et il vous montrera une grande chambre haute, meublée: c''est là que vous préparerez la Pâque.
verses.am: ያም በደርብ ላይ ያለውን የተነጠፈ ታላቅ አዳራሽ ያሳያችኋል፤ በዚያም አሰናዱልን።

verses.en: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.fr: Ils partirent, et trouvèrent les choses comme il le leur avait dit; et ils préparèrent la Pâque.
verses.am: ሄደውም እንዳላቸው አገኙና ፋሲካን አሰናዱ።

verses.en: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.
verses.fr: L''heure étant venue, il se mit à table, et les apôtres avec lui.
verses.am: ሰዓቱም በደረሰ ጊዜ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ሐዋርያት ጋር በማዕድ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:
verses.fr: Il leur dit: J''ai désiré vivement manger cette Pâque avec vous, avant de souffrir;
verses.am: እርሱም። ከመከራዬ በፊት ከእናንተ ጋር ይህን ፋሲካ ልበላ እጅግ እመኝ ነበር፤

verses.en: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: car, je vous le dis, je ne la mangerai plus, jusqu''à ce qu''elle soit accomplie dans le royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁና፥ በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እስኪፈጸም ድረስ፥ ወደ ፊት ከዚህ አልበላም አላቸው።

verses.en: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
verses.fr: Et, ayant pris une coupe et rendu grâces, il dit: Prenez cette coupe, et distribuez-la entre vous;
verses.am: ጽዋንም ተቀበለ አመስግኖም። ይህን እንካችሁ በመካከላችሁም ተካፈሉት፤

verses.en: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
verses.fr: car, je vous le dis, je ne boirai plus désormais du fruit de la vigne, jusqu''à ce que le royaume de Dieu soit venu.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁና፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እስክትመጣ ድረስ ከአሁን ጀምሮ ከወይኑ ፍሬ አልጠጣም አለ።

verses.en: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
verses.fr: Ensuite il prit du pain; et, après avoir rendu grâces, il le rompit, et le leur donna, en disant: Ceci est mon corps, qui est donné pour vous; faites ceci en mémoire de moi.
verses.am: እንጀራንም አንሥቶ አመሰገነ ቆርሶም ሰጣቸውና። ስለ እናንተ የሚሰጠው ሥጋዬ ይህ ነው፤ ይህን ለመታሰቢያዬ አድርጉት አለ።

verses.en: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
verses.fr: Il prit de même la coupe, après le souper, et la leur donna, en disant: Cette coupe est la nouvelle alliance en mon sang, qui est répandu pour vous.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ከእራት በኋላ ጽዋውን አንሥቶ እንዲህ አለ። ይህ ጽዋ ስለ እናንተ በሚፈሰው በደሜ የሚሆን አዲስ ኪዳን ነው።

verses.en: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
verses.fr: Cependant voici, la main de celui qui me livre est avec moi à cette table.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አሳልፎ የሚሰጠኝ እጅ እነሆ በማዕድ ከእኔ ጋር ናት።

verses.en: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
verses.fr: Le Fils de l''homme s''en va selon ce qui est déterminé. Mais malheur à l''homme par qui il est livré!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅስ እንደ ተወሰነው ይሄዳል፥ ነገር ግን አልፎ ለሚሰጥበት ለዚያ ሰው ወዮለት።

verses.en: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
verses.fr: Et ils commencèrent à se demander les uns aux autres qui était celui d''entre eux qui ferait cela.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ይህን ሊያደርግ ያለው ማን እንደ ሆነ እርስ በርሳቸው ይጠያየቁ ጀመር።

verses.en: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
verses.fr: Il s''éleva aussi parmi les apôtres une contestation: lequel d''entre eux devait être estimé le plus grand?
verses.am: ደግሞም ማናቸውም ታላቅ ሆኖ እንዲቈጠር በመካከላቸው ክርክር ሆነ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Les rois des nations les maîtrisent, et ceux qui les dominent sont appelés bienfaiteurs.
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። የአሕዛብ ነገሥታት ይገዙአቸዋል፥ በላያቸውም የሚሠለጥኑት ቸርነት አድራጊዎች ይባላሉ።

verses.en: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
verses.fr: Qu''il n''en soit pas de même pour vous. Mais que le plus grand parmi vous soit comme le plus petit, et celui qui gouverne comme celui qui sert.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን እንዲህ አትሁኑ፤ ነገር ግን ከእናንተ ታላቅ የሆነ በመካከላችሁ እንደ ታናሽ፥ የሚገዛም እንደሚያገለግል ይሁን።

verses.en: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
verses.fr: Car quel est le plus grand, celui qui est à table, ou celui qui sert? N''est-ce pas celui qui est à table? Et moi, cependant, je suis au milieu de vous comme celui qui sert.
verses.am: በማዕድ የተቀመጠ ወይስ የሚያገለግል ማናቸው ታላቅ ነው? የተቀመጠው አይደለምን? እኔ ግን በመካከላችሁ እንደሚያገለግል ነኝ።

verses.en: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
verses.fr: Vous, vous êtes ceux qui avez persévéré avec moi dans mes épreuves;
verses.am: ነገር ግን እናንተ በፈተናዎቼ ከእኔ ጋር ጸንታችሁ የኖራችሁ ናችሁ፤

verses.en: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
verses.fr: c''est pourquoi je dispose du royaume en votre faveur, comme mon Père en a disposé en ma faveur,
verses.am: ጌታም። ስምዖን ስምዖን ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ሰይጣን እንደ ስንዴ ሊያበጥራችሁ ለመነ፤

verses.en: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.fr: afin que vous mangiez et buviez à ma table dans mon royaume, et que vous soyez assis sur des trônes, pour juger les douze tribus d''Israël.
verses.am: ጌታም። ስምዖን ስምዖን ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ሰይጣን እንደ ስንዴ ሊያበጥራችሁ ለመነ፤

verses.en: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
verses.fr: Le Seigneur dit: Simon, Simon, Satan vous a réclamés, pour vous cribler comme le froment.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እምነትህ እንዳይጠፋ ስለ አንተ አማለድሁ፤ አንተም በተመለስህ ጊዜ ወንድሞችህን አጽና አለ።

verses.en: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
verses.fr: Mais j''ai prié pour toi, afin que ta foi ne défaille point; et toi, quand tu seras converti, affermis tes frères.
verses.am: እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወደ ወኅኒም ወደ ሞትም ከአንተ ጋር ለመሄድ የተዘጋጀሁ ነኝ አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
verses.fr: Seigneur, lui dit Pierre, je suis prêt à aller avec toi et en prison et à la mort.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። ጴጥሮስ ሆይ፥ እልሃለሁ፥ እንዳታውቀኝ ሦስት ጊዜ እስክትክደኝ ድረስ ዛሬ ዶሮ አይጮኽም አለው።

verses.en: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
verses.fr: Et Jésus dit: Pierre, je te le dis, le coq ne chantera pas aujourd''hui que tu n''aies nié trois fois de me connaître.
verses.am: ደግሞም። ያለ ኮረጆና ያለ ከረጢት ያለ ጫማም በላክኋችሁ ጊዜ፥ አንዳች ጐደለባችሁን? አላቸው። እነርሱም። አንዳች እንኳ አሉ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.
verses.fr: Il leur dit encore: Quand je vous ai envoyés sans bourse, sans sac, et sans souliers, avez-vous manqué de quelque chose? Ils répondirent: De rien.
verses.am: እርሱም። አሁን ግን ኮረጆ ያለው ከእርሱ ጋር ይውሰድ፥ ከረጢትም ያለው እንዲሁ፤ የሌለውም ልብሱን ሽጦ ሰይፍ ይግዛ።

verses.en: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
verses.fr: Et il leur dit: Maintenant, au contraire, que celui qui a une bourse la prenne et que celui qui a un sac le prenne également, que celui qui n''a point d''épée vende son vêtement et achète une épée.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁና፥ ይህ። ከዓመፀኞች ጋር ተቈጠረ ተብሎ የተጻፈው በእኔ ሊፈጸም ግድ ነው፤ አዎን፥ ስለ እኔ የሚሆነው አሁን ይፈጸማልና አላቸው።

verses.en: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.
verses.fr: Car, je vous le dis, il faut que cette parole qui est écrite s''accomplisse en moi: Il a été mis au nombre des malfaiteurs. Et ce qui me concerne est sur le point d''arriver.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ በዚህ ሁለት ሰይፎች አሉ አሉት። እርሱም። ይበቃል አላቸው።

verses.en: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
verses.fr: Ils dirent: Seigneur, voici deux épées. Et il leur dit: Cela suffit.
verses.am: ወጥቶም እንደ ልማዱ ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ሄደ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ደግሞ ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
verses.fr: Après être sorti, il alla, selon sa coutume, à la montagne des oliviers. Ses disciples le suivirent.
verses.am: ወደ ስፍራውም ደርሶ። ወደ ፈተና እንዳትገቡ ጸልዩ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il fut arrivé dans ce lieu, il leur dit: Priez, afin que vous ne tombiez pas en tentation.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም የድንጋይ ውርወራ የሚያህል ራቀ፥ ተንበርክኮም። አባት ሆይ፥

verses.en: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
verses.fr: Puis il s''éloigna d''eux à la distance d''environ un jet de pierre, et, s''étant mis à genoux, il pria,
verses.am: ብትፈቅድ ይህችን ጽዋ ከእኔ ውሰድ፤ ነገር ግን የእኔ ፈቃድ አይሁን የአንተ እንጂ እያለ ይጸልይ ነበር።

verses.en: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
verses.fr: disant: Père, si tu voulais éloigner de moi cette coupe! Toutefois, que ma volonté ne se fasse pas, mais la tienne.
verses.am: ከሰማይም መጥቶ የሚያበረታ መልአክ ታየው።

verses.en: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.
verses.fr: Alors un ange lui apparut du ciel, pour le fortifier.
verses.am: በፍርሃትም ሲጣጣር አጽንቶ ይጸልይ ነበር፤ ወዙም በምድር ላይ እንደሚወርድ እንደ ደም ነጠብጣብ ነበረ።

verses.en: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
verses.fr: Etant en agonie, il priait plus instamment, et sa sueur devint comme des grumeaux de sang, qui tombaient à terre.
verses.am: ከጸሎትም ተነሥቶ ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጣና ከኀዘን የተነሣ ተኝተው ሲያገኛቸው።

verses.en: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,
verses.fr: Après avoir prié, il se leva, et vint vers les disciples, qu''il trouva endormis de tristesse,
verses.am: ስለ ምን ትተኛላችሁ? ወደ ፈተና እንዳትገቡ ተነሥታችሁ ጸልዩ አላቸው።

verses.en: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
verses.fr: et il leur dit: Pourquoi dormez-vous? Levez-vous et priez, afin que vous ne tombiez pas en tentation.
verses.am: ገናም ሲናገር እነሆ፥ ሰዎች መጡ፤ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱም ይሁዳ የሚባለው ይቀድማቸው ነበር፥ ሊስመውም ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀረበ።

verses.en: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.
verses.fr: Comme il parlait encore, voici, une foule arriva; et celui qui s''appelait Judas, l''un des douze, marchait devant elle. Il s''approcha de Jésus, pour le baiser.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን። ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ በመሳም የሰውን ልጅ አሳልፈህ ትሰጣለህን? አለው።

verses.en: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
verses.fr: Et Jésus lui dit: Judas, c''est par un baiser que tu livres le Fils de l''homme!
verses.am: በዙሪያውም የነበሩት የሚሆነውን ባዩ ጊዜ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በሰይፍ እንምታቸውን? አሉት።

verses.en: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?
verses.fr: Ceux qui étaient avec Jésus, voyant ce qui allait arriver, dirent: Seigneur, frapperons-nous de l''épée?
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አንዱ የሊቀ ካህናቱን ባሪያ መትቶ ቀኝ ጆሮውን ቈረጠው።

verses.en: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
verses.fr: Et l''un d''eux frappa le serviteur du souverain sacrificateur, et lui emporta l''oreille droite.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን መልሶ። ይህንስ ፍቀዱ አለ፤ ጆሮውንም ዳስሶ ፈወሰው።

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus, prenant la parole, dit: Laissez, arrêtez! Et, ayant touché l''oreille de cet homme, il le guérit.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ እርሱ ለመጡበት ለካህናት አለቆችና ለመቅደስ አዛዦች ለሽማግሌዎችም። ወንበዴን እንደምትይዙ ሰይፍና ጐመድ ይዛችሁ ወጣችሁን?

verses.en: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?
verses.fr: Jésus dit ensuite aux principaux sacrificateurs, aux chefs des gardes du temple, et aux anciens, qui étaient venus contre lui: Vous êtes venus, comme après un brigand, avec des épées et des bâtons.
verses.am: በመቅደስ ዕለት ዕለት ከእናንተ ጋር ስሆን እጆቻችሁን አልዘረጋችሁብኝም፤ ይህ ግን ጊዜያችሁና የጨለማው ሥልጣን ነው አላቸው።

verses.en: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
verses.fr: J''étais tous les jours avec vous dans le temple, et vous n''avez pas mis la main sur moi. Mais c''est ici votre heure, et la puissance des ténèbres.
verses.am: ይዘውም ወሰዱት ወደ ሊቀ ካህናት ቤትም አገቡት፤ ጴጥሮስም ርቆ ይከተለው ነበር።

verses.en: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.
verses.fr: Après avoir saisi Jésus, ils l''emmenèrent, et le conduisirent dans la maison du souverain sacrificateur. Pierre suivait de loin.
verses.am: በግቢ መካከልም እሳት አንድደው በአንድነት ተቀምጠው ሳሉ ጴጥሮስ በመካከላቸው ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.
verses.fr: Ils allumèrent du feu au milieu de la cour, et ils s''assirent. Pierre s''assit parmi eux.
verses.am: በብርሃኑም በኩል ተቀምጦ ሳለ አንዲት ገረድ አየችውና ትኵር ብላ። ይህ ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ አለች።

verses.en: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.
verses.fr: Une servante, qui le vit assis devant le feu, fixa sur lui les regards, et dit: Cet homme était aussi avec lui.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። አንቺ ሴት፥ አላውቀውም ብሎ ካደ።

verses.en: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
verses.fr: Mais il le nia disant: Femme, je ne le connais pas.
verses.am: ከጥቂት ጊዜም በኋላ ሌላው አይቶት። አንተ ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ወገን ነህ አለው። ጴጥሮስ ግን። አንተ ሰው፥ እኔ አይደለሁም አለ።

verses.en: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
verses.fr: Peu après, un autre, l''ayant vu, dit: Tu es aussi de ces gens-là. Et Pierre dit: Homme, je n''en suis pas.
verses.am: አንድ ሰዓትም የሚያህል ቆይቶ ሌላው አስረግጦ። እርሱ የገሊላ ሰው ነውና በእውነት ይህ ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ አለ።

verses.en: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.
verses.fr: Environ une heure plus tard, un autre insistait, disant: Certainement cet homme était aussi avec lui, car il est Galiléen.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ግን። አንተ ሰው፥ የምትለውን አላውቅም አለ። ያን ጊዜም ገና ሲናገር ዶሮ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
verses.fr: Pierre répondit: Homme, je ne sais ce que tu dis. Au même instant, comme il parlait encore, le coq chanta.
verses.am: ጌታም ዘወር ብሎ ጴጥሮስን ተመለከተው፤ ጴጥሮስም። ዛሬ ዶሮ ሳይጮኽ ሦስት ጊዜ ትክደኛለህ እንዳለው የጌታ ቃል ትዝ አለው።

verses.en: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur, s''étant retourné, regarda Pierre. Et Pierre se souvint de la parole que le Seigneur lui avait dite: Avant que le coq chante aujourd''hui, tu me renieras trois fois.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ወደ ውጭ ወጥቶ ምርር ብሎ አለቀሰ።

verses.en: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.fr: Et étant sorti, il pleura amèrement.
verses.am: ኢየሱስንም የያዙት ሰዎች ይዘብቱበትና ይደበድቡት ነበር፤

verses.en: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.
verses.fr: Les hommes qui tenaient Jésus se moquaient de lui, et le frappaient.
verses.am: ሸፍነውም ፊቱን ይመቱት ነበርና። በጥፊ የመታህ ማን ነው? ትንቢት ተናገር እያሉ ይጠይቁት ነበር።

verses.en: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
verses.fr: Ils lui voilèrent le visage, et ils l''interrogeaient, en disant: Devine qui t''a frappé.
verses.am: ሌላም ብዙ ነገር እየተሳደቡ በእርሱ ላይ ይናገሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
verses.fr: Et ils proféraient contre lui beaucoup d''autres injures.
verses.am: በነጋም ጊዜ የሕዝቡ ሽማግሌዎችና የካህናት አለቆች ጻፎችም ተሰብስበው ወደ ሸንጎአቸው ወሰዱትና

verses.en: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,
verses.fr: Quand le jour fut venu, le collège des anciens du peuple, les principaux sacrificateurs et les scribes, s''assemblèrent, et firent amener Jésus dans leur sanhédrin. Ils dirent:
verses.am: ክርስቶስ አንተ ነህን? ንገረን አሉት። እርሱ ግን እንዲህ አላቸው። ብነግራችሁ አታምኑም፤

verses.en: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
verses.fr: Si tu es le Christ, dis-le nous. Jésus leur répondit: Si je vous le dis, vous ne le croirez pas;
verses.am: ብጠይቅም አትመልሱልኝም አትፈቱኝምም።

verses.en: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
verses.fr: et, si je vous interroge, vous ne répondrez pas.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከአሁን ጀምሮ የሰው ልጅ በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል ቀኝ ይቀመጣል።

verses.en: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.
verses.fr: Désormais le Fils de l''homme sera assis à la droite de la puissance de Dieu.
verses.am: ሁላቸውም። እንግዲያስ አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህን? አሉት። እርሱም። እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ እናንተ ትላላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
verses.fr: Tous dirent: Tu es donc le Fils de Dieu? Et il leur répondit: Vous le dites, je le suis.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ራሳችን ከአፉ ሰምተናልና ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ምን ምስክር ያስፈልገናል? አሉ።

verses.en: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.
verses.fr: Alors ils dirent: Qu''avons-nous encore besoin de témoignage? Nous l''avons entendu nous-mêmes de sa bouche.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ራሳችን ከአፉ ሰምተናልና ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ምን ምስክር ያስፈልገናል? አሉ።

verses.en: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
verses.fr: Ils se levèrent tous, et ils conduisirent Jésus devant Pilate.
verses.am: ሁሉም በሞላው ተነሥተው ወደ ጲላጦስ ወሰዱትና።

verses.en: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
verses.fr: Ils se mirent à l''accuser, disant: Nous avons trouvé cet homme excitant notre nation à la révolte, empêchant de payer le tribut à César, et se disant lui-même Christ, roi.
verses.am: ይህ ሕዝባችንን ሲያጣምም ለቄሣርም ግብር እንዳይሰጥ ሲከለክል ደግሞም። እኔ ክርስቶስ ንጉሥ ነኝ ሲል አገኘነው ብለው ይከሱት ጀመር።

verses.en: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.
verses.fr: Pilate l''interrogea, en ces termes: Es-tu le roi des Juifs? Jésus lui répondit: Tu le dis.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም። አንተ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ነህን? ብሎ ጠየቀው። እርሱም መልሶ። አንተ አልህ አለው።

verses.en: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
verses.fr: Pilate dit aux principaux sacrificateurs et à la foule: Je ne trouve rien de coupable en cet homme.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም ለካህናት አለቆችና ለሕዝቡ። በዚህ ሰው አንድ በደል ስንኳ አላገኘሁበትም አለ።

verses.en: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
verses.fr: Mais ils insistèrent, et dirent: Il soulève le peuple, en enseignant par toute la Judée, depuis la Galilée, où il a commencé, jusqu''ici.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን አጽንተው። ከገሊላ ጀምሮ እስከዚህ ድረስ በይሁዳ ሁሉ እያስተማረ ሕዝቡን ያውካል አሉ።

verses.en: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.
verses.fr: Quand Pilate entendit parler de la Galilée, il demanda si cet homme était Galiléen;
verses.am: ጲላጦስ ግን። ገሊላ ሲሉ በሰማ ጊዜ። የገሊላ ሰው ነውን? ብሎ ጠየቀ፤

verses.en: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
verses.fr: et, ayant appris qu''il était de la juridiction d''Hérode, il le renvoya à Hérode, qui se trouvait aussi à Jérusalem en ces jours-là.
verses.am: ከሄሮድስም ግዛት እንደ ሆነ ባወቀ ጊዜ ወደ ሄሮድስ ሰደደው፤ እርሱ ደግሞ በዚያ ጊዜ በኢየሩሳሌም ነበረና።

verses.en: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
verses.fr: Lorsque Hérode vit Jésus, il en eut une grande joie; car depuis longtemps, il désirait le voir, à cause de ce qu''il avait entendu dire de lui, et il espérait qu''il le verrait faire quelque miracle.
verses.am: ሄሮድስም ኢየሱስን ባየው ጊዜ እጅግ ደስ አለው፤ ስለ እርሱ ስለ ሰማ ከብዙ ጊዜ ጀምሮ ሊያየው ይመኝ ነበርና፥ ምልክትም ሲያደርግ ሊያይ ተስፋ ያደርግ ነበር።

verses.en: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
verses.fr: Il lui adressa beaucoup de questions; mais Jésus ne lui répondit rien.
verses.am: በብዙ ቃልም ጠየቀው፤ እርሱ ግን አንድ ስንኳ አልመለሰለትም።

verses.en: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
verses.fr: Les principaux sacrificateurs et les scribes étaient là, et l''accusaient avec violence.
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎችም አጽንተው ሲከሱት ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
verses.fr: Hérode, avec ses gardes, le traita avec mépris; et, après s''être moqué de lui et l''avoir revêtu d''un habit éclatant, il le renvoya à Pilate.
verses.am: ሄሮድስም ከሠራዊቱ ጋር ናቀው ዘበተበትም፥ የጌጥ ልብስም አልብሶ ወደ ጲላጦስ መልሶ ሰደደው።

verses.en: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
verses.fr: Ce jour même, Pilate et Hérode devinrent amis, d''ennemis qu''ils étaient auparavant.
verses.am: ሄሮድስና ጲላጦስም በዚያን ቀን እርስ በርሳቸው ወዳጆች ሆኑ፥ ቀድሞ በመካከላቸው ጥል ነበረና።

verses.en: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
verses.fr: Pilate, ayant assemblé les principaux sacrificateurs, les magistrats, et le peuple,
verses.am: ጲላጦስም፥ የካህናትን አለቆችና መኳንንትን ሕዝቡንም በአንድነት ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው።

verses.en: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
verses.fr: leur dit: Vous m''avez amené cet homme comme excitant le peuple à la révolte. Et voici, je l''ai interrogé devant vous, et je ne l''ai trouvé coupable d''aucune des choses dont vous l''accusez;
verses.am: ሕዝቡን ያጣምማል ብላችሁ ይህን ሰው ወደ እኔ አመጣችሁት፤ እነሆም፥ በፊታችሁ መርምሬ ከምትከሱበት ነገር አንድ በደል ስንኳ በዚህ ሰው አላገኘሁበትም።

verses.en: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
verses.fr: Hérode non plus, car il nous l''a renvoyé, et voici, cet homme n''a rien fait qui soit digne de mort.
verses.am: ሄሮድስም ደግሞ ምንም አላገኘም፤ ወደ እኛ መልሶታልና፤ እነሆም፥ ለሞት የሚያደርሰው ምንም አላደረገም፤

verses.en: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
verses.fr: Je le relâcherai donc, après l''avoir fait battre de verges.
verses.am: ሁላቸውም በአንድነት። ይህን አስወግድ፥ በርባንንም ፍታልን እያሉ ጮኹ፤

verses.en: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)
verses.fr: A chaque fête, il était obligé de leur relâcher un prisonnier.
verses.am: ሁላቸውም በአንድነት። ይህን አስወግድ፥ በርባንንም ፍታልን እያሉ ጮኹ፤

verses.en: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:
verses.fr: Ils s''écrièrent tous ensemble: Fais mourir celui-ci, et relâche-nous Barabbas.
verses.am: እርሱም ሁከትን በከተማ አንሥቶ ሰውን ስለ ገደለ በወኅኒ ታስሮ ነበር።

verses.en: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
verses.fr: Cet homme avait été mis en prison pour une sédition qui avait eu lieu dans la ville, et pour un meurtre.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም ኢየሱስን ሊፈታ ወድዶ ዳግመኛ ተናገራቸው፤

verses.en: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.
verses.fr: Pilate leur parla de nouveau, dans l''intention de relâcher Jésus.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እነርሱ። ስቀለው ስቀለው እያሉ ይጮኹ ነበር።

verses.en: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.
verses.fr: Et ils crièrent: Crucifie, crucifie-le!
verses.am: ሦስተኛም። ምን ነው? ያደረገውስ ክፋት ምንድር ነው? ለሞት የሚያደርሰው በደል አላገኘሁበትም፤ ስለዚህ ቀጥቼ እፈታዋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
verses.fr: Pilate leur dit pour la troisième fois: Quel mal a-t-il fait? Je n''ai rien trouvé en lui qui mérite la mort. Je le relâcherai donc, après l''avoir fait battre de verges.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን እንዲሰቀል በታላቅ ድምፅ አጽንተው ለመኑት። የእነርሱ ጩኸትና የካህናት አለቆችም ቃል በረታ።

verses.en: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
verses.fr: Mais ils insistèrent à grands cris, demandant qu''il fût crucifié. Et leurs cris l''emportèrent:
verses.am: ጲላጦስም ልመናቸው እንዲሆንላቸው ፈረደበት።

verses.en: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
verses.fr: Pilate prononça que ce qu''ils demandaient serait fait.
verses.am: ያንን የለመኑትንም፥ ስለ ሁከት ሰውንም ስለ መግደል በወኅኒ ታስሮ የነበረውን አስፈታላቸው፥ ኢየሱስን ግን ለፈቃዳቸው አሳልፎ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
verses.fr: Il relâcha celui qui avait été mis en prison pour sédition et pour meurtre, et qu''ils réclamaient; et il livra Jésus à leur volonté.
verses.am: በወሰዱትም ጊዜ ስምዖን የተባለ የቀሬናን ሰው ከገጠር ሲመጣ ይዘው ከኢየሱስ በኋላ መስቀሉን እንዲሸከም ጫኑበት።

verses.en: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
verses.fr: Comme ils l''emmenaient, ils prirent un certain Simon de Cyrène, qui revenait des champs, et ils le chargèrent de la croix, pour qu''il la porte derrière Jésus.
verses.am: ዋይ ዋይ ከሚሉና ሙሾ ከሚያወጡ ሴቶችና ከሕዝቡ እጅግ ብዙዎች ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
verses.fr: Il était suivi d''une grande multitude des gens du peuple, et de femmes qui se frappaient la poitrine et se lamentaient sur lui.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ተራራዎችን። በላያችን ውደቁ፥ ኮረብቶችንም። ሰውሩን ይሉ ዘንድ ይጀምራሉ፤

verses.en: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
verses.fr: Jésus se tourna vers elles, et dit: Filles de Jérusalem, ne pleurez pas sur moi; mais pleurez sur vous et sur vos enfants.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ተራራዎችን። በላያችን ውደቁ፥ ኮረብቶችንም። ሰውሩን ይሉ ዘንድ ይጀምራሉ፤

verses.en: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
verses.fr: Car voici, des jours viendront où l''on dira: Heureuses les stériles, heureuses les entrailles qui n''ont point enfanté, et les mamelles qui n''ont point allaité!
verses.am: በእርጥብ እንጨት እንዲህ የሚያደርጉ ከሆኑ፥ በደረቀውስ እንዴት ይሆን?

verses.en: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
verses.fr: Alors ils se mettront à dire aux montagnes: Tombez sur nous! Et aux collines: Couvrez-nous!
verses.am: ሌሎችንም ሁለት ክፉ አድራጊዎች ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር ይገድሉ ዘንድ ወሰዱ።

verses.en: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
verses.fr: Car, si l''on fait ces choses au bois vert, qu''arrivera-t-il au bois sec?
verses.am: ቀራንዮም ወደሚባል ስፍራ በደረሱ ጊዜ፥ በዚያ እርሱን ክፉ አድራጊዎቹንም አንዱን በቀኝ ሁለተኛውንም በግራ ሰቀሉ።

verses.en: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
verses.fr: On conduisait en même temps deux malfaiteurs, qui devaient être mis à mort avec Jésus.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። አባት ሆይ፥ የሚያደርጉትን አያውቁምና ይቅር በላቸው አለ። ልብሱንም ተካፍለው ዕጣ ተጣጣሉበት።

verses.en: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils furent arrivés au lieu appelé Crâne, ils le crucifièrent là, ainsi que les deux malfaiteurs, l''un à droite, l''autre à gauche.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ቆመው ይመለከቱ ነበር። መኳንንቱም ደግሞ። ሌሎችን አዳነ፤ እርሱ በእግዚአብሔር የተመረጠው ክርስቶስ ከሆነ፥ ራሱን ያድን እያሉ ያፌዙበት ነበር።

verses.en: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
verses.fr: Jésus dit: Père, pardonne-leur, car ils ne savent ce qu''ils font. Ils se partagèrent ses vêtements, en tirant au sort.
verses.am: ጭፍሮችም ደግሞ ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው ሆምጣጤም አምጥተው።

verses.en: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
verses.fr: Le peuple se tenait là, et regardait. Les magistrats se moquaient de Jésus, disant: Il a sauvé les autres; qu''il se sauve lui-même, s''il est le Christ, l''élu de Dieu!
verses.am: አንተስ የአሁድ ንጉሥ ከሆንህ፥ ራስህን አድን እያሉ ይዘብቱበት ነበር።

verses.en: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
verses.fr: Les soldats aussi se moquaient de lui; s''approchant et lui présentant du vinaigre,
verses.am: ይህ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ነው ተብሎ በግሪክና በሮማይስጥ በዕብራይስጥም ፊደል የተጻፈ ጽሕፈት ደግሞ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ።

verses.en: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.
verses.fr: ils disaient: Si tu es le roi des Juifs, sauve-toi toi-même!
verses.am: ከተሰቀሉት ከክፉ አድራጊዎቹም አንዱ። አንተስ ክርስቶስ አይደለህምን? ራስህንም እኛንም አድን ብሎ ሰደበው።

verses.en: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, This Is The King Of The Jews.
verses.fr: Il y avait au-dessus de lui cette inscription: Celui-ci est le roi des Juifs.
verses.am: ሁለተኛው ግን መልሶ። አንተ እንደዚህ ባለ ፍርድ ሳለህ እግዚአብሔርን ከቶ አትፈራውምን?

verses.en: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
verses.fr: L''un des malfaiteurs crucifiés l''injuriait, disant: N''es-tu pas le Christ? Sauve-toi toi-même, et sauve-nous!
verses.am: ስለ አደረግነውም የሚገባንን እንቀበላለንና በእኛስ እውነተኛ ፍርድ ነው፤ ይህ ግን ምንም ክፋት አላደረገም ብሎ ገሠጸው።

verses.en: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
verses.fr: Mais l''autre le reprenait, et disait: Ne crains-tu pas Dieu, toi qui subis la même condamnation?
verses.am: ኢየሱስንም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በመንግሥትህ በመጣህ ጊዜ አስበኝ አለው።

verses.en: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
verses.fr: Pour nous, c''est justice, car nous recevons ce qu''ont mérité nos crimes; mais celui-ci n''a rien fait de mal.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ ዛሬ ከእኔ ጋር በገነት ትሆናለህ አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
verses.fr: Et il dit à Jésus: Souviens-toi de moi, quand tu viendras dans ton règne.
verses.am: ስድስት ሰዓትም ያህል ነበረ፥ ጨለማም እስከ ዘጠኝ ሰዓት በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ሆነ፥ ፀሐይም ጨለመ፥

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, Today shalt thou be with me in paradise.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Je te le dis en vérité, aujourd''hui tu seras avec moi dans le paradis.
verses.am: የቤተ መቅደስም መጋረጃ ከመካከሉ ተቀደደ።

verses.en: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.
verses.fr: Il était déjà environ la sixième heure, et il y eut des ténèbres sur toute la terre, jusqu''à la neuvième heure.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኾ። አባት ሆይ፥ ነፍሴን በእጅህ አደራ እሰጣለሁ አለ። ይህንም ብሎ ነፍሱን ሰጠ።

verses.en: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
verses.fr: Le soleil s''obscurcit, et le voile du temple se déchira par le milieu.
verses.am: የመቶ አለቃውም የሆነውን ነገር ባየ ጊዜ። ይህ ሰው በእውነት ጻድቅ ነበረ ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን አከበረ።

verses.en: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
verses.fr: Jésus s''écria d''une voix forte: Père, je remets mon esprit entre tes mains. Et, en disant ces paroles, il expira.
verses.am: ይህንም ለማየት ተከማችተው የነበሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ የሆነውን ባዩ ጊዜ፥ ደረታቸውን እየደቁ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
verses.fr: Le centenier, voyant ce qui était arrivé, glorifia Dieu, et dit: Certainement, cet homme était juste.
verses.am: የሚያውቁቱ ግን ሁሉ ከገሊላ የተከተሉት ሴቶችም ይህን እያዩ በሩቅ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
verses.fr: Et tous ceux qui assistaient en foule à ce spectacle, après avoir vu ce qui était arrivé, s''en retournèrent, se frappant la poitrine.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ በጎና ጻድቅ ሰው የሸንጎ አማካሪም የሆነ ዮሴፍ የሚባል ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.en: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
verses.fr: Tous ceux de la connaissance de Jésus, et les femmes qui l''avaient accompagné depuis la Galilée, se tenaient dans l''éloignement et regardaient ce qui se passait.
verses.am: ይህም በምክራቸውና በሥራቸው አልተባበረም ነበር፤ አርማትያስም ከምትባል ከአይሁድ ከተማ ሆኖ እርሱ ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ይጠባበቅ ነበር።

verses.en: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:
verses.fr: Il y avait un conseiller, nommé Joseph, homme bon et juste,
verses.am: ይኸውም ወደ ጲላጦስ ቀርቦ የኢየሱስን ሥጋ ለመነው፤

verses.en: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: qui n''avait point participé à la décision et aux actes des autres; il était d''Arimathée, ville des Juifs, et il attendait le royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: አውርዶም በተልባ እግር ልብስ ከፈነው፥ ማንም ገና ባልተቀበረበት ከዓለትም በተወቀረ መቃብር አኖረው።

verses.en: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
verses.fr: Cet homme se rendit vers Pilate, et demanda le corps de Jésus.
verses.am: የመዘጋጀት ቀንም ነበረ፤ ሰንበትም ሊጀምር ነበረ።

verses.en: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
verses.fr: Il le descendit de la croix, l''enveloppa d''un linceul, et le déposa dans un sépulcre taillé dans le roc, où personne n''avait encore été mis.
verses.am: ከገሊላም ከእርሱ ጋር የመጡት ሴቶች ተከትለው መቃብሩን ሥጋውንም እንዴት እንዳኖሩት አዩ።

verses.en: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
verses.fr: C''était le jour de la préparation, et le sabbat allait commencer.
verses.am: ተመልሰውም ሽቱና ቅባት አዘጋጁ። በሰንበትም እንደ ትእዛዙ ዐረፉ።

verses.en: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
verses.fr: Les femmes qui étaient venues de la Galilée avec Jésus accompagnèrent Joseph, virent le sépulcre et la manière dont le corps de Jésus y fut déposé,
verses.am: ከገሊላም ከእርሱ ጋር የመጡት ሴቶች ተከትለው መቃብሩን ሥጋውንም እንዴት እንዳኖሩት አዩ።

verses.en: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
verses.fr: et, s''en étant retournées, elles préparèrent des aromates et des parfums. Puis elles se reposèrent le jour du sabbat, selon la loi.
verses.am: ተመልሰውም ሽቱና ቅባት አዘጋጁ። በሰንበትም እንደ ትእዛዙ ዐረፉ።

verses.en: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.
verses.fr: Le premier jour de la semaine, elles se rendirent au sépulcre de grand matin, portant les aromates qu''elles avaient préparés.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከሳምንቱ በመጀመሪያው ቀን ያዘጋጁትን ሽቱ ይዘው ከእነርሱም ጋር አንዳንዶቹ ወደ መቃብሩ እጅግ ማልደው መጡ።

verses.en: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.
verses.fr: Elles trouvèrent que la pierre avait été roulée de devant le sépulcre;
verses.am: ድንጋዩንም ከመቃብሩ ተንከባሎ አገኙት፥

verses.en: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
verses.fr: et, étant entrées, elles ne trouvèrent pas le corps du Seigneur Jésus.
verses.am: ገብተውም የጌታን የኢየሱስን ሥጋ አላገኙም።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:
verses.fr: Comme elles ne savaient que penser de cela, voici, deux hommes leur apparurent, en habits resplendissants.
verses.am: እነርሱም በዚህ ሲያመነቱ፥ እነሆ፥ ሁለት ሰዎች የሚያንጸባርቅ ልብስ ለብሰው ወደ እነርሱ ቀረቡ፤

verses.en: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?
verses.fr: Saisies de frayeur, elles baissèrent le visage contre terre; mais ils leur dirent: Pourquoi cherchez-vous parmi les morts celui qui est vivant?
verses.am: ፈርተውም ፊታቸውን ወደ ምድር አቀርቅረው ሳሉ፥ እንዲህ አሉአቸው። ሕያውን ከሙታን መካከል ስለ ምን ትፈልጋላችሁ? ተነሥቶአል እንጂ በዚህ የለም።

verses.en: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
verses.fr: Il n''est point ici, mais il est ressuscité. Souvenez-vous de quelle manière il vous a parlé, lorsqu''il était encore en Galilée,

verses.en: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
verses.fr: et qu''il disait: Il faut que le Fils de l''homme soit livré entre les mains des pécheurs, qu''il soit crucifié, et qu''il ressuscite le troisième jour.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ በኃጢአተኞች እጅ አልፎ ሊሰጥና ሊሰቀል በሦስተኛውም ቀን ሊነሣ ግድ ነው እያለ ገና በገሊላ ሳለ ለእናንተ እንደ ተናገረ አስቡ።

verses.en: And they remembered his words,
verses.fr: Et elles se ressouvinrent des paroles de Jésus.

verses.en: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.
verses.fr: A leur retour du sépulcre, elles annoncèrent toutes ces choses aux onze, et à tous les autres.
verses.am: ቃሎቹንም አሰቡ፥ ከመቃብሩም ተመልሰው ይህን ሁሉ ለአሥራ አንዱና ለሌሎች ሁሉ ነገሩአቸው።

verses.en: It was Mary Magdalene and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.
verses.fr: Celles qui dirent ces choses aux apôtres étaient Marie de Magdala, Jeanne, Marie, mère de Jacques, et les autres qui étaient avec elles.
verses.am: ይህንም ለሐዋርያት የነገሩአቸው መግደላዊት ማርያምና ዮሐና የያዕቆብም እናት ማርያም ከእነርሱም ጋር የነበሩት ሌሎች ሴቶች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
verses.fr: Ils tinrent ces discours pour des rêveries, et ils ne crurent pas ces femmes.
verses.am: ይህም ቃል ቅዠት መስሎ ታያቸውና አላመኑአቸውም።

verses.en: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.
verses.fr: Mais Pierre se leva, et courut au sépulcre. S''étant baissé, il ne vit que les linges qui étaient à terre; puis il s''en alla chez lui, dans l''étonnement de ce qui était arrivé.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ግን ተነሥቶ ወደ መቃብር ሮጠ፤ በዚያም ዝቅ ብሎ ሲመለከት የተልባ እግር ልብስን ብቻ አየ፤ በሆነውም ነገር እየተደነቀ ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.en: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
verses.fr: Et voici, ce même jour, deux disciples allaient à un village nommé Emmaüs, éloigné de Jérusalem de soixante stades;
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ከእነርሱ ሁለቱ በዚያ ቀን ከኢየሩሳሌም ስድሳ ምዕራፍ ያህል ወደሚርቅ ኤማሁስ ወደሚባል መንደር ይሄዱ ነበር፤

verses.en: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
verses.fr: et ils s''entretenaient de tout ce qui s''était passé.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ስለ ሆነው ነገር ሁሉ እርስ በርሳቸው ይነጋገሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''ils parlaient et discutaient, Jésus s''approcha, et fit route avec eux.
verses.am: ሲነጋገሩና ሲመራመሩም፥ ኢየሱስ ራሱ ቀርቦ ከእነርሱ ጋር ይሄድ ነበር፤

verses.en: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
verses.fr: Mais leurs yeux étaient empêchés de le reconnaître.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እንዳያውቁት ዓይናቸው ተይዞ ነበር።

verses.en: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
verses.fr: Il leur dit: De quoi vous entretenez-vous en marchant, pour que vous soyez tout tristes?
verses.am: እርሱም። እየጠወለጋችሁ ስትሄዱ፥ እርስ በርሳችሁ የምትነጋገሩአቸው እነዚህ ነገሮች ምንድር ናቸው? አላቸው።

verses.en: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?
verses.fr: L''un d''eux, nommé Cléopas, lui répondit: Es-tu le seul qui, séjournant à Jérusalem ne sache pas ce qui y est arrivé ces jours-ci? -
verses.am: ቀለዮጳ የሚባልም አንዱ መልሶ። አንተ በኢየሩሳሌም እንግዳ ሆነህ ለብቻህ ትኖራለህን? በእነዚህ ቀኖች በዚያ የሆነውን ነገር አታውቅምን? አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:
verses.fr: Quoi? leur dit-il. Et ils lui répondirent: Ce qui est arrivé au sujet de Jésus de Nazareth, qui était un prophète puissant en oeuvres et en paroles devant Dieu et devant tout le peuple,
verses.am: እርሱም። ይህ ምንድር ነው? አላቸው። እነርሱም እንዲህ አሉት። በእግዚአብሔርና በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት በሥራና በቃል ብርቱ ነቢይ ስለ ነበረው ስለ ናዝሬቱ ስለ ኢየሱስ፤

verses.en: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.
verses.fr: et comment les principaux sacrificateurs et nos magistrats l''ont livré pour le faire condamner à mort et l''ont crucifié.
verses.am: እርሱንም የካህናት አለቆችና መኳንንቶቻችን ለሞት ፍርድ እንዴት አሳልፈው እንደ ሰጡትና እንደ ሰቀሉት ነው።

verses.en: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
verses.fr: Nous espérions que ce serait lui qui délivrerait Israël; mais avec tout cela, voici le troisième jour que ces choses se sont passées.
verses.am: እኛ ግን እስራኤልን እንዲቤዥ ያለው እርሱ እንደ ሆነ ተስፋ አድርገን ነበር፤ ደግሞም ከዚህ ሁሉ ጋር ይህ ከሆነ ዛሬ ሦስተኛው ቀን ነው።

verses.en: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;
verses.fr: Il est vrai que quelques femmes d''entre nous nous ont fort étonnés; s''étant rendues de grand matin au sépulcre
verses.am: ደግሞም ከእኛ ውስጥ ማልደው ከመቃብሩ ዘንድ የነበሩት አንዳንድ ሴቶች አስገረሙን፤

verses.en: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
verses.fr: et n''ayant pas trouvé son corps, elles sont venues dire que des anges leur sont apparus et ont annoncé qu''il est vivant.
verses.am: ሥጋውንም ባጡ ጊዜ። ሕያው ነው የሚሉ የመላእክትን ራእይ ደግሞ አየን ሲሉ መጥተው ነበር።

verses.en: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
verses.fr: Quelques-uns de ceux qui étaient avec nous sont allés au sépulcre, et ils ont trouvé les choses comme les femmes l''avaient dit; mais lui, ils ne l''ont point vu.
verses.am: ከእኛም ጋር ከነበሩት ወደ መቃብር ሄደው ሴቶች እንደ ተናገሩት ሆኖ አገኙት፥ እርሱን ግን አላዩትም።

verses.en: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:
verses.fr: Alors Jésus leur dit: O hommes sans intelligence, et dont le coeur est lent à croire tout ce qu''ont dit les prophètes!
verses.am: እርሱም። እናንተ የማታስተውሉ፥ ነቢያትም የተናገሩትን ሁሉ ልባችሁ ከማመን የዘገየ፤

verses.en: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?
verses.fr: Ne fallait-il pas que le Christ souffrît ces choses, et qu''il entrât dans sa gloire?
verses.am: ክርስቶስ ይህን መከራ ይቀበል ዘንድና ወደ ክብሩ ይገባ ዘንድ ይገባው የለምን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
verses.fr: Et, commençant par Moïse et par tous les prophètes, il leur expliqua dans toutes les Ecritures ce qui le concernait.
verses.am: ከሙሴና ከነቢያት ሁሉ ጀምሮ ስለ እርሱ በመጻሕፍት ሁሉ የተጻፈውን ተረጐመላቸው።

verses.en: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils furent près du village où ils allaient, il parut vouloir aller plus loin.
verses.am: ወደሚሄዱበትም መንደር ቀረቡ፥ እርሱም ሩቅ የሚሄድ መሰላቸው።

verses.en: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.
verses.fr: Mais ils le pressèrent, en disant: Reste avec nous, car le soir approche, le jour est sur son déclin. Et il entra, pour rester avec eux.
verses.am: እነርሱ። ከእኛ ጋር እደር፥ ማታ ቀርቦአልና ቀኑም ሊመሽ ጀምሮአል ብለው ግድ አሉት፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር ሊያድር ገባ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''il était à table avec eux, il prit le pain; et, après avoir rendu grâces, il le rompit, et le leur donna.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር በማዕድ ተቀምጦ ሳለ እንጀራውን አንሥቶ ባረከው፥ ቈርሶም ሰጣቸው፤

verses.en: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
verses.fr: Alors leurs yeux s''ouvrirent, et ils le reconnurent; mais il disparut de devant eux.
verses.am: ዓይናቸውም ተከፈተ፥ አወቁትም፤ እርሱም ከእነርሱ ተሰወረ።

verses.en: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
verses.fr: Et ils se dirent l''un à l''autre: Notre coeur ne brûlait-il pas au dedans de nous, lorsqu''il nous parlait en chemin et nous expliquait les Ecritures?
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸውም። በመንገድ ሲናገረን መጻሕፍትንም ሲከፍትልን ልባችን ይቃጠልብን አልነበረምን? ተባባሉ።

verses.en: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
verses.fr: Se levant à l''heure même, ils retournèrent à Jérusalem, et ils trouvèrent les onze, et ceux qui étaient avec eux, assemblés

verses.en: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
verses.fr: et disant: Le Seigneur est réellement ressuscité, et il est apparu à Simon.
verses.am: በዚያችም ሰዓት ተነሥተው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ፥ አሥራ አንዱና ከእነርሱ ጋር የነበሩትም። ጌታ በእውነት ተነሥቶአል ለስምዖንም ታይቶአል እያሉ በአንድነት ተሰብስበው አገኙአቸው።

verses.en: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
verses.fr: Et ils racontèrent ce qui leur était arrivé en chemin, et comment ils l''avaient reconnu au moment où il rompit le pain.
verses.am: እነርሱም በመንገድ የሆነውን እንጀራውንም በቈረሰ ጊዜ እንዴት እንደ ታወቀላቸው ተረኩላቸው።

verses.en: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
verses.fr: Tandis qu''ils parlaient de la sorte, lui-même se présenta au milieu d''eux, et leur dit: La paix soit avec vous!
verses.am: ይህንም ሲነጋገሩ ኢየሱስ ራሱ በመካከላቸው ቆሞ። ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን አላቸው።

verses.en: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
verses.fr: Saisis de frayeur et d''épouvante, ils croyaient voir un esprit.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ደነገጡና ፈሩ መንፈስም ያዩ መሰላቸው።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?
verses.fr: Mais il leur dit: Pourquoi êtes-vous troublés, et pourquoi pareilles pensées s''élèvent-elles dans vos coeurs?
verses.am: እርሱም። ስለ ምን ትደነግጣላችሁ? ስለ ምንስ አሳብ በልባችሁ ይነሣል?

verses.en: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.
verses.fr: Voyez mes mains et mes pieds, c''est bien moi; touchez-moi et voyez: un esprit n''a ni chair ni os, comme vous voyez que j''ai.
verses.am: እኔ ራሴ እንደ ሆንሁ እጆቼንና እግሮቼን እዩ፤ በእኔ እንደምታዩት፥ መንፈስ ሥጋና አጥንት የለውምና እኔን ዳስሳችሁ እዩ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.
verses.fr: Et en disant cela, il leur montra ses mains et ses pieds.
verses.am: ይህንም ብሎ እጆቹንና እግሮቹን አሳያቸው።

verses.en: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?
verses.fr: Comme, dans leur joie, ils ne croyaient point encore, et qu''ils étaient dans l''étonnement, il leur dit: Avez-vous ici quelque chose à manger?
verses.am: እነርሱም ከደስታ የተነሣ ገና ስላላመኑ ሲደነቁ ሳሉ። በዚህ አንዳች የሚበላ አላችሁን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
verses.fr: Ils lui présentèrent du poisson rôti et un rayon de miel.
verses.am: እነርሱም ከተጠበሰ ዓሣ አንድ ቁራጭ፥ ከማር ወለላም ሰጡት፤

verses.en: And he took it, and did eat before them.
verses.fr: Il en prit, et il mangea devant eux.
verses.am: ተቀብሎም በፊታቸው በላ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.
verses.fr: Puis il leur dit: C''est là ce que je vous disais lorsque j''étais encore avec vous, qu''il fallait que s''accomplît tout ce qui est écrit de moi dans la loi de Moïse, dans les prophètes, et dans les psaumes.
verses.am: እርሱም። ከእናንተ ጋር ሳለሁ በሙሴ ሕግና በነቢያት በመዝሙራትም ስለ እኔ የተጻፈው ሁሉ ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይገባል ብዬ የነገርኋችሁ ቃሌ ይህ ነው አላቸው።

verses.en: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,
verses.fr: Alors il leur ouvrit l''esprit, afin qu''ils comprissent les Ecritures.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም መጻሕፍትን ያስተውሉ ዘንድ አእምሮአቸውን ከፈተላቸው፤

verses.en: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behooved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:
verses.fr: Et il leur dit: Ainsi il est écrit que le Christ souffrirait, et qu''il ressusciterait des morts le troisième jour,
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። ክርስቶስ መከራ ይቀበላል በሦስተኛውም ቀን ከሙታን ይነሣል፥

verses.en: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
verses.fr: et que la repentance et le pardon des péchés seraient prêchés en son nom à toutes les nations, à commencer par Jérusalem.
verses.am: በስሙም ንስሐና የኃጢአት ስርየት ከኢየሩሳሌም ጀምሮ በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ይሰበካል ተብሎ እንዲሁ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: And ye are witnesses of these things.
verses.fr: Vous êtes témoins de ces choses.
verses.am: እናንተም ለዚህ ምስክሮች ናችሁ።

verses.en: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
verses.fr: Et voici, j''enverrai sur vous ce que mon Père a promis; mais vous, restez dans la ville jusqu''à ce que vous soyez revêtus de la puissance d''en haut.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ አባቴ የሰጠውን ተስፋ እኔ እልክላችኋለሁ፤ እናንተ ግን ከላይ ኃይል እስክትለብሱ ድረስ በኢየሩሳሌም ከተማ ቆዩ።

verses.en: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
verses.fr: Il les conduisit jusque vers Béthanie, et, ayant levé les mains, il les bénit.
verses.am: እስከ ቢታንያም አወጣቸው እጆቹንም አንሥቶ ባረካቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''il les bénissait, il se sépara d''eux, et fut enlevé au ciel.
verses.am: ሲባርካቸውም ከእነርሱ ተለየ ወደ ሰማይም ዐረገ።

verses.en: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
verses.fr: Pour eux, après l''avoir adoré, ils retournèrent à Jérusalem avec une grande joie;
verses.am: እነርሱም፤ ሰገዱለትና በብዙ ደስታ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ፥

verses.en: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
verses.fr: et ils étaient continuellement dans le temple, louant et bénissant Dieu.
verses.am: ዘወትርም እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገኑና እየባረኩ በመቅደስ ኖሩ።
